By reconstructing recorded driving clips inside a georeferenced digital twin (DT-R2S), we condition a diffusion model on geometrically aligned simulator renderings, establishing a digital twin-grounded Sim2Real model (DT-S2R). As a result, DT-S2R synthesizes photorealistic driving images given low-cost yet georeferenced simulator data across both reconstructed and novel simulator scenes within digital-twin coverage. The efficacy of generated data is verified on diverse 3D detectors. DETR3D, especially, reports 93.18% of mAP obtained by a target-region real-data oracle, without employing target images for detector training. Furthermore, simple co-training with existing out-of-target real data outperforms the oracle. Thus, DT-R2S2R can substantially reduce the cost of manual on-site data collection and annotation in digital twin-available districts, providing a practical foundation for scaling 3D perception.

</details>


### [92] [DIPrune: Task-Aware Token Pruning with Dual Importance for Efficient Multimodal Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08341)
*Shuo Yang,Changbai Li,Linlin Yang,Huobin Tan,Rongyu Chen,Tongfei Chen,Tian Wang,Sheng Xu,Baochang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对免训练多模态大模型剪枝中语义退化问题，提出DIPrune框架，通过任务导向的损失失真最小化与双重要性评分机制，同时优化层内静态显著性与层间动态语义演化，在LLaVA和Qwen-VL上取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免训练剪枝方法多依赖视觉冗余或文本-视觉注意力，因任务无关设计或注意力估计不可靠而导致语义退化。实证分析表明，浅层显著token通过数值惯性持续压制新出现的语义token，使深层推理所需信号被过早丢弃。

Method: 从任务导向角度将免训练剪枝重构为最终任务损失失真的最小化问题，推导出可处理的token级上界作为代理目标；该形式化揭示了一个此前被忽略的层间项（跨层梯度）。据此提出DIPrune——基于排序的框架，采用双重要性评分机制，联合优化层内静态特征显著性与层间动态语义演化。

Result: 在LLaVA和Qwen-VL上的大量实验表明，DIPrune持续取得state-of-the-art结果。

Conclusion: DIPrune通过任务导向的失真最小化与层内-层间联合评分，有效缓解语义退化，为免训练多模态大模型剪枝提供了新范式并达到SOTA性能。

Abstract: Recent training-free pruning approaches for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) effectively cut computational overhead by exploiting visual redundancy or text-vision attention. However, they frequently suffer from semantic degradation due to their task-agnostic design or unreliable attention estimates. Based on our empirical analysis, we have found that this issue arises because salient tokens in shallow layers persistently suppress emerging semantic ones through numerical inertia, leading to premature discarding of signals crucial for deep reasoning. To address the aforementioned issue, from the task-oriented aspects, we first reformulate training-free pruning as a minimization of the distortion in the final task loss and derive a tractable, token-wise upper bound to serve as a surrogate objective. Specifically, this formulation inherently reveals a previously neglected inter-layer term that accounts for gradients across layers. Accordingly, for the implementation, we propose DIPrune, a rank-based framework that employs a dual importance scoring mechanism to jointly optimize intra-layer static feature saliency and inter-layer dynamic semantic evolution. Extensive experiments on LLaVA and Qwen-VL demonstrate that DIPrune consistently achieves state-of-the-art results.

</details>


### [93] [PolarScale: A Physics-Grounded Benchmark for Radiometrically Consistent RGB-to-Stokes Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08346)
*Beibei Lin,Tingting Chen,Xin Zhang,Wenhao Zhao,Dongjun Li,Zifeng Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PolarScale基准，将全Stokes重建中被除掉的辐射尺度作为显式预测与评估目标，并系统评测多种模型在该任务上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有从RGB类输入推断偏振的方法仅预测归一化Stokes分量或相对描述符，缺少全Stokes重建所需的辐射尺度，该尺度在归一化过程中被除掉了，导致物理可辨识性缺失且缺乏统一评估目标。

Method: 基于已有三色全Stokes测量构建PolarScale基准：输入为每场景归一化总强度图s0（场景参照线性图像，非消费级sRGB照片），要求模型预测归一化Stokes分量、AoLP/DoLP/DoCP及每场景尺度。由于尺度不可物理辨识，采用数据集条件语义尺度估计，并与常数尺度对照进行对比，同时引入角度、自洽性和物理边界指标；在7种复原类与生成类骨干网络、3种预测策略上进行评测。

Result: 最强复原模型尺度估计平均相对误差为3.6-4.3%，常数对照为5.7%，物理边界违规像素少于0.25%；两个生成基线退化为近零尺度；显式描述符监督提升描述符精度（MAE下PSNR 23.66 vs 18.88 dB）。预测的全Stokes表示改善漫反射/镜面分离、材质分割和眩光分类，但在漫反射/镜面分离上学习尺度仅与常数对照相当。

Conclusion: 将辐射尺度显式化可提升尺度估计与描述符精度，并有益于下游偏振视觉任务，但尺度学习的实际收益在部分任务上仍有限，提示语义尺度估计的物理可辨识性挑战。

Abstract: Polarization imaging provides physical cues beyond intensity imaging but typically requires specialized hardware. Recent methods infer polarization from RGB-like inputs, yet predict only normalized Stokes components or relative descriptors, from which the radiometric scale needed for full Stokes reconstruction has been divided out. We introduce PolarScale, a benchmark that makes this scale an explicit prediction and evaluation target. Built on existing trichromatic full-Stokes measurements, PolarScale takes the per-scene normalized total-intensity image $s_0$ (a scene-referred linear image, not a consumer sRGB photograph) and asks models to predict normalized Stokes components, AoLP/DoLP/DoCP, and a per-scene scale. Because the scale is divided out of the input, it is not physically identifiable; PolarScale therefore evaluates dataset-conditioned semantic scale estimation against a constant-scale control, together with angular, self-consistency, and physical-bound metrics. Across seven restoration-based and generative backbones and three prediction strategies, the strongest restoration models estimate the scale with 3.6-4.3% mean relative error versus 5.7% for the constant control and violate physical bounds on fewer than 0.25% of pixels, whereas two generative baselines collapse to a near-zero scale; explicit descriptor supervision improves descriptor accuracy (23.66 vs. 18.88 dB PSNR for MAE). Predicted full-Stokes representations improve diffuse/specular separation, material segmentation, and glare classification, although in diffuse/specular separation the learned scale performs only on par with the constant control.

</details>


### [94] [Test-Time Adaptation of Quantized ViTs via Single-Pass Quantizer-Aligned Recalibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08358)
*Hyeongheon Cha,Young D. Kwon,Sung-Ju Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出QuAR，一种面向量化ViT的单次前向、免反向传播、免参数更新的测试时自适应方法，通过将测试流的逐通道统计量重新对齐到源校准区间来减轻激活量化码分布失真，在ImageNet-C上以更低时延和极小内存开销超越现有免反传TTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化ViT在分布偏移下性能脆弱，而现有TTA方法与量化推理约束不匹配：基于反向传播的方法开销大，免反传方法仍需额外前向或参数更新，轻量特征/逻辑层方法只能恢复部分精度。更关键的是，一个量化特有的失效模式未被直接针对——分布偏移下激活以不同方式占据冻结量化器的校准范围，导致码分布失真，从而放大精度下降。

Method: QuAR（Quantizer-Aligned Recalibration）：单次前向的TTA方法，不反向传播、不更新任何模型参数。在冻结量化器输入端对激活进行重新校准，将测试流的逐通道运行时统计量映射回源校准区间，从而对齐量化器的码分布。

Result: 在ImageNet-C与ViT-B上，QuAR在3、4、6、8比特权重/激活精度下取得免反传TTA方法中最高的平均精度；8比特下超过最强基线2.28个百分点，3比特下超过4.00个百分点；时延降低46%，内存开销仅0.17 MB（峰值推理内存的0.01%）。诊断分析表明增益源于量化器处逐通道失配减少，恢复了基线未改变或进一步扭曲的码分布。单一固定配置在持续流、非独立同分布标签偏移、七个分布外数据集套件及另外三种主干网络上均保持领先。

Conclusion: QuAR以单次前向、免反传、免参数更新的方式，直接针对量化器码分布失配这一量化特有失效模式进行激活重校准，在多种比特精度、偏移类型、骨干网络与连续流场景下均优于现有免反传TTA方法，兼具高精度、低时延与极小内存开销。

Abstract: Post-training quantization is a standard route to fitting vision transformers (ViTs) into edge compute and memory budgets, yet quantized models become especially brittle under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) addresses such shifts without labels, but most existing approaches are poorly aligned with the constraints of quantized inference. Prevailing TTA methods recover accuracy through backpropagation, while backprop-free methods often still incur overhead from extra forward passes or parameter updates, and lightweight feature- or logit-level methods recover only part of the loss. Across these approaches, a quantization-specific failure mode that amplifies the drop is not directly targeted: under shift, activations occupy frozen quantizers' calibrated ranges differently, distorting their code distribution. We propose Quantizer-Aligned Recalibration (QuAR), a single-pass TTA method tailored to quantized ViTs that neither backpropagates nor updates any model parameters. QuAR recalibrates activations at the input to a frozen quantizer, mapping the test stream's running per-channel statistics back toward the source calibration. On ImageNet-C with ViT-B, QuAR achieves the highest mean accuracy among state-of-the-art backprop-free TTA methods at 3-, 4-, 6- and 8-bit weight/activation precision, outperforming the strongest baseline by 2.28 points at 8 bits and 4.00 at 3 bits, with 46% lower latency and a memory overhead of only 0.17 MB (0.01% of peak inference memory). Analysis and diagnostics trace the gain to a reduced per-channel mismatch at these quantizers, which restores the code distribution the baselines leave unchanged or distort further. A single fixed configuration remains ahead across continual streams, non-i.i.d. label shift, seven out-of-distribution suites, and three other backbones.

</details>


### [95] [A Stevens's Power Law Check-up of GPT-5.5's Image-Based Visualization Reading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08365)
*Kaichun Yang,Jian Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究将Stevens幂定律迁移至AI模型，用以测量算法模型对可视化的固有感知能力，并以十二种视觉变量开展无图例的对照估计实验，使模型"读图"可量化、可与人类感知比较且更易解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可视化评价多聚焦人类感知，缺少对AI模型内建感知机制的度量工具，导致模型读图过程难以量化、难以与人类感知对照、也难以被人理解。

Method: 借用Stevens幂定律构建心理物理式测量范式；在无图例的试点实验中，模型先观察参考图并估计其量值，再对同一视觉表征的后续图像相对于参考图估计量值；覆盖十二种视觉变量进行系统评测。

Result: 通过十二种视觉变量的评测，模型对视觉编码的读取被转化为可测量的指标，实现了与人类感知的可比性，并提升了可解释性。

Conclusion: 该范式可揭示算法模型的内建感知机制，为AI可视化理解提供与人类感知可对齐的量化评估路径。

Abstract: We adapt Stevens's power law to measure the innate ability of AI models to read visualizations, which can reveal the built-in perceptual mechanisms of algorithmic models. In our pilot study, models see no legend. A model first views a reference visual representation and estimates its magnitude, then estimates the magnitude of each subsequent image of the same representation relative to that reference. Our evaluation of twelve visual variables makes how algorithmic models read visual encodings measurable, comparable with human perception, and more interpretable to humans.

</details>


### [96] [UniCounting: Instance-Aware Proposal Consolidation for Image-Query-Free Multi-Category Counting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08379)
*Jinshi Liu,Pan Liu,Lei He,Weichao Luo,Rui Qian*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 UniCounting，将固定词表、无图像查询的多类别计数建模为对过完备候选掩码的实例级结构推断；仅训练 3267 参数的关系头，在 COCO clean500 上优于校准的 OWLv2-All80。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉计数通常在给定图像级示例、文本查询或目标类别的条件下只统计单一指定目标，模型输出单一计数。本文关注更受限的设定：固定词表且无图像查询的多类别计数——词表在每次运行前固定，模型只接收 RGB 图像，需在不被告知哪些类别出现的情况下预测完整的类别-计数向量。

Method: 将计数表述为对过完备候选集的实例感知结构推断。通用分割器会产生重复掩码、局部视图和来自邻近实例的候选；语义分数只能为其命名，无法判定哪些候选指代同一对象。方法使用冻结的 SAM 2.1 生成掩码，冻结的 DINOv2 与 OpenCLIP 提供关系特征与类别特征；一个 3267 参数、类别共享的关系头基于实例掩码导出的监督预测同实例亲和度。随后通过稀疏图构建、代表选择、标注与背景边距准入，将每个被接纳的连通分量转换为一个计数，并附带可复现的分组证据。仅训练关系头，不使用计数或密度图目标。

Result: 在 COCO clean500 上，UniCounting 相比校准的 OWLv2-All80 取得更低的点估计向量 ℓ1 误差与缺席类虚假质量，微观存在 F1 相当。在匹配解码器下，学习到的关系相对掩码包含、掩码 IoU、CLIP 与 DINO 均降低了两类误差，并揭示出碎片化-合并的权衡。另在 OmniCount-sub、FSC-147 与 CARPK 上报告了迁移诊断结果。

Conclusion: 通过把多类别计数转化为过完备候选上的实例级关系推断，仅训练轻量关系头即可实现固定词表、无图像查询的多类别计数，并在点估计误差与缺席类虚假质量上优于校准基线，同时体现出碎片化与合并之间的权衡。

Abstract: Visual counting is commonly formulated as counting a single specified target, with a model receiving an image-specific exemplar, text query, or target category and returning a single count. We instead study fixed-vocabulary image-query-free multi-category counting. A global vocabulary is fixed for each run, and, given only an RGB image, the model predicts a complete category--count vector without being told which categories appear. We present UniCounting, which casts counting as instance-aware structural inference over an over-complete proposal set. Generic segmenters produce duplicate masks, partial views, and proposals from neighboring instances; semantic scores can name them but cannot determine which denote the same object. Frozen SAM~2.1 generates masks, while frozen DINOv2 and OpenCLIP provide relation and category features. A 3,267-parameter category-shared relation head predicts same-instance affinities from instance-mask-derived supervision. Sparse graph construction, representative selection, labeling, and background-margin admission then convert each admitted component into one count with replayable group evidence. Only the relation head is trained, without count or density-map targets. On COCO clean500, UniCounting obtains lower point-estimate vector $\ell_1$ error and absent-class false mass than calibrated OWLv2-All80, with comparable micro presence F1. Under a matched decoder, the learned relation reduces both errors relative to mask containment, mask IoU, CLIP, and DINO, while revealing a fragmentation--merge trade-off. We also report transfer diagnostics on OmniCount-sub, FSC-147, and CARPK.

</details>


### [97] [UP-MOPD: Update Projection in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08398)
*Taojie Zhu,Jing Jin,Yuan Xia,Chenyang Ding,Qunshan He,Wanke Xia,Tao Sun,Yan Chen,Jian Wang,Jinjie Gu,Tao Feng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出 UP-MOPD，通过在优化器更新层面进行投影而非梯度修正，缓解多教师在线策略蒸馏中的域间冲突，在医疗与通用领域及公开基准上取得更优综合表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多教师在线策略蒸馏旨在将不同领域专家整合进单一学生模型，但存在梯度冲突，阻碍知识融合。已有梯度修正方法在朴素 SGD 下可约束参数更新，然而在 AdamW 等优化器中，动量、自适应缩放与权重衰减可能使被修正的梯度转化为一阶上增大某领域损失的更新，形成理论与实践的缺口。

Method: 提出面向多教师在线策略蒸馏的更新投影方法 UP-MOPD。其流程为：先让原始混合梯度正常更新优化器状态并产生候选位移，随后仅对违反约束的候选位移在其提交至参数前进行投影；投影解为该候选位移在欧氏距离下唯一的可行最近更新。

Result: 在医疗与通用领域组合实验中，UP-MOPD 在训练后期相较 vanilla M-OPD 将 IFEval-loose 准确率提升 2.96 分；在八项指标上平均得分 60.03，优于梯度投影（59.00）与更新拒绝（59.15）。在涵盖数学、代码与指令遵循的公开基准上，六项任务平均最优（32.67），在 LiveCodeBench v5 上领先，并在 IFEval 上取得并列最佳结果。

Conclusion: 结果表明，将约束施加于优化器更新（而非梯度）进行投影，可有效降低多教师在线策略蒸馏中的领域间干扰，提升学生模型在多领域任务上的综合性能。

Abstract: On-policy distillation from multiple teachers combines expertise from different domains in a single student, but conflicting gradients can hinder this integration. Gradient corrections directly constrain parameter updates under plain SGD. With optimizers such as AdamW, however, momentum, adaptive scaling, and weight decay can turn a corrected gradient into an update that increases a domain loss to first order. To address this gap, we propose Update Projection for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (UP-MOPD). UP-MOPD lets the original mixed gradient update the optimizer state and generate a candidate displacement, then projects only violating candidates before they are committed to the parameters. The projection gives the unique feasible update closest to the candidate in Euclidean distance. In experiments combining medical and general domains, UP-MOPD improves IFEval-loose accuracy late in training by 2.96 points over vanilla M-OPD. It achieves an average score of 60.03 across eight metrics, compared with 59.00 for gradient projection and 59.15 for update rejection. On a public benchmark covering mathematics, code, and instruction following, it achieves the best average across six tasks (32.67), leads on LiveCodeBench v5, and ties for the best IFEval result.These results support projecting optimizer updates to reduce interference between domains.

</details>


### [98] [GeoPID: Decomposing and Steering Visual Information in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08401)
*Seulgi Kim,Zhixiong Zhang,Xinwei Zhang,Jie Ling,Ronn Shaw*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练框架GeoPID，从几何视角分解多模态信息为冗余、模态独有与协同成分，发现正确答案在强视觉定位需求下具有更强视觉独有成分，并通过在推理时沿视觉独有子空间选择性放大视觉表示，无需参数更新即可平均相对提升7.63%准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型虽性能优异，但倾向低估视觉信息、过度依赖文本上下文，导致视觉定位能力不足。

Method: GeoPID为免训练框架，基于视觉与文本表示子空间之间的几何关系，将信息分解为冗余、模态独有和协同三部分；在22个VLM与14个基准上分析后，提出针对性干预技术，在推理阶段沿视觉独有子空间选择性放大视觉表示。

Result: 跨22个VLM与14个基准的分析表明，当问题强需求视觉定位时，正确预测表现出更强的视觉独有成分；所提干预在无额外参数更新下增强视觉定位能力，平均相对准确率提升7.63%。

Conclusion: 从几何视角分析并调控多模态信息，可在不更新模型参数的情况下有效缓解VLM对文本的过度依赖，提升视觉定位性能。

Abstract: While recent vision-language models (VLMs) have shown outstanding performance across diverse applications, they tend to under-use visual information and over-rely on textual context. In this work, we propose \textsc{GeoPID}, a training-free framework that analyzes multimodal information within VLMs from a geometric perspective. \textsc{GeoPID} decomposes information into Redundant, Modality-Unique, and Synergistic components through the geometric relationships between visual and textual representation subspaces. Through an extensive analysis across 22 VLMs and 14 benchmarks, we confirm that correct predictions exhibit stronger vision-unique components when questions strongly require visual grounding. Building on this geometric analysis, we introduce a targeted intervention technique that selectively amplifies visual representations along the vision-unique subspace during inference. As a result, visual grounding capabilities were enhanced without any additional model parameter updates, achieving an average relative accuracy gain of 7.63\%.

</details>


### [99] [Decoy and disclosure radii of invariant shape descriptors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08410)
*Tanush Shaska,Lubjana Beshaj*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 对旋转不变描述子的纤维维度与秩进行分析，证明标准不变量池存在诱饵族与镜像诱饵，并给出两个精确验证案例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旋转不变描述子（如球谐不变量）常用于形状识别与检索，但其纤维结构决定了安全性与唯一性：纤维半径过大意味着存在可被误匹配的远距离诱饵，半径过小则会泄露注册形状。现有标准不变量池是否具有唯一性、能否消除镜像歧义，尚缺乏量化分析。

Method: 针对截断至球谐次数 L、含 n 个系数的星形曲面，以轨道距离刻画描述子的纤维半径与秩，推导一般秩 r 的描述子在模旋转下纤维维数为 n−3−r；分析带功率池、偶双谱与三阶带三个不变量的诱饵族维数与秩饱和行为；用精确算术与区间算术对两个案例进行验证。

Result: 标准池（带功率、偶双谱、三阶带三个不变量）在 L=4,6,8 时分别存在维数 5、13、20 的诱饵族，其秩直至 L=16 才达到 n−3，且每个 L 均残留镜像诱饵；奇双谱在 L≥4 时一般可消除镜像诱饵。固定平均半径时该池可精确确定所围体积，但无法判定曲面是否满足间隙要求。L=6 时存在诱饵，与全部 32 个不变量的相对精度达 2×10^{-18}，轨道距离至少为注册元组范数的 0.87 倍；对小行星 (101955) Bennu 雷达形状模型，该池能恢复建模体积、却丢失手性，并使禁入半径不确定性超过 7 m。

Conclusion: 标准旋转不变描述子池对星形曲面的识别存在本质非唯一性：存在高维诱饵族与持久镜像诱饵，且无法保证间隙等几何约束的判定；奇双谱可部分弥补镜像歧义。研究提示需谨慎使用此类不变量于安全敏感或几何约束严格的场景。

Abstract: A recognizer that compares rotation-invariant descriptors sees a surface only up to the fiber of the descriptor. We measure this fiber by its radius in the orbit distance from the enrolled surface. A large radius admits decoys, that is, distant shapes that pass the matcher. A small radius discloses the enrolled shape to anyone who captures the stored value. For star-shaped surfaces truncated to spherical harmonics of degree at most $L$, with $n$ coefficients, a descriptor of generic rank $r$ has generic fibers of dimension $n-3-r$ modulo rotations. The standard pool of band powers, even bispectra, and three invariants of the degree-three band therefore admits decoy families of dimension $5$, $13$, $20$ at $L=4,6,8$. Its rank first reaches $n-3$ at $L=16$, and a mirror decoy remains at every $L$. The odd bispectra remove the mirror decoy generically for $L \geq 4$. Yet at fixed mean radius the same pool determines the enclosed volume exactly, and it does not determine whether a surface meets a clearance requirement. We certify two cases by exact and interval arithmetic. At $L=6$ a decoy matches all $32$ invariants to relative precision $2 \cdot 10^{-18}$ at orbit distance at least $0.87$ times the norm of the enrolled tuple. For the radar shape model of asteroid (101955) Bennu, the pool recovers the modeled volume, misses the handedness, and leaves the keep-out radius uncertain by more than $7 \, \mathrm{m}$.

</details>


### [100] [Image Bitstream Fine-grained Understanding for Privacy-Friendly AIoT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08414)
*Zhen Yu,Wenyang Liu,Kejun Wu,Chengwang Xiao,Renjie Qiao,Chengtao Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出面向图像比特流细粒度理解（IBFU）的基础模型 BFG，可直接从编码比特流中提取语义并生成细粒度描述，无需像素域重建，具备隐私友好特性，并在比特流受损场景下保持稳定性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统视觉理解需将图像完整解码至像素域，导致像素级视觉内容在推理流程中暴露，难以满足 AIoT 场景的隐私保护需求；同时实际传输与存储中比特流易受损，现有视觉语言模型在此类场景下性能下降严重。因此需要一种不依赖像素重建、且对受损比特流鲁棒的细粒度理解范式。

Method: 提出 Bitstream Fine-grained Generator（BFG）基础模型，包含两部分：Bitstream Semantic Encoder（BSeE）直接从编码图像比特流建模语义表示，不做显式像素重建；Fine-grained Semantic Generator（FSeG）通过自回归生成将比特流语义转换为详细自然语言描述。同时构建大规模受损比特流细粒度理解数据集 CFU-D，涵盖完整比特流与多种损坏类型、不同严重程度的受损变体，用于训练与评估。

Result: 在比特流受损条件下，BFG 仍能保持稳定的细粒度描述生成能力。以 Stanford Dogs Caption 数据集上的平均 CIDEr 为例，性能仅从 0.6339 轻微下降至 0.6077；而 Qwen-VL-Chat、BLIP-2、GLM、Gemini、GPT 等视觉语言模型性能下降严重。

Conclusion: 该工作为 AIoT 场景下的隐私友好细粒度视觉理解提供了一种可行范式，验证了直接在比特流域进行语义分析与生成的可行性与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Image Bitstream Fine-grained Understanding (IBFU) aims to directly perform fine-grained classification and semantic description generation from encoded image byte sequences. In contrast to conventional pixel-domain visual understanding, IBFU conducts semantic analysis without fully decoding images into the pixel domain. Since pixel-level visual content is not explicitly reconstructed during inference, this paradigm reduces visual exposure within the processing pipeline and suits privacy-friendly Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT) applications. In this paper, we propose Bitstream Fine-grained Generator (BFG), a novel foundation model tailored for IBFU. BFG consists of two main components: a Bitstream Semantic Encoder (BSeE) and a Fine-grained Semantic Generator (FSeG). BSeE directly models semantic representations from encoded image bitstreams without explicit pixel reconstruction, while FSeG transforms the extracted bitstream semantics into detailed natural-language descriptions through autoregressive generation. To train BFG and comprehensively evaluate IBFU in practical AIoT scenarios, where image bitstreams may suffer corruption during transmission and storage, we construct a large-scale Corrupted-bitstream Fine-grained Understanding dataset (CFU-D), containing both intact bitstreams and corrupted variants across multiple corruption types and severity levels. Experiments show that BFG maintains stable fine-grained caption generation under bitstream corruption. For example, the performance only has slight change from 0.6339 to 0.6077 in terms of average CIDEr score on Stanford Dogs Caption dataset, while vision-language models, such as Qwen-VL-Chat, BLIP-2, GLM, Gemini, and GPT suffer severe performance decrease. This paper provides a practical paradigm for privacy-friendly fine-grained understanding in AIoT.

</details>


### [101] [Ariadne's Thread of LipSync: Unraveling Forgeries via Inconsistency between Lip Motions and Head Poses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08417)
*Tianyi She,Jiawei Liu,Weifeng Liu,Hanqing Zhao,Weiming Zhang,Kejiang Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LipDA框架，利用唇部与头部姿态的生物耦合不一致性，联合实现LipSync伪造检测与生成模型溯源归因，检测AUC超97%、归因准确率达97.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LipSync生成技术日益逼真，带来严重社会风险；现有防御策略难以应对，因为先进生成方法不仅唇音同步更好，还消除了视觉伪影，导致传统线索失效。作者认为其忽视了自然语音视频中唇部运动与头部姿态间的固有生物耦合关系。

Method: LipDA框架利用头-唇不一致性：检测阶段通过对真实与伪造视频的唇部特征和姿态特征进行对比，学习量化二者差异；归因阶段捕获各生成模型特有的时序动态与音视同步模式作为"指纹"，实现源追踪。同时构建了大规模、多生成器的LipSync-A数据集。

Result: 在两个具有挑战性的LipSync数据集及自建大规模多生成器数据集上，检测AUC超97%，模型归因准确率97.5%，显著优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 头-唇生物耦合不一致性可作为鲁棒的LipSync伪造判别线索，LipDA实现了检测与归因的联合建模，并开源代码与数据集以推动后续研究。

Abstract: Recent advances in LipSync generation technology have led to the creation of highly realistic videos, posing severe societal risks. However, existing defense strategies struggle against LipSync forgeries, as advanced LipSync generation methods not only achieve better lip synchronization but also eliminate visual artifacts. An important reason is that they overlook an inherent biological coupling between lip movements and head poses in natural speech videos. In this paper, we propose LipDA, a novel framework for joint LipSync Detection and Attribution, which takes advantage of the inconsistency between head and lip. For detection, the framework learns to quantify this discrepancy by contrasting lip and pose features from authentic versus forged videos. For attribution, our method is designed to capture the unique temporal dynamics and audio-visual synchronization patterns that act as the fingerprint of models, enabling source tracing. We conduct extensive experiments on two challenging LipSync datasets as well as our own proposed large-scale and multi-generator dataset. LipDA achieves over 97\% AUC in detection and 97.5\% accuracy in model attribution, significantly outperforming existing methods. Code and the proposed LipSync-A dataset are available at https://github.com/AnsonShe/LipDA.

</details>


### [102] [From the Drosophila Visual Connectome to General-Purpose Computer Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08418)
*Zongyu Li,Akito Yamauchi,Huaizhi Liu,Vishwanatha Rao,Jia Guo,for the Frontotemporal Lobar Degeneration Neuroimaging Initiative,for the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ConnectomeX/FlyVision，一种保留 ON/OFF 并行、循环计算与群体图交互的类脑可训练视觉架构，在参数远少于 ResNet18 的情况下于自然与医学影像任务上取得接近或更优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物连接组蕴含面向视觉计算的结构化解，可提供可复用的归纳偏置；工作动机是将果蝇视觉连接组的计算特性迁移到人工视觉，探索其可扩展性与跨任务泛化能力。

Method: 围绕 FlyVision 构建 ConnectomeX：保留并行 ON/OFF 通路、循环计算与群体级图交互，并跨任务扩展模型容量；引入 local-k7 与低频学习分支；通过 BrainAGE 将共享的 ImageNet 预训练 FlyVision Large 编码器应用于每例扫描的 24 张矢状/冠状/轴状切片，并以置信度调制高斯投票融合切片年龄估计与三轴结果。

Result: MNIST 99.34%（80,608 参数）、CIFAR-10 78.03%（81,408 参数）；ImageNet-1K 上 Base/Large 达 60.79%/66.25%（1.8M/3.7M 参数），local-k7+低频分支达 66.53%，接近 ResNet18 的 69.25%（11.7M）；22 类皮肤病 63.78% 准确率、95.28% macro-AUROC（2.99M 参数）；四类胸片 ImageNet 预训练 Base/Large 为 92.60%/92.76%（1.33M/2.97M），优于 ResNet18 的 91.56%（11.18M）；BrainAGE 在 433 例留出扫描上三轴融合 MAE 5.98 岁、R²=0.868。

Conclusion: 连接组启发的计算在 224×224 分类任务中与 ResNet18 差距在三个百分点以内，并在胸片上以显著更少参数实现反超，表明保守的连接组信息计算可从紧凑识别扩展至大规模自然与生物医学视觉。

Abstract: Biological connectomes encode structured solutions to visual computation that may provide reusable inductive biases for artificial vision. We develop ConnectomeX around FlyVision, a trainable architecture that preserves parallel ON/OFF processing, recurrent computation and population-level graph interaction while scaling model capacity across tasks. FlyVision reached 99.34% accuracy on MNIST with 80,608 parameters and 78.03% on CIFAR-10 with 81,408 parameters. On ImageNet-1K, FlyVision Base and Large reached 60.79% and 66.25% top-1 accuracy with 1.8 and 3.7 million parameters, while a Large local-k7 model with a learned low-frequency branch reached 66.53%, compared with 69.25% for ResNet18 with 11.7 million parameters. On a 22-class skin-disease benchmark, FlyVision Large achieved 63.78% accuracy and 95.28% macro-AUROC with 2.99 million parameters. In four-class chest radiography, ImageNet-pretrained FlyVision Base and Large reached 92.60% and 92.76% accuracy with 1.33 and 2.97 million parameters, compared with 91.56% for ImageNet-pretrained ResNet18 with 11.18 million. BrainAGE extends FlyVision to volumetric T1-weighted MRI by applying a shared ImageNet-pretrained FlyVision Large encoder to 24 sagittal, coronal and axial slices per scan and combining slice-level age estimates by confidence-modulated Gaussian voting. On 433 held-out scans, three-axis fusion achieved a mean absolute error of 5.98 years and R^2 = 0.868. Across the 224x224 classification tasks, the best FlyVision configuration remained within three percentage points of ResNet18 on ImageNet-1K and skin-disease classification and exceeded it on chest radiography with substantially fewer parameters. These results show that a conserved connectome-informed computation can scale from compact recognition to large-scale natural and biomedical vision.

</details>


### [103] [Deformable CT-US Registration via Anatomy-Aware Implicit Neural Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08419)
*Agnieszka Lach,Magdalena Wysocki,Feng Li,Mohammad Farid Azampour,Benjamin D. Killeen,Felix Ginzinger,Mathias Braun,Philipp Steininger,Heinz Deutschmann,Nassir Navab*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文提出一种融合CT解剖先验的可变形CT-超声配准框架：先用机器人辅助光学跟踪完成刚性配准，再用SIREN隐式神经表示逐帧估计形变场，并引入CT HU导出的组织刚度空间变正则、接触区位移先验与扇形几何正则，以NGF优化。相比刚性初始化对齐提升17%，优于经典可变形基线且几乎无拓扑折叠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超声与术前CT的切片到体数据配准可辅助微创介入，在术中定位CT中可辨的软组织。光学跟踪虽能提供初始刚性配准，但探头接触引起的软组织形变会破坏刚性对齐精度，因此需要引入解剖先验的可变形配准方法。

Method: 框架先通过机器人辅助光学跟踪建立刚性配准，随后以SIREN正弦隐式神经表示按帧优化可变形变换。由CT的HU值近似组织刚度作为空间变化正则，抑制骨等刚性结构形变、放宽软组织形变。另加两项物理约束：接触区位移先验（使探头面下方组织受压）和基于波束方向与凸阵探头视场的扇形几何正则。参数以归一化梯度场（NGF）优化。

Result: 相比刚性初始化，对齐精度提升17%，并优于经典可变形配准基线，同时保持近乎零的拓扑折叠。

Conclusion: 将CT解剖先验（组织刚度、接触物理与扇形几何）嵌入隐式神经可变形配准，可有效补偿探头接触导致的软组织结构形变，实现高精度、低折叠的CT-超声配准，适用于微创介入中的术中定位。

Abstract: Slice-to-volume registration between ultrasound (US) and preoperative computed tomography (CT) imaging would enhance many minimally invasive interventions, for example by locating soft tissue structures intra-operatively that are discernible in CT. While optical tracking enables initial rigid registration, contact from the probe induces soft tissue deformations that inhibit accurate alignment. In this work, we introduce a deformable CT-ultrasound registration framework that incorporates anatomical priors derived from CT to improve registration under deformation. Rigid registration is first established using a robot-assisted optical tracking system, after which a deformable transformation is estimated using a sinusoidal implicit neural representation (SIREN) optimized per frame. Tissue stiffness is approximated from CT-based HU values and used as spatially varying regularization, suppressing deformation in rigid structures such as bone while allowing more flexibility in soft tissue. Two additional constraints capture the physics of probe contact: a contact-zone displacement prior that drives the displacement field to compress tissue below the probe face, and a fan-geometry regularization term based on beam direction and convex transducer field of view. Model parameters are optimized with a normalized gradient field (NGF). The proposed approach improves alignment over rigid initialisation by 17% and outperforms classical deformable baselines while maintaining near-zero topological folding.

</details>


### [104] [HuC-VideoMAE: Human-Centric Video Masked Autoencoding from synthetic data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08433)
*Ricardo Pizarro,Roberto Valle,José M. Buenaposada,Luis M. Bergasa,Luis Baumela*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究在合成人体动作数据集上进行视频Transformer自监督预训练，提出以人体为中心的掩码策略，缩小了与Kinetics预训练的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流动作识别模型依赖Kinetics-700等大规模网络爬取视频预训练，但此类数据通常未获得被摄者同意，存在伦理问题。BEDLAM2.0等基于动作捕捉生成的合成视频数据集提供了合乎伦理的替代方案，但将其用于自监督预训练的效果尚不理想。

Method: 首先验证标准VideoMAE掩码策略直接用于合成数据预训练会显著劣于Kinetics预训练。为此提出一种以人体为中心的掩码方案，利用人体关键点和人体边界框区域指导掩码，使模型在预训练阶段聚焦于人体运动的结构与动态。

Result: 在NTU RGB+D和Toyota-Smarthome上的实验表明，该方法显著优于在合成数据上的标准VideoMAE预训练；在NTU RGB+D跨视角-跨被试设置下，在不使用任何真实帧预训练的情况下，弥补了与Kinetics预训练之间49%的性能差距。

Conclusion: 以人体结构先验引导的掩码策略可有效提升合成数据预训练质量，为构建合乎伦理的动作识别模型提供了可行路径，作者将公开预训练模型以促进相关研究与应用。

Abstract: Modern action recognition models rely on video transformers pretrained on massive collections of web-crawled videos, such as Kinetics-700. However, the use of such data raises ethical concerns, as subjects' consent is typically not obtained. Recent high-quality synthetic video datasets generated from motion-capture data, such as BEDLAM2.0, offer a promising ethical alternative. In this work, we investigate self-supervised pretraining of video transformers on synthetic human-motion datasets. We first show that directly applying the standard VideoMAE masking strategy leads to substantially worse performance than pretraining on Kinetics. To address this limitation, we propose a human-centric masking scheme that leverages body keypoints and person bounding box regions. Our approach encourages the model to focus on the structure and dynamics of human motion during pretraining. Experiments on NTU RGB+D and Toyota-Smarthome demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms standard VideoMAE pretraining on synthetic data, closing 49% of the gap to Kinetics pretraining on NTU RGB+D cross-view-subject without using a single real frame during pretraining. To promote the use of ethical action recognition models, we will publicly release our pretrained models.

</details>


### [105] [Knee3DVLM: Dual-Sequence Full-Volume Vision-Language Modeling for Comprehensive Knee MRI Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08482)
*Maryam Baizhigitova,Andrew Seohwan Yu,Po-Hao Chen,Naveen Subhas,Sixu Chen,Xinxin Wang,Kunio Nakamura,Richard Lartey,Xiaojuan Li,Mingrui Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出序列感知的视觉语言模型Knee3DVLM，融合DESS与TSE全容积膝关节MRI预测57个MOAKS衍生二分类诊断目标，融合配置性能优于单序列，并在多分类分析中优于现有最强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在三维医学影像中应用渐广，但在膝关节MRI上仍有限，尤其难以处理临床实践中互补的多序列（如DESS与流体敏感TSE）信息，缺乏面向结构化报告的多序列融合建模方案。

Method: 构建序列感知VLM Knee3DVLM，输入全容积DESS与流体敏感TSE MRI，输出源自MOAKS的57个解剖定位二分类诊断目标以支持结构化报告；在受试者不重叠的Osteoarthritis Initiative划分上，对比DESS单序列、TSE单序列与DESS-TSE配对三种配置。

Result: 在1,074例留出队列中，融合模型取得平均准确率72.98%、平衡准确率71.17%、平均ROC-AUC 78.96%、宏平均ROC-AUC 78.74%，三项配置中最高；在与3DReasonKnee队列对齐的次要多分类分析中，五类病理指标数值上均高于已报道的最强3DReasonKnee配置。

Conclusion: 结果支持采用双序列全容积建模以实现全面的膝关节MRI评估。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly being applied to three-dimensional medical imaging, but their application to knee MRI remains limited, particularly for interpreting the complementary sequences used in clinical practice. We introduce Knee3DVLM, a sequence-aware VLM that uses full-volume DESS and fluid-sensitive TSE MRI to predict 57 anatomically resolved binary diagnostic targets derived from the MRI Osteoarthritis Knee Score (MOAKS) for structured reporting. We evaluated DESS-only, TSE-only, and paired DESS-TSE configurations using subject-disjoint Osteoarthritis Initiative partitions. In a held-out cohort of 1,074 examinations, the fused model achieved 72.98% average accuracy, 71.17% balanced accuracy, 78.96% mean ROC-AUC, and 78.74% macro ROC-AUC, the highest values among the three configurations. In a secondary multiclass analysis aligned with the released 3DReasonKnee cohort, Knee3DVLM was numerically higher than the strongest reported 3DReasonKnee configuration across five pathology categories. These findings support dual-sequence full-volume modeling for comprehensive knee MRI assessment.

</details>


### [106] [2D Spatial Reasoning with Adaptive Neural Cellular Automata](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08518)
*Martin Spitznagel,Janis Keuper*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出自适应神经细胞自动机(aNCA),用可变形卷积动态调整感受野,在网格类数据上迭代推理2D空间关系,在数独、迷宫最短路径等图像化谜题任务上取得可理解的最优结果与强泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习方法仍难以处理空间推理任务,缺乏利用感知实体的几何信息及其相互空间关系来解决问题的能力。

Method: 提出自适应神经细胞自动机(aNCA)架构,采用可变形卷积(deformable convolutions)动态自适应感知/感受野,并在网格状数据结构(如图像)上迭代地进行2D空间关系推理。

Result: 在公开基准上取得当前最优(state of the art)且可理解(comprehensible)的结果,在求解数独、迷宫最短路径等基于图像的谜题时表现出很强的泛化能力。

Conclusion: aNCA通过可变形卷积动态调整感受野并迭代推理空间关系,有效提升空间推理任务的可解释性与泛化性。

Abstract: Many modern learning approaches are still struggling with spatial reasoning tasks, i.e. they lack the ability to utilize geometric information of perceived entities and their spatial relation to each other to solve problems. We introduce a novel Adaptive Neural Cellular Automata (aNCA) architecture which uses deformable convolutions to dynamically adapt the perceptive field and iteratively reason over 2D spatial relations on grid-like data structures (e.g. images). Empirical results on public benchmarks show state of the art comprehensible results with high generalization abilities for solving image based puzzles like Sudoku or finding the shortest path in a maze.

</details>


### [107] [MedCORE: Criteria-Grounded Clinical Reasoning for Interpretable Medical Image Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08528)
*Asim Khan,Samee Ullah Khan,Dwarikanath Mahapatra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MedCORE 是一个将临床诊断标准显式融入视觉-语言架构的结构化诊断框架，分解标准、空间定位、多尺度编码并建模标准间依赖，在多模态医学影像任务上取得一致性提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习模型常将图像特征直接映射为疾病标签，绕过临床诊断中的结构化推理过程，未显式考察形态学与纹理学标准，导致诊断透明度不足，可能影响临床安全部署。

Method: MedCORE（Medical Criteria-Oriented Reasoning and Evidence）将诊断过程分解为临床定义的标准，对每个标准进行空间定位；通过多尺度表示编码宏观结构与微观纹理病理证据；采用图注意力网络显式建模标准间依赖以细化标准表示；将标准表示与临床文本描述对齐，并通过类级视觉原型强化，最后以不确定性校准加权聚合，按比例降低低置信度证据的权重。

Result: 在三个临床异质影像模态上验证：ISIC 2018 皮肤镜病变分类达 89.2% 准确率、85.7% macro-F1、96.4% AUC；BUSI 乳腺超声病变表征达 96.1% 准确率、95.2% macro-F1、98.4% AUC；IDRiD 糖尿病视网膜病变分级达 84.3% 准确率、80.2% macro-F1、92.8% AUC。相比强 CNN、Transformer、生物医学视觉-语言、基于概念及基于原型的基线均有一致提升。

Conclusion: MedCORE 通过在视觉-语言架构中操作化临床推理，实现了结构化、可解释的诊断过程，并在多种医学影像任务上优于现有基线，展示了结构化标准导向推理在临床安全部署中的潜力。

Abstract: Clinical diagnosis is inherently a structured reasoning process, yet existing deep learning models often bypass this structure by mapping image features directly to disease labels without explicitly interrogating the morphological and textural criteria that clinicians systematically evaluate. This limits diagnostic transparency and may compromise safe clinical deployment. We present MedCORE (Medical Criteria-Oriented Reasoning and Evidence), a structured diagnostic framework that operationalizes clinical reasoning within a vision-language architecture. For each input image, MedCORE decomposes the diagnostic process into clinically defined criteria, spatially localizes each criterion to diagnostically relevant image regions, encodes evidence through multi-scale representations that capture macro-structural and micro-textural pathological characteristics, and refines criterion representations using a Graph Attention Network that explicitly models inter-criteria dependencies. Criterion representations are further aligned with clinical text descriptors, reinforced through class-wise visual prototypes, and aggregated using uncertainty-calibrated weighting that proportionally discounts low-confidence diagnostic evidence. MedCORE is validated across three clinically heterogeneous imaging modalities, including dermoscopic lesion classification on ISIC 2018, breast ultrasound lesion characterization on BUSI, and diabetic retinopathy grading on IDRiD. Quantitatively, MedCORE achieves 89.2% accuracy, 85.7% macro-F1, and 96.4% AUC on ISIC 2018; 96.1% accuracy, 95.2% macro-F1, and 98.4% AUC on BUSI; and 84.3% accuracy, 80.2% macro-F1, and 92.8% AUC on IDRiD. These results demonstrate consistent improvements over strong CNN, transformer, biomedical vision-language, concept-based, and prototype-based baselines.

</details>


### [108] [Beyond Perturbation Magnitude: Direction-Dependent Responses in Multimodal Geometric Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08533)
*Yongsheng Luo,Wengan He,Yu Li,Rouying Wu,Wei Lv*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出并验证"方向性几何响应"（DGR）：多模态几何对齐分数的响应并非由扰动位移大小决定，而由位移在局部体积梯度上的投影共同决定，该一阶量可高精度解释退化引起的响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于Gram行列式的几何对齐分数为多模态高阶一致性提供了紧凑建模方式，但其在模态退化（如视频模糊、音频噪声）下的响应机制缺乏理解。作者质疑一个直觉假设：几何分数的响应是否主要由扰动引起的位移幅度决定。

Method: 使用MSR-VTT（N=878）与DiDeMo（N=980）的冻结特征队列，施加受控的视频模糊与音频噪声。对Gramian体积做闭式一阶展开，得到DGR——位移在局部体积梯度上的投影，同时包含干净工作点、位移幅度与位移方向三要素。通过消融与"无方向"替代量对比，并检验预定的增益归一化候选 V/(g_V+eps)。

Result: 位移幅度最多只解释绝对响应样本外方差的15%，幅度匹配的样本对之间响应系统性不同，说明标量幅度无法组织响应。绝对一阶DGR项的样本外R^2为0.838–0.969，匹配幅度排序准确率0.864–0.963，响应符号准确率0.909–0.989；无方向替代量在对应评估协议下仍然弱或不稳定。增益归一化候选未通过可预测性与干净序门控。

Conclusion: 几何响应取决于表征所处的工作点、退化把关系几何移动了多远、以及朝哪个方向移动，三者共同决定；标量位移幅度不足以解释。DGR使用观测到的退化态位移，因而是解释性量而非部署期预测器。

Abstract: Geometric alignment scores based on Gram determinants provide a compact way to model higher-order consistency among modalities, yet how such scores respond to modality degradation is poorly understood. This paper asks whether the response of a multimodal geometric score is determined primarily by the magnitude of the perturbation-induced displacement. Using frozen cohorts from MSR-VTT (N=878) and DiDeMo (N=980), we apply controlled video blur and audio noise and analyze the response in the relational geometry on which the score is defined. Displacement magnitude explains at most 15% of the out-of-sample variance in the absolute response, and magnitude-matched pairs respond systematically differently, so scalar magnitude does not organize the response. The closed-form first-order expansion of the Gramian volume yields the Directional Geometric Response (DGR): the projection of the displacement onto the local volume gradient, which jointly captures the clean operating point, displacement magnitude, and displacement direction. The absolute first-order DGR term explains the observed response with out-of-sample R^2 of 0.838-0.969, matched-magnitude ranking accuracies of 0.864-0.963, and response-sign accuracies of 0.909-0.989, whereas the tested direction-free alternatives remain weak or unstable under the corresponding evaluation protocols. A pre-specified gain-normalization candidate, V/(g_V+eps), fails its predictability and clean-order gates. DGR uses the observed degraded-state displacement and is therefore an explanatory quantity, not a deployment-time predictor: geometric response depends on where the representation operates, how far degradation moves the relational geometry, and in which direction it moves.

</details>


### [109] [RSJEV: Discriminative Remote Sensing Scene Classification with Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08539)
*Dongchen Si,Di Wang,Mingzhen Xu,Jing Zhang,Bo Du,Liangpei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出RSJEV，一种面向遥感场景分类的单次（one-pass）多模态决策框架，将分类重构为候选条件约束的多模态判别决策过程，无需自回归解码即可直接估计类别概率，在三个基准上取得优于CNN、Transformer、Mamba、CLIP和MLLM方法的性能，并以0.8B参数实现更优的精度-效率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遥感场景分类现有方法存在三类局限：任务特定的视觉分类器依赖预定义标签空间、泛化受限；基于CLIP的方法通过静态图文对齐进行识别，交互能力有限；多模态大语言模型（MLLM）将分类当作自回归文本生成，在候选类别明确的情况下引入冗余的token级生成，推理开销大。因此需要一种既能保留视觉-语言交互又能避免自回归解码的低成本、高效率分类范式。

Method: 提出RSJEV单次多模态决策框架。将场景分类重新表述为候选条件约束（candidate-conditioned）的多模态判别决策过程，联合建模视觉表示、任务指令与候选类别语义。核心组件为OnePass Decider：提取多模态决策状态，并在候选类别空间内直接估计类别概率，从而在保留视觉-语言交互的同时消除自回归解码。

Result: 在UC Merced、AID、NWPU-RESISC45三个常用遥感场景分类基准上的大量实验表明，RSJEV的分类性能优于代表性的CNN、Transformer、Mamba、CLIP及MLLM方法；同时显著降低推理成本，在仅0.8B参数的紧凑模型下实现更优的精度-效率权衡。

Conclusion: 结果验证了状态条件化（state-conditioned）多模态决策在高效遥感图像理解中的有效性，表明以判别式决策替代自回归生成是提升遥感场景分类效率与性能的可行路径。代码将开源于 https://github.com/Dongtcs/RSJEV。

Abstract: Remote sensing scene classification is a fundamental task in Earth observation and geospatial analysis. Existing approaches mainly follow three paradigms: task-specific visual classification, vision-language similarity matching, and autoregressive multimodal generation. However, visual classifiers rely on predefined label spaces, CLIP-based methods perform recognition through static image-text alignment, and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) introduce unnecessary token-level generation for classification tasks with explicit candidate categories. To address these limitations, we propose RSJEV, a one-pass multimodal decision framework for remote sensing scene classification. Unlike conventional MLLMs that formulate classification as autoregressive text generation, RSJEV reformulates scene classification as a candidate-conditioned multimodal discriminative decision process, where visual representations, task instructions, and candidate category semantics are jointly modeled. Specifically, we introduce a OnePass Decider that extracts multimodal decision states and directly estimates category probabilities within the candidate category space, eliminating autoregressive decoding while preserving vision-language interactions. Extensive experiments on three widely used remote sensing scene classification benchmarks, including UC Merced, AID, and NWPU-RESISC45, demonstrate that RSJEV achieves superior classification performance compared with representative CNN-, Transformer-, Mamba-, CLIP-, and MLLM-based methods. Moreover, RSJEV significantly reduces inference costs and achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off with only a compact 0.8B-parameter model. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of state-conditioned multimodal decision making for efficient remote sensing image understanding. The code will be available at https://github.com/Dongtcs/RSJEV.

</details>


### [110] [Have I Seen Enough? Frozen Video-Language Models Encode Evidence Readiness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08560)
*Dan Ben-Ami,Kobi Cohen,Chaim Baskin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 冻结的VideoLLM内部已线性编码"证据就绪度"信号，该信号由带时间戳的证据而非模型输出定义，且受问题条件调制；基于此可构建Readiness Gating回答时机策略，在匹配视频时长下最高提升+9.75个百分点准确率，开销可忽略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式视频语言模型不仅要决定回答什么，还需判断当前问题所需证据是否已经到达。现有系统把这一决策当作独立的触发器来学习，本文追问：未经修改的模型本身是否已经计算了该决策。

Method: 将证据就绪度以带时间戳的证据进行标注（而非取自模型输出），在字节完全一致的评测上训练线性探针，检验其可解码性、跨基准族泛化性、问题条件性与错误回答下的稳健性；并与不确定性估计器、已发布流式触发器对比，最终将读出转化为Readiness Gating回答时机策略，并通过移动准确率上限的干预实验进行验证。

Result: 在最严格的not-ready采样下（拟合时钟接近随机），七个模型AUROC为0.733-0.905；无该基准族视频训练的探针仍可读出该族；字节相同的窗口上仅改问题即可在66.1%的问题对上反转读出，而问题盲控制项按构造处于随机水平；错误回答中的AUROC仍达0.722。就绪度在时延匹配的答案选择任务上优于不确定性估计器及其监督组合，且比置信度更贴合人类独立判断。已发布触发器同样是线性读出，但在其自身基座激活上近似与就绪度正交，解码精度远低于探针。Readiness Gating在匹配视频时长下最高提升+9.75个百分点；跨26种配置，增益随任务可提供的准确率上限而变化，且在相同像素上移动该上限会同步移动增益。

Conclusion: 证据就绪度并非需要额外学习的触发器，而是冻结VideoLLM内部已线性可读的、问题条件的信号，其表现优于现有不确定性与触发器方案，并可转化为低开销的回答时机策略，其收益取决于任务可用准确率上限。

Abstract: Streaming video-language models must decide not only what to answer, but whether the evidence needed for the current question has arrived. Existing systems learn that decision as a separate trigger; we ask whether an unmodified model already computes it. We show that frozen VideoLLMs carry a linearly readable evidence-readiness signal, labelled from timestamped evidence rather than from model output. It decodes in all seven models of a shared byte-identical evaluation (AUROC 0.733-0.905 under the strictest not-ready sampling, where a fitted clock is near chance), and a probe fitted without any of a benchmark family's footage still reads that family. It is question-conditioned: on byte-identical windows, changing only the question reverses the readout on 66.1% of pairs, while every question-blind control is at chance by construction. The model can answer incorrectly and still encode readiness: AUROC remains 0.722 among wrong answers. Readiness also beats uncertainty estimators and their supervised combination on latency-matched answer selection, and tracks independent human judgments more closely than confidence. Released streaming triggers are also linear readouts, yet a trained trigger read on its own base model's activations is approximately orthogonal to readiness and decodes it far less accurately than a probe. We turn the readout into Readiness Gating, an answer-timing policy that improves accuracy by up to +9.75 pp at matched video duration with negligible computational overhead. How much it gains varies with the accuracy headroom the task makes available: across 26 configurations the gain tracks that headroom, and an intervention that moves it over identical pixels moves the gain with it.

</details>


### [111] [Sparse2comm: Towards Robust Cooperative 3D Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08573)
*Lei Yang,Boqi Li,Chunmian Lin,Li Wang,Ziying Song,Shaoqing Xu,Heye Huang,Haibao Yu,Chen Lv*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Sparse2comm 是一个带宽高效且鲁棒的协同 3D 目标检测框架，将不可靠协同建模为对退化协同特征的渐进式恢复，在保持干净精度竞争力的同时显著提升多种真实退化下的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协同感知通过车辆与路侧基础设施共享互补观测提升 3D 目标检测，但实际部署受限于带宽有限与协同不可靠：丢包、传输时延与空间错位会共同退化协同特征流。现有方法通常仅降低通信开销或补偿单一退化类型，对耦合扰动处理不足。

Method: Sparse2comm 将不可靠协同视为渐进式恢复流程，包含三部分：(1) Sparse Feature Encoding：将通信编码为协同智能体随机掩码采样的前景特征，自车据此重建稠密语义表示，通过稀疏到稠密机制从稀疏观测推断缺失的以目标为中心的内容，在同一表示内实现超低带宽通信与丢包恢复；(2) Latency-Aware Alignment：在语义恢复特征上预测运动流以补偿延迟消息；(3) Self-Calibrating Fusion：以自监督方式估计残差空间偏移，再进行自适应跨智能体融合。整体按序恢复语义完整性、时间一致性与空间对齐。

Result: 在 DAIR-V2X、OpenV2V 与 V2V4Real 上的大量实验表明，Sparse2comm 保持有竞争力的干净精度，并在单一及混合真实退化下持续提升鲁棒性。与选择性特征通信基线 Where2comm 相比，Sparse2comm 在三个数据集混合设置下 AP@0.5/AP@0.7 分别提升 +20.15/+11.79、+12.66/+11.07 和 +15.36/+12.61。

Conclusion: Sparse2comm 通过稀疏到稠密的语义恢复、时延感知对齐与自校准融合的有序流水线，同时解决带宽限制与丢包、时延、空间错位等耦合退化，在多个真实数据集上实现高效且鲁棒的协同 3D 目标检测。

Abstract: Cooperative perception improves autonomous driving by sharing complementary observations among vehicles and roadside infrastructure for 3D object detection. However, practical deployment is constrained by limited bandwidth and unreliable cooperation, where packet loss, transmission delay, and spatial misalignment jointly degrade the cooperative feature stream. Existing methods often reduce communication cost or compensate for one degradation type, leaving coupled disturbances insufficiently addressed. To address this problem, we propose Sparse2comm, a bandwidth-efficient and robust cooperative 3D object detection framework that treats unreliable cooperation as progressive restoration over degraded cooperative features. Sparse Feature Encoding first encodes communication as randomly mask-sampled foreground features transmitted by collaborating agents, from which the ego vehicle reconstructs dense semantic representations. This sparse-to-dense mechanism learns to infer missing object-centric content from sparse observations, enabling ultra-low-bandwidth communication and packet-loss recovery within the same representation. On the semantically restored features, Latency-Aware Alignment predicts motion flow to compensate delayed messages, and Self-Calibrating Fusion estimates residual spatial offsets in a self-supervised manner before adaptive cross-agent fusion. Sparse2comm therefore restores semantic completeness, temporal consistency, and spatial alignment in an ordered pipeline. Extensive experiments on DAIR-V2X, OpenV2V, and V2V4Real show that Sparse2comm maintains competitive clean accuracy and consistently improves robustness under individual and mixed real-world degradations. Compared with the selective feature communication baseline Where2comm, Sparse2comm improves mixed-setting AP@0.5/AP@0.7 by +20.15/+11.79, +12.66/+11.07, and +15.36/+12.61 on the three datasets, respectively.

</details>


### [112] [FedDermaSeg: Federated Learning for Dermatological Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08574)
*Anabik Pal,Ganesh Patidar,Bikash Santra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究联邦学习在皮肤病变分割中的可行性，在ISIC 2018与PH2上验证其性能接近集中式训练并优于本地模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 皮肤癌早期检测与病灶精确勾画至关重要，分割是计算机辅助诊断的基础步骤。传统深度学习分割依赖集中式训练，需将图像与掩膜汇聚到中心服务器，在医疗场景中引发隐私问题并消耗大量集中算力。

Method: 采用ISIC 2018皮肤病变分割挑战赛的训练集与验证集模拟分布式学习环境，构建联邦分割模型；在ISIC 2018测试集与PH2数据集上评估其性能与泛化能力，并与集中式训练和本地训练模型对比。

Result: 联邦模型性能与集中式训练相当，且持续优于各本地训练模型。

Conclusion: 联邦学习可在不集中聚合医学图像的前提下实现协作式皮肤病变分割，具备应用潜力。

Abstract: Skin cancer is a major global health concern, and early detection and accurate lesion delineation are important for effective diagnosis and treatment planning. Automated skin lesion analysis can assist dermatologists, with lesion segmentation serving as a fundamental step in computer-aided diagnostic systems. Conventional deep learning-based segmentation models typically rely on centralized training, where images and their corresponding segmentation masks are collected on a central server. Such data aggregation raises privacy concerns in medical applications and requires substantial centralized computational resources. To address these limitations, we investigate the feasibility of federated learning for privacy-preserving skin lesion segmentation. The training and validation sets of the ISIC 2018 Skin Lesion Segmentation Challenge dataset are used to simulate a distributed learning environment and develop a federated segmentation model. The resulting model is evaluated on the ISIC 2018 test set and the PH2 dataset to assess its performance and generalizability. Experimental results demonstrate that the federated model achieves performance comparable to centralized training while consistently improving upon the locally trained models. These findings demonstrate the potential of federated learning for collaborative skin lesion segmentation without requiring centralized aggregation of medical images.

</details>


### [113] [LiDAR Resolution Recovery via Foundation-Model-Guided Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08620)
*Samed Doğan,Nico Leuze,Alfred Schöttl*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 以预训练Stable Diffusion为骨干，微调LiDAR条件深度模型并用2D基础模型伪深度监督；训练中随机抽稀LiDAR条件，在nuScenes上用物理保留真实光束评估不同光束预算下的恢复性能，极稀疏条件下优势最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高线束LiDAR成本高，但感知流水线常需密集角度采样；需探究能否仅凭少量光束恢复密集扫描，并量化恢复与分辨率之间的权衡。

Method: 以预训练Stable Diffusion模型为骨干，用2D基础模型的伪深度作目标，微调LiDAR条件深度模型；训练时对LiDAR条件按不同光束预算随机抽稀；在nuScenes上以物理上held-out的真实光束评估，并将恢复能力与拟合精度分开报告。

Result: 极稀疏区间优势最大：4光束输入下δ1.25精度达66.8%，而散点插值仅45.1%；类分层误差分析显示平面表面最先恢复，引入深度不连续的对象最早退化。

Conclusion: 结果量化了基础模型引导的LiDAR增强中恢复/分辨率权衡，表明该范式在超低线束场景下最具价值。

Abstract: High-beam-count LiDAR sensors are costly, yet many perception pipelines require dense angular sampling. Using a pretrained Stable Diffusion model as the backbone, we fine-tune a LiDAR-conditioned depth model with pseudo-depth targets from a 2D foundation model. During training, the LiDAR conditioning is randomly decimated at different beam budgets. We then investigate how much of a LiDAR scan can be recovered from heavily decimated input and characterize performance across the input beam budget. We evaluate against physically held-out real beams on nuScenes and report recovery separately from fit accuracy. Our model yields its largest advantage in very sparse regimes, achieving a $δ_{1.25}$ accuracy of $66.8$% from $4$-beam input where scattered interpolation reaches only $45.1$%. A class-stratified error breakdown further reveals that planar surfaces recover first while objects introducing depth discontinuities degrade earliest. Together, these results quantify the recovery/resolution trade-off for foundation-model-guided LiDAR enhancement.

</details>


### [114] [Forensic Reserve: Eliciting Latent Knowledge for Image Forgery Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08639)
*Jiahua Li,Zixu John,Tom Zhong,Fuping Wu,Tianhao Xu,Jianqing Zheng,Yuanhan Mo,Fei Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Reserve-Guided Elicitation (RGE)框架，将预训练模型内部稀疏的"取证储备"组件转化为结构约束，实现轻量级生成图像伪造检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成图像日益逼真，可靠伪造检测对维护视觉信息可信度至关重要。现有方法主要依赖任务特定监督来适配视觉基础模型表征，未能充分利用模型内部的取证知识来指导检测。

Method: 1) 用Forensic Lens (F-lens)将各层与token组的激活分解为独立组件，依据真实与生成图像的响应差异全局筛选出储备位点与方向；2) 将选定方向映射回隐状态空间构建固定储备子空间，仅在识别位点插入Forensic Reserve Adapters (FRA)；3) 冻结主干参数、参考分类器与子空间基，仅训练FRA系数图，产生约束于对应子空间的输入相关残差更新，强化已有取证响应。

Result: 仅用500张标注训练图像、可训练参数低于主干0.2%，在三个检测基准上无需目标基准适配即达到有竞争力性能；在涵盖自监督与视觉-语言预训练的八种编码器上均稳定优于对应的冻结检测器。

Conclusion: RGE揭示了预训练视觉模型中广泛共享的潜在取证能力，通过储备引导的轻量适配可有效激发该能力，实现高效、可泛化的伪造检测。

Abstract: As generated images become increasingly realistic, reliable forgery detection is essential for maintaining trust in visual information. However, existing methods primarily rely on task-specific supervision to adapt vision foundation model representations, without fully exploiting internal forensic knowledge to guide detection. To address this limitation, we propose Reserve-Guided Elicitation (RGE), a framework that treats sparse, origin-sensitive internal components in pretrained models as a forensic reserve and translates their localization into structural constraints for lightweight adaptation. Specifically, we first use the Forensic Lens (F-lens) to decompose activations across layers and token groups into independent components and globally screen them by their response differences between real and generated images, identifying reserve sites and directions. Next, we map the selected directions back to hidden-state space to construct fixed reserve subspaces and insert Forensic Reserve Adapters (FRA) only at the identified sites. Finally, with the backbone parameters, previously fitted reference classifier, and subspace bases fixed, we train only the FRA coefficient maps to generate input-dependent residual updates constrained to the corresponding subspaces, strengthening existing forensic responses. Using only 500 labeled training images and a trainable parameter budget below 0.2% of the backbone, RGE achieves competitive performance across three detection benchmarks without target-benchmark adaptation. Furthermore, RGE consistently improves over the corresponding frozen detectors across eight encoders spanning self-supervised and vision-language pretraining, eliciting a latent forensic capacity broadly shared across pretrained vision models.

</details>


### [115] [Stable Scores, Unstable Answers: Frame Phase and Option Order in Video Multiple-Choice Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08649)
*Lichen Zhu,Yiheng Wang,Yueqian Lin,Hai "Helen" Li,Yiran Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 视频-语言模型的评测依赖均匀抽帧网格，其参数仅报告采样率而忽略相位。相位偏移会显著改变答案却几乎不影响总分。PHASEFUSION 通过对三个相位偏移网格的选项后验取平均，在精度不降（预设裕度内）的前提下显著降低相位敏感性，并另行用单次推理的答案边际标记选项顺序干扰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频-语言模型基准只报告均匀网格的采样率，忽略了相位这一自由度，导致评测结果不可复现、不可比较：仅相差半步相位的两个采样器在得分几乎相同的情况下会对约四分之一的问题给出不同答案，说明当前报告方式掩盖了实质性的评测脆弱性。

Method: PHASEFUSION 将稠密网格视为多相分解，解码三个相位偏移的子网格，并对各子网格的选项后验进行平均融合；同时用单次推理得到的答案边际（answer margin）来单独标记仅由选项顺序改变引起的波动，从而将相位效应与选项顺序效应区分开。

Result: 在受控实验中，仅改变相位（控制选项顺序后）约每五个答案变动一个；半步相位偏移下两个采样器的答案差异率为 23.6%，但得分差异在一分以内。PHASEFUSION 在预设裕度内（logit 评分）匹配 32 帧单次推理的精度，并将三个网格整体半步偏移所改变的答案比例从 18.2% 降至 10.1%。

Conclusion: 视频基准应连同采样预算一起报告相位约定，或在评测中显式地对相位做边缘化处理；PHASEFUSION 提供了一种在不牺牲精度的前提下降低相位敏感性的方案。

Abstract: Video-language models are ranked by multiple-choice accuracy on frames from a uniform grid. The grid has two parameters, a rate and a phase, and benchmarks report only the rate. The phase moves answers: two deployed samplers differing only by a half-step phase offset answer 23.6% of questions differently while scoring within a point, and across four releases from two families shifting only the phase changes roughly one answer in five after controlling option order. PHASEFUSION decodes three offset grids and averages the option posteriors. The grids are the polyphase components of the dense grid. Fusion matches a 32-frame single pass in accuracy within a prespecified margin (logit-scored) and cuts the answers a half-step shift of all three grids changes from 18.2% to 10.1%. Option order, which changes only the presentation, is flagged instead by a one-pass answer margin. Report the phase convention with the budget, or marginalize it.

</details>


### [116] [Selective Transfer of RL Updates for Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08659)
*Suxin Ji,Hungtao Wan,Mingjun Liu,An Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 Selective-RL，将能力迁移定位于训练阶段更新（RL 引起的参数变化），而非端点差异，并通过保留主导矩阵方向实现更优的跨模型推理能力迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于端点的模型合并会把模型固有差异与推理后训练获得的改变混为一谈，难以准确刻画"能力迁移"的实质。作者希望从训练阶段视角，隔离强化学习（RL）带来的参数更新，从而更纯粹地研究跨模型能力迁移。

Method: 1) 以训练阶段更新（RL 诱导的参数变化）为迁移对象，取代端点式合并；2) 分析发现完整更新中不同成分的跨模型可迁移性差异显著，主导方向比完整更新更易迁移；3) 提出 Selective-RL：隔离 RL 阶段更新，保留其主导的矩阵级方向并保持原有幅度，将其迁移到 VLM 的语言模块。

Result: 在 3 个模型家族、5 个视觉推理基准上，Selective-RL 在 15 组比较中有 12 组优于完整更新插值，其中在 Qwen 接收模型上 MathVision 提升 8.55 个百分点。对照实验表明，仅靠更新幅度或任意低秩近似无法复现该增益。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了"后训练所获得的能力"与"可跨模型迁移的能力"之间的区别，为跨模型能力迁移提供了训练阶段视角的新框架，并开源了代码。

Abstract: Model merging provides a training-free way to transfer reasoning capabilities from language models to vision-language models (VLMs), but endpoint-based transfer can conflate pre-existing model differences with changes acquired during reasoning post-training. We instead formulate capability transfer around the training-stage update, isolating the parameter changes induced by reinforcement learning (RL). Yet transferring this update in full remains suboptimal: we find that its components differ substantially in cross-model transferability, with dominant directions transferring more effectively than the complete update. Based on this finding, we introduce Selective-RL, which isolates the RL-stage update, retains its dominant matrix-wise directions with magnitude preservation, and transfers them to the language modules of a VLM. Across three model families and five visual-reasoning benchmarks, Selective-RL improves full-update interpolation in 12 of 15 comparisons, including an 8.55 percentage-point MathVision gain on the Qwen recipient. Matched controls show that update magnitude or arbitrary low rank alone does not reproduce these gains. These results highlight a distinction between what is acquired during post-training and what remains transferable across models, providing a training-stage perspective on cross-model capability transfer. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/selective-rl.

</details>


### [117] [Knowing When to Trust a Prior: Reliability-Gated Cue Fusion for Video Gaze Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08663)
*Lichen Zhu,Yueqian Lin,Yiheng Wang,Hai "Helen" Li,Yiran Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 FocusGate，一种成员可弃权的无注视先验门控集成方法，通过逐帧门控在无监督/有监督视频注视预测中显著提升性能且开销极低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频注视预测主要由注视数据训练的模型主导，而无注视先验虽含未被这些模型吸收的信号，但在无差别融合时会在体育等域产生负面影响，因此需要判断何时信任先验。

Method: 提出 FocusGate：一种门控集成，成员可弃权。逐帧门控读取散焦图的三个形状统计量，选择估计器平均优于随机的帧；被拒帧精确退化为基线，midrank 归一化使全零先验在零参数下弃权。

Result: 门控融合在电影、体育和网页视频上显著为正，而无条件融合在体育上有害、网页上无效。加入四个有监督预测器（含 NTIRE 2026 冠军）后，在全部十六个模型-域组合的 shuffled AUC 上均有提升，十五个显著，仅增加冠军 1% 延迟。单独使用时，在电影域以 16 帧因果均值超越 TASED-Net 和 UNISAL。

Conclusion: 无注视先验在适当门控下可有效补充注视训练模型，实现跨域稳健提升且计算开销极小。

Abstract: Video gaze prediction is led by gaze-trained models, yet gaze-free priors carry signal those models have not absorbed, if one knows when to trust them. We propose FocusGate, a gated ensemble of gaze-free priors whose members may abstain. A per-frame gate reads three shape statistics of a defocus map and selects the frames on which the estimator is above chance on average, so rejected frames reduce to the base exactly, while midrank normalisation lets an all-zero prior abstain at zero parameters. Gated fusion is significantly positive on film, sports and web video, whereas unconditional fusion is harmful on sports and null on web. Added to four supervised predictors, the NTIRE 2026 champion among them, FocusGate improves all sixteen model-domain cells in shuffled AUC, fifteen significantly, one domain pre-registered and scored once, while adding only 1% to the champion's latency. Alone, it surpasses TASED-Net and UNISAL in shuffled AUC on film with a 16-frame causal mean.

</details>


### [118] [PDB: Point-Based Deformation Blending for Facial Animation Retargeting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08672)
*Sihun Cha,Hyeonseung Shin,Suah Yu,Junyong Noh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PDB（基于点的变形混合）方法实现跨网格的面部动画重定向，无需预定义笼或逐元素解码器，仅用自重建监督即支持跨身份迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨结构网格的面部表情重定向需在保持面部运动的同时避免表面伪影，现有方法多依赖预定义笼、预计算坐标或密集位移，易产生失真且泛化受限。

Method: PDB从源中性-表情对预测紧凑的变形控制点，从目标中性网格预测混合权重。权重对每个目标仅计算一次并跨帧复用，控制点随源表情变化；用ReLU保证权重非负并允许精确零值，再行归一化。目标网格由权重与控制点相乘直接重建，无预定义笼、预计算坐标、逐元素变形解码器或全局重建求解。仅用自重建监督训练。

Result: 实验显示重定向准确、推理快速，学到的权重具局部支撑；在表情准确度与局部表面保持的联合评估中，较所评估的密集位移方法减少表面伪影并保留预期运动；感知评估在自重建与跨身份重定向中均支持表情保真与视觉质量。

Conclusion: PDB以点基变形混合实现简洁高效的跨网格面部重定向，避免复杂依赖与配对跨身份训练，兼顾运动保真与表面质量，具备良好实用性与泛化性。

Abstract: Mesh-agnostic facial animation retargeting transfers expressions across meshes with different structures, but preserving facial motion without surface artifacts remains challenging. To address this, we present PDB, Point-Based Deformation Blending for facial animation retargeting. PDB predicts a compact set of deformed control points from a source neutral-expression pair and blending weights from the target neutral mesh. The weights are computed once per target and reused across frames, while the control points vary with each source expression. ReLU enforces non-negative weights and permits exact zeros, followed by row-wise normalization. The target mesh is reconstructed directly by multiplying the weights and control points, without a predefined cage, precomputed coordinates, a learned per-element deformation decoder, or a global reconstruction solve. Trained only with self-retargeting reconstruction supervision, PDB supports cross-identity transfer without paired cross-identity training expressions. Experiments demonstrate accurate retargeting, fast inference, and localized support in the learned weights. Joint evaluation of expression accuracy and local surface preservation shows reduced surface artifacts relative to the evaluated dense displacement method while retaining the intended motion. Perceptual evaluations further support expression fidelity and visual quality in both self- and cross-retargeting.

</details>


### [119] [EC-RAG: Event Chain Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Long Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08674)
*Yuhao Qin,Junbo Wang,Yuke Li,Yining Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 EC-RAG，一种免训练的事件链检索增强生成框架，将长视频组织为显式事件链以支持问答，在 Video-MME、MLVU、LongVideoBench 上优于帧级检索基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大型视频语言模型处理长视频时多独立处理帧，难以捕捉跨事件的时序依赖；已有检索增强方法多在帧或片段层面操作，无法有效建模事件的演化与相互关系。

Method: EC-RAG 首先将视频切分为语义连贯的片段，用多模态信号（语音、文本、视觉）表示每个片段，再按时间顺序链接为结构化事件链并保留事件间关系；给定查询后，在事件链中定位相关事件并聚合对应模态的支持证据。整体为免训练、即插即用框架，无需额外训练或依赖闭源模型。

Result: 在 Video-MME、MLVU 与 LongVideoBench 上，该事件中心设计持续优于帧级检索基线。

Conclusion: 以事件为中心的抽象、结构化多模态融合与即插即用兼容性使 EC-RAG 有效提升长视频理解，凸显了时序结构建模的重要性。

Abstract: Current large video-language models (LVLMs) still face challenges when dealing with long videos, mainly because frames are often processed independently, making it difficult to capture temporal dependencies across events. Although retrieval-augmented approaches have been introduced to provide additional context, most of them operate at the frame or snippet level, which limits their ability to model how events evolve over time and relate to each other. In this paper, we propose Event Chain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (EC-RAG), a training-free framework that organizes video content into an explicit event chain before question answering. Instead of retrieving isolated frames or text segments, EC-RAG first partitions the video into semantically coherent segments, represents each segment using multi-modal signals, and then links them into a structured chain that preserves temporal order and captures inter-event relationships. Given a query, the system identifies relevant events within this chain and gathers supporting evidence from the associated modalities. Our approach offers several practical advantages: (i) event-level abstraction that better reflects how video content is naturally structured, enabling more reliable localization compared to frame-level retrieval; (ii) structured multi-modal fusion that aggregates speech, text, and visual cues at the event level, allowing complementary information to be more effectively utilized during reasoning; and (iii) plug-and-play compatibility with existing LVLM backbones, requiring no additional training or reliance on proprietary models. Experiments on Video-MME, MLVU, and LongVideoBench show that this event-centric design consistently outperforms frame-level retrieval baselines, highlighting the importance of modeling temporal structure for long-video understanding.

</details>


### [120] [RenderBench: Benchmarking Render-to-Real Video Transfer with Reconstructed Digital Twins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08684)
*Dicong Qiu,Zhiyuan Xu,Yaosheng Liu,Feng Han,Bo Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出RenderBench，一个包含12个重建真实场景（涵盖大规模室内环境与第一视角，含静态和动态设置）的基准，用于评估从代理渲染到真实视频的生成能力，并提供配对真实视频与可编辑数字孪生。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估"渲染到真实"（render-to-real）能力需要真实目标视频（展示相同场景演化）以及配准的可编辑3D副本作为配对数据，但这类数据传统上需要大量人工建模、标定和动画制作，成本高昂且获取困难，因此缺乏标准化评估基准。

Method: 构建流程融合视觉几何、神经重建与辅助3D创作：将每个场景分解为静态物体与动态主体，配准到拍摄相机，并仅在通过多视角几何与时序验证后才被接受。每个评估单元包含外观参考图、留出的真实目标视频、可编辑数字孪生、匹配的代理渲染以及渲染器原生场景标注。

Result: 首个版本保留14个配准样本中的12个（85.7%），包含1,496个真实-代理配对帧。所有发布场景通过文件完整性与环境编辑审计；代理诊断得到深度si-RMSE为0.2170，实例mIoU为0.3673。评估时对照配对真实目标视频，并保留PAI-Bench-C兼容的结构投影，利用场景标注按物体、可见性、关节和运动对失败进行定位。

Conclusion: RenderBench提供了配对真实观测与可编辑场景状态，可用于同时评估外观保真度以及几何与动态的保持能力。

Abstract: Modern video models can generate realistic videos from real appearance references and proxy renders that specify scene structure, viewpoint changes, and motion. Evaluating this render-to-real capability requires a real target video depicting the same scene evolution, paired with an editable, geometrically registered 3D replica. Such data has traditionally required substantial manual modeling, calibration, and animation effort. We introduce RenderBench, a benchmark of 12 reconstructed real-world scenes spanning large-scale indoor environments and egocentric viewpoints, with both static and dynamic settings. Our construction pipeline combines visual geometry, neural reconstruction, and assisted 3D authoring. Each scene is decomposed into static objects and dynamic actors, registered to the capture cameras, and accepted only after multi-view geometric and temporal validation. Each evaluation unit contains appearance reference images, a held-out real target video, an editable digital twin, a matched proxy render, and renderer-native scene annotations. We evaluate transfer models against paired real target videos, retain PAI-Bench-C-compatible structural projections, and use scene annotations to localize failures by object, visibility, articulation, and motion. The first release retains 12 of 14 registered samples (85.7%), comprising 1,496 paired real-proxy frames. All released scenes pass file-integrity and environment-edit audits, while proxy diagnostics yield a depth si-RMSE of 0.2170 and instance mIoU of 0.3673. RenderBench provides paired real observations and editable scene state for assessing both appearance fidelity and preservation of geometry and dynamics.

</details>


### [121] [SpaTime: Streaming Vision-Language Models for Spatio-temporal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08713)
*Hairong Yin,Huangying Zhan,Shin-Fang Chng,Yi Xu,Raymond A. Yeh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SpaTime，一种将因果几何token逐帧融合进语言模型的流式VLM，并设计响应时间损失监督何时作答；在自建流式基准上达到49.2%总体准确率，响应时间误差较最强流式基线降低66%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身智能体需在视频仍到达时进行3D空间推理，并在观察足够后尽快作答。现有引入3D几何先验的VLM虽空间推理强，但只能离线运行（需完整视频）；流式VLM可因果处理帧并自主决定何时响应，却缺乏显式3D表示。因此需兼顾流式因果性与3D几何推理。

Method: SpaTime在每一帧将因果几何token融合进语言模型，仅使用迄今观察到的帧。为监督作答时机，提出响应时间损失：将逐帧响应概率映射为可微的期望响应时间，并惩罚其与真值帧的距离。评估方面构建StreamVSTI-Bench与StreamVSI-Bench，作为VSTI-Bench与VSI-Bench的流式改编。

Result: 在StreamVSTI-Bench上，SpaTime总体准确率达49.2%，平均响应时间误差较最强流式基线降低66%。

Conclusion: SpaTime通过逐帧融合因果几何token并引入可微响应时间损失，使流式VLM在保持因果在线处理的同时具备3D空间推理能力，并显著改善作答时机控制，验证了流式3D空间推理的可行性。

Abstract: Embodied agents must reason about 3D space while the video is still arriving, answering questions as soon as they have observed enough of the scene. VLMs that incorporate 3D geometric priors achieve strong spatial reasoning, but they operate offline, i.e., the full video must be available before they produce an answer. Streaming VLMs process frames causally and decide for themselves when to respond, yet they lack explicit 3D representations. We present SpaTime, a streaming VLM that fuses causal geometry tokens into the language model at every frame, using only the frames observed so far. To supervise when the model answers, we propose a response-time loss that maps per-frame response probabilities to a differentiable expected response time and penalizes the distance from the ground-truth frame. For evaluation, we construct StreamVSTI-Bench and StreamVSI-Bench, streaming adaptations of VSTI-Bench and VSI-Bench. On StreamVSTI-Bench, SpaTime reaches 49.2% overall accuracy and reduces the mean response-time error by 66% relative to the strongest streaming baseline.

</details>


### [122] [Co-Evolving Paths and Flows via Path-Flow Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08717)
*Zeyu Michael Li,William Xingxu Chen,Xiang Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文将路径-流对齐作为流匹配的统一训练目标，联合训练端点保持的路径网络与流网络，诊断出"路径过拟合"失效模式（对齐损失下降但样本质量变差），并发现其与概率路径中的低熵瓶颈相关，提出随机路径正则化（对路径网络隐藏部分源信息、保持端点精确）以设置熵下限、抑制瓶颈，在ImageNet-256×256上稳定提升FID。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统流匹配固定插值路径、仅学习速度场，路径本身并非最优；虽然任意学习到的固定路径都定义合法的流匹配目标，但单独用对齐损失指导路径学习并不可靠，会陷入路径过拟合：对齐损失降低而生成质量反而下降。作者希望找到该失效模式的成因并加以解决，使联合路径-流训练真正有效。

Method: 提出统一的路径-流对齐训练目标：用同一对齐损失联合训练路径网络与流网络——流网络匹配路径速度，路径网络将自己的速度对齐到当前流网络，且路径保持精确端点。诊断表明路径过拟合与诱导概率路径中的低熵瓶颈有关，即学习到的路径使样本经过过度集中的中间边缘分布。为此引入随机路径正则化：在保持端点精确的前提下，对路径网络隐藏一部分源信息，从而为随机训练路径的边缘分布提供显式熵下限，抑制学习采样器中的瓶颈。方法不改变推理时架构与采样器。

Result: 在ImageNet-256×256、SiT骨干网络上，该方法在不同模型规模下持续提升FID，可扩展到model-guidance训练，且推理阶段架构与采样器保持不变。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 对齐损失本身不足以作为路径学习的可靠准则；低熵瓶颈是路径过拟合的关键成因，通过随机路径正则化引入熵下限可有效抑制瓶颈，使联合路径-流训练切实可行，并在生成质量上带来稳定且可扩展的提升。

Abstract: We study path-flow alignment as a unified training objective for flow matching. Instead of fixing the interpolation path and learning only the velocity field, we jointly train an endpoint-preserving path network and a flow network using the same alignment loss: the flow learns to match the path velocity, and the path learns to align its velocity to the current flow. Although every fixed learned path defines a valid flow-matching objective, the alignment loss alone is not a reliable criterion for path learning. We identify path overfitting, a failure mode in which the alignment loss decreases while sample quality worsens. We find that this failure is associated with low-entropy bottlenecks in the induced probability path, where the learned path routes samples through overly concentrated intermediate marginals. Motivated by this diagnosis, we introduce a stochastic path regularizer that hides part of the source information from the path network while preserving exact endpoints. The resulting regularization gives an explicit entropy floor for the stochastic training-path marginals and empirically suppresses the bottleneck in the learned sampler, making joint path-flow training effective. On ImageNet-256x256 with SiT backbones, our method consistently improves FID across model scales, extends to model-guidance training, and leaves the inference-time architecture and sampler unchanged. Code is available at https://github.com/lizeyu090312/traj_opt_paper

</details>


### [123] [Post-Training Semantic Lifting for 3D Gaussian Splatting: Separating Detector, Lifting and Representation Error](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08756)
*Iván Verdugo Guerra,Ezequiel López Rubio,Jorge García González*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种后训练提升方法，将多视角检测证据按高斯可见性加权累积，并用双阈值过滤3D高斯，实现从2D检测器到网格语义标注的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同一3D高斯在多视角下类别判断不一致，且部分视角存在遮挡、检测置信度差异；同时真值以带标注的网格给出，因为两次训练产生的高斯不一致。

Method: 逐目标类别进行后训练提升：按每个高斯在各视角中的可见性加权，同时累积目标与非目标证据；随后用双阈值过滤高斯，主阈值β选高置信种子，较低阈值γβ补充其周围连通分量；评估时将标签从高斯转移到既可见又有标注的网格顶点。

Result: 在七个Replica验证场景上确定阈值与转移算子，在十个留出的ScanNet++场景上固定参数评估：验证集mIoU在数据集掩码下为0.93、YOLO掩码下为0.65；ScanNet++测试集为0.80与0.54。相比逐视角证据阈值化，测试mIoU提升0.24，并可对两个数据集的全部类别和场景使用单一阈值。

Conclusion: 该方法能分离2D检测器、提升过程与表示转移三类误差来源；误差分析表明剩余误差主要来自检测器。

Abstract: The same Gaussian of a 3D Gaussian Splatting model is seen from many views, and these views do not always agree on the class it belongs to. The Gaussian may be occluded in some of them, and the confidence of the detector is not the same from one view to another. The ground truth, on the other hand, is given as an annotated mesh, because two training runs do not produce the same Gaussians. In this work, we propose a post-training lifting method that works with one target class at a time and combines the information coming from all the views. Target and non-target evidence are accumulated simultaneously, weighted by the visibility of each Gaussian in each view. After that, the Gaussians are filtered with two thresholds: a main threshold $β$ selects the high-confidence seeds, and a lower one $γβ$ adds the connected components around them. For the evaluation, the labels are transferred from the Gaussians to the mesh vertices that are both visible and annotated. With this design, we can separate three sources of error: the 2D detector, the lifting and the transfer between representations. The thresholds and the transfer operator are chosen on seven Replica validation scenes, and the method is evaluated on ten held-out ScanNet++ scenes with the same values for every scene and class. The mean mIoU on the validation scenes was 0.93 with masks from the dataset annotations and 0.65 with YOLO masks, and on the ScanNet++ test scenes it was 0.80 and 0.54. Compared with thresholding the evidence per view, as a previous version of the method did, the fraction improves the test mIoU by 0.24 and makes it possible to use a single threshold for all the classes and scenes of both datasets. Finally, the error analysis shows that most of the remaining error comes from the detector.

</details>


### [124] [Data Leakage in Patch-Based Hyperspectral Image Classification: Quantifying the Impact of Spatial Overlap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08770)
*Mohammed Q. Alkhatib*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究基于块的HSI分类中同类训练-测试空间重叠导致的数据泄漏问题，提出重叠百分比(OP)和平均重叠率(AOR)两种度量，并在Pavia University数据集上对比随机与非随机空间采样下SVM、MLP、2D-CNN、3D-CNN、ViT和MorpMamba的表现，证明随机采样会显著高估分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于块的学习通过利用局部光谱-空间信息提升了HSI分类性能，但从同一图像中随机划分训练-测试样本会导致空间块重叠，引发数据泄漏和过于乐观的性能估计。

Method: 提出两种同类训练-测试空间重叠度量：重叠百分比(OP)量化全局被重叠的测试块像素量，平均重叠率(AOR)衡量受影响测试块的局部重叠严重程度；在Pavia University数据集上，使用SVM、MLP、2D-CNN、3D-CNN、ViT和MorpMamba，比较随机与非随机空间采样，并进行块尺寸分析。

Result: 随机采样下深度块模型精度较高，3D-CNN的OA达96.17%；非随机空间采样下性能大幅下降，3D-CNN降至55.20%，ViT和2D-CNN分别下降40.71和38.81个百分点。块尺寸从5x5增至19x19时，随机采样的重叠百分比从23.28%升至77.02%。

Conclusion: 随机块划分评估会显著夸大分类性能，尤其对强烈利用空间上下文的模型影响更大；HSI分类研究应采用非随机空间采样以获得可靠评估。代码已开源。

Abstract: Patch-based learning improves hyperspectral image (HSI) classification by exploiting local spectral-spatial information, but random train-test sampling from the same image can cause spatial patch overlap, leading to data leakage and optimistic performance estimates. This paper investigates same-class train-test spatial overlap in patch-based HSI classification using two measures: overlap percentage (OP), which quantifies the global amount of overlapped testing patch pixels, and average overlap ratio (AOR), which measures the local severity among affected testing patches. Experiments on the Pavia University dataset compare random and non-random spatial sampling using SVM, MLP, 2D-CNN, 3D-CNN, ViT, and MorpMamba. The results show that deep patch-based models achieve high accuracy under random sampling, with 3D-CNN reaching 96.17% Overall Accuracy (OA), but drop substantially under non-random spatial sampling, where 3D-CNN decreases to 55.20% and ViT and 2D-CNN drop by 40.71 and 38.81 percentage points (PP), respectively. Patch-size analysis further shows that increasing the patch size from 5x5 to 19x19 raises the random-sampling overlap percentage from 23.28% to 77.02%. These findings demonstrate that random patch-based evaluation can substantially inflate classification performance, especially for models that strongly exploit spatial context. The code associated with this paper is available at: https://github.com/mqalkhatib/Data_Leakage_in_HSI_Classification.

</details>


### [125] [Backend-Agnostic Sparse Attention for Fast High-Resolution Visual Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08772)
*Liao Ma,Jiayi Song,Yunfeng Wu,Songhua Liu,Peilin Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出后端无关的稀疏注意力BASA，通过跨DiT块的移位局部窗口注意力实现全局信息交换，无需定制内核即可兼顾视觉质量与实际加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散Transformer在高分辨率生成中因全注意力二次复杂度而计算昂贵。窗口注意力虽高效，但存在权衡：分区窗口注意力虽计算高效却阻断跨窗口交互，产生明显网格伪影；细粒度滑窗注意力虽恢复交互、提升质量，却因不规则计算导致理论与实际加速差距大，且需针对每种硬件后端定制内核。

Method: BASA用移位的局部窗口注意力替换视觉自注意力。通过在DiT块间引入结构化的窗口移位方案，使某层被窗口边界分隔的token能在后续层中通信，从而实现全局信息交换并消除窗口伪影；不引入额外不规则算子或定制内核。

Result: 实验表明，BASA在FLUX上实测加速超过理论估计的90%，在Wan上取得4.52倍注意力加速，同时保持具有竞争力的生成质量。

Conclusion: BASA兼具视觉质量与实际加速，可直接部署于现有注意力后端，缩小理论稀疏性与实际加速之间的差距，是一种后端无关的高效稀疏注意力方案。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved strong performance in image and video generation, but the quadratic complexity of full attention makes high-resolution generation computationally expensive. Window attention offers an efficient alternative, yet existing methods face a practical trade-off: partitioned window attention typically achieves computational efficiency consistent with its theoretical complexity. However, isolated windows block cross-window interaction, often introducing visible grid-like artifacts in the generated results. Fine-grained sliding-window attention effectively restores interactions across neighboring windows and improves visual quality. However, its irregular computation patterns create a substantial gap between theoretical and practical speedups and require specialized kernels tailored to each hardware backend. To tackle these challenges, we propose BASA, a backend-agnostic sparse attention, which brings the best of both worlds: visual quality and practical acceleration. Specifically, BASA replaces visual self-attention with shifted local-window attention.
