By introducing a structured window-shifting scheme across DiT blocks, we allow tokens divided by window boundaries in one layer to communicate in the following layers, thereby achieving global information exchange and eliminating window-induced visual artifacts. Notably, our design introduces no additional irregular operators or customized kernels, making it readily deployable on existing attention backends and closing the gap between theoretical sparsity and practical acceleration. Experiments demonstrate that BASA achieves measured speedups exceeding 90\% of the theoretical estimates on FLUX and delivers a 4.52$\times$ attention speedup on Wan while maintaining competitive generation quality.

</details>


### [126] [CtrlCache: Accelerating Interactive Video World Models with Control-Aware Caching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08777)
*Shangye Song,Dong Gong,Hong Jia,Yun Sing Koh,Xinyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出训练免控感知缓存框架CtrlCache，利用分块控制信号对去噪计算进行调度，在Matrix-Game 2.0与LingBot-World v1/v2上实现1.21x–1.41x DiT主干预加速，同时提升WBench综合分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式视频世界模型需高效生成视频块并忠实响应用户控制。现有系统采用分块自回归生成配合少步去噪，但每块仍需多次昂贵去噪迭代；免训练缓存虽可降本，却主要依赖模型内部去噪动态、未显式考虑控制切换。而控制信号在块去噪前已到达，可零前向开销获得调度依据。

Method: 分析不同控制机制下相邻块：动作切换处结构相似度下降，低频结构比高频细节更持久。据此设计CtrlCache：1）动作感知调度与刷新策略，跨块及块内检测动作变化，将块标记为initial、transition、turning、steady四态；在选定内部去噪步，initial与transition块保留完整计算，turning与steady块复用同块内最近一次全计算步的Transformer残差；2）频率混合历史先验引导，利用前序干净潜变量补充低频信息，且不增加DiT前向。

Result: 在Matrix-Game 2.0、LingBot-World v1/v2上评估，无需模型重训即取得1.21x–1.41x的DiT主干预加速，并在三款模型上均优于原始推理的WBench综合分数。

Conclusion: 显式利用块级控制信号可构建零额外前向的缓存调度，实现交互式视频世界模型的速度—质量双赢。

Abstract: Interactive video world models need to generate each video chunk efficiently while responding faithfully to user controls. Many systems use chunk-wise autoregressive generation with few-step denoising, but each chunk still requires several costly denoising iterations. Training-free caching can reduce this cost, yet existing policies make reuse decisions primarily from model-internal denoising dynamics and do not explicitly account for control transitions. Actually, interactive generation explicitly exposes a signal they do not use: the controls for a chunk arrive before it is denoised, so a schedule derived from them costs no forward pass. To this end, we analyze adjacent chunks under different control regimes and find that structural similarity drops around action changes, while low-frequency structure remains more persistent than high-frequency detail. Motivated by these observations, we propose CtrlCache, a training-free control-aware caching framework that adapts computation to the current control sequence. Specifically, the action-aware scheduling and refresh policy detects action changes across and within chunks, and labels each chunk as initial, transition, turning, or steady state. At one selected interior denoising step, initial and transition chunks retain full computation, while turning and steady chunks reuse the transformer residual from the most recent fully computed step in the same chunk. To exploit the persistence of low-frequency structure during steady interaction, we further introduce a frequency-mixed history prior guidance that incorporates complementary information from the preceding clean latent without an additional DiT forward pass. Evaluated on Matrix-Game 2.0 and LingBot-World v1/v2, CtrlCache achieves 1.21x to 1.41x DiT-backbone speedups without model retraining while improving WBench Overall scores over original inference across all three models.

</details>


### [127] [ALIVE: Interaction-Aligned Object Insertion for First-Frame-Guided Video Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08779)
*Zhenghong Zhou,Zhe Lin,Jiebo Luo,Yuqian Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 ALIVE 框架，通过编辑首帧与仅命名插入对象的指令，使插入对象与源视频内容产生连贯交互（如被拿起、被操作），并通过 VLM 预测交互引导提升效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频编辑工具能插入对象，但难以让插入对象参与交互（如被拿起或操作）。作者希望让插入的对象"活"起来，与源视频内容产生一致的交互行为，同时保持对源视频内容的保真。

Method: 1) 构建 35,800 组编辑对，结合 3D 渲染、模型生成、真实世界视频以及 ROSE 的通用编辑对；每组仅在目标对象是否存在上不同，同时保留周围动作，以学习协调的对象行为与源内容保持。2) 训练一个视觉-语言模型（VLM），从相同输入预测交互引导。3) 提出 ALIVE-interaction 基准，用统一的 VLM 协议评估交互动保真度、源内容保持和视觉连贯性，并在通用视频对象插入基准上评测。

Result: 在无 VLM 引导时，ALIVE 在两个基准上的 Overall 分别比最强评测基线提升 43.9% 和 4.4%。引入 VLM 预测的引导后，在无需额外用户输入的情况下，ALIVE-interaction 分数再提升 0.95 分。

Conclusion: 通过数据构造与 VLM 交互引导，ALIVE 有效实现了插入对象与源视频连贯交互，并在交互保真、源保持和视觉连贯性上显著优于基线。

Abstract: Current video editors can insert objects but often struggle to make them participate in interactions such as being picked up or manipulated. We introduce ALIVE, a framework that makes inserted objects "alive" through coherent interactions with the source video's contents, using an edited first frame and an instruction naming only the added object. We curate 35,800 editing pairs combining 3D-rendered, model-generated, and real-world videos with general editing pairs from ROSE. Each pair differs in the target object's presence while preserving the surrounding action, teaching editors coordinated object behavior and source preservation. We further train a vision-language model (VLM) to predict interaction guidance from the same inputs. We introduce the ALIVE-interaction benchmark to assess interaction fidelity, source preservation, and visual coherence using a unified VLM-based protocol, and evaluate on the general video object insertion benchmark. Without VLM guidance, ALIVE improves Overall over the strongest evaluated baseline by 43.9% and 4.4% on the two benchmarks, respectively. VLM-predicted guidance further improves the ALIVE-interaction score by 0.95 points without additional user inputs.

</details>


### [128] [4D-HOF: Hand-Object Flow Matching for Feed-Forward 4D Interaction Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08782)
*Shiqi Li,Sean Cho,Yijie Li,Fengzhi Guo,Bowen Wen,Cheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 4D-HOF 是一个前馈式 4D 手-物交互重建框架，利用条件流匹配模型将视觉基础模型给出的粗糙手-物状态传输至交互流形，并在传输过程中引入测试时引导以融合物理约束与 2D 观测证据，从而在域外基准上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 4D 手-物重建方法存在两方面局限：一是依赖逐序列优化，计算成本高昂；二是生成式方法多从随机噪声出发合成交互，导致交互预测不稳定。因此需要一种既能前馈推理、又能稳定修正交互状态并支持约束融合的重建方案。

Method: 提出 4D-HOF：以视觉基础模型产生的粗糙但具信息量的手-物状态为条件，学习条件流匹配模型，将初始状态传输至交互流形，前馈式地纠正平移、旋转与对齐误差。其生成式建模使测试时引导内嵌于传输过程，直接以物理交互约束与观测到的 2D 证据引导演化中的生成状态，将重建优化融入生成过程而非事后后处理。并在多样数据集上训练以提升泛化性。

Result: 在域外（out-of-domain）基准上，4D-HOF 达到 state-of-the-art 性能，能够生成更稳定、更准确的 4D 手-物重建；同时保持前馈推理，避免逐序列优化开销，并展现出对复杂野外场景的稳健泛化能力。

Conclusion: 4D-HOF 通过条件流匹配与测试时引导的统一生成框架，将基础模型先验、物理约束与 2D 证据整合进重建过程，兼顾了前馈效率与重建稳定性、准确性，为 4D 手-物交互重建提供了有效且可泛化的新范式。

Abstract: Existing methods for 4D hand-object reconstruction often rely on costly per-sequence optimization, while generative approaches typically synthesize interactions from random noise, which can lead to unstable interaction prediction. We introduce 4D-HOF, a feed-forward framework that reconstructs 4D hand-object interactions from coarse but informative estimates produced by vision foundation models. Concretely, we learn a conditional flow matching model that transports foundation-model-derived hand-object states toward an interaction manifold, allowing the model to correct errors in translation, rotation, and alignment in a feed-forward manner. A key advantage of our generative formulation is that it naturally enables test-time guidance within the transport process. Rather than applying a separate post-hoc optimization after reconstruction, we directly steer the evolving generative states using physical interaction constraints and observed 2D evidence, allowing the reconstruction to be refined as part of the generative process itself. By training the generative model on diverse datasets, 4D-HOF generalizes robustly to challenging in-the-wild scenarios. Experiments on out-of-domain benchmarks show that 4D-HOF achieves state-of-the-art performance, producing more stable and accurate 4D hand-object reconstructions.

</details>


### [129] [Building Rome from a Single Image](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08790)
*Jiraphon Yenphraphai,Fang Li,Tianshuo Xu,Depu Meng,Quentin Herau,Yihan Hu,Raymond A. Yeh,Wei Zhan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种将物体中心的3D生成器（如Trellis 2）改造成适用于室内外单图场景生成的方法，核心包括自适应分块、显式2D-3D对应建模与合成户外数据扩充，在多个数据集上几何精度与感知质量均优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单图场景生成需要从单张图像重建包括未观测区域在内的完整3D场景网格。现有预训练3D物体生成器虽具备强形状先验，但主要针对固定规范体积内的独立物体，且因户外3D数据稀缺而多局限于室内场景，难以直接用于户外场景。

Method: 方法包含三部分：(a) 将场景划分为随相机距离缩放的自适应分块，近处分块尺寸更小以保留细节，远处结构（如建筑）用大分块覆盖；(b) 通过提升图像特征并让模型感知自由空间、已观测表面与未观测区域，使生成器捕获显式2D-3D对应关系；(c) 合成约4,000个户外场景，扩充以室内为主的现有场景数据集。

Result: 在Tanks and Temples、ScanNet++及真实（in-the-wild）图像上的实验表明，该方法在室内外场景的几何精度和感知质量上均优于所有基线。

Conclusion: 通过自适应分块、显式2D-3D对应建模与户外数据合成，可将物体中心的预训练3D生成器有效重设计为室内外通用的单图场景生成器，并保持其原有形状先验。

Abstract: Single-image scene generation aims to produce a complete 3D scene mesh from a single image, including surfaces the camera did not observe. While pretrained 3D object generators encode a strong shape prior, they are mainly designed for isolated objects in a fixed canonical volume and focus mostly on indoor scenes, since diverse 3D data for outdoor scenes are quite limited. In this work, we present a method that redesigns such an object-centric generator, e.g., Trellis 2, to work on both indoor and outdoor scenes while retaining its prior. We accomplish this by (a) partitioning the scene into adaptive chunks that scale relative to the distance to the camera; nearby chunks have a smaller size to keep the finer detail, while distant structures, e.g., buildings, are covered by large chunks; (b) making the generator capture explicit 2D-3D correspondence by lifting image features and making the model aware of the free space, observed surface, and unobserved region; (c) synthesizing around 4,000 outdoor scenes to broaden the training data, as existing scene datasets are largely indoor. Experiments on Tanks and Temples, ScanNet++, and in-the-wild images show that our method outperforms all baselines in geometric accuracy and perceptual quality across both indoor and outdoor scenes.

</details>


### [130] [World Models' Last Exam in Physics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08791)
*Mingju Gao,Qingle Liu,Yuzhao Peng,Xinjie Lin,Ziming Qin,Zheng Jiang,Wenyi Li,Calvin Xiao,Youjie Zheng,Kaisen Yang,Qinhuai Na*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"世界模型物理期末考试"（World Models' Last Exam in Physics）基准，用40项受控任务与基于测量的评估器检验视频世界模型的物理一致性，8个模型1280段视频中最佳仅得57.76分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频世界模型能生成视觉逼真但物理上不一致的序列，影响其在具身智能预测与规划中的可靠性；现有评估多依赖模型判断或参考视频，直接物理测试又局限于力学。

Method: 构建含40个受控任务的基准，覆盖力学、光学、流体、热学与相变、电磁学、表面张力；每任务由初始图像+生成提示+预定义物理判据组成，无需参考视频即可进行可解释测试；评估器结合任务可观测性筛选与任务特定定量物理测量。

Result: 在8个视频生成模型的1280段视频上实验，发现持续存在的物理不一致且任务间差异显著，最佳模型总分57.76/100；用物理关系已知的合成视频验证测量模块有效性；评估器在任务内排序与成对比较中与人类判断的一致性均优于直接使用视觉语言模型的基线。

Conclusion: 该基准兼具物理域覆盖、可测量证据支撑的评分与明确的测量局限说明，为诊断物理不一致、追踪视频世界模型物理一致性进展提供了可解释依据。

Abstract: Video world models can produce visually convincing yet physically inconsistent sequences, raising concerns about their reliability for prediction and planning in embodied AI systems. Existing evaluations often rely on model-based judgments or reference videos, while direct physical tests largely focus on mechanics. We introduce World Models' Last Exam in Physics, a measurement-based benchmark for evaluating physical consistency in video world models. The benchmark comprises 40 controlled tasks spanning mechanics, optics, fluids, thermal and phase-change phenomena, electromagnetism, and surface tension. Each task pairs an initial image and a generation prompt with predefined physical criteria, enabling interpretable tests of observable physical relationships without requiring reference videos. Its evaluator combines task-observability screening with task-specific quantitative physical measurements. Experiments on eight video generation models across 1,280 videos reveal persistent physical inconsistencies and substantial variation across tasks, with the best model achieving an overall score of 57.76 out of 100. Evaluation on synthetic videos with known physical relationships provides evidence for the validity of the measurement module under controlled conditions. The evaluator also achieves higher agreement with human judgments than a direct vision-language model baseline in both within-task rankings and pairwise comparisons. By combining coverage across physical domains with scores grounded in measurable evidence and explicit measurement limitations, the benchmark provides an interpretable basis for diagnosing physical inconsistencies and tracking progress toward physically consistent video world models.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [131] [Generalizable Robustness Testing of DNN-Based Robotic Navigation Systems via XAI-Guided Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06862)
*Khizra Sohail,Miren Illarramendi,Aitor Arrieta*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种可解释性引导的多目标进化方法，通过视觉与行为聚类选取代表性图像并生成稀疏扰动，用于DNN控制CPS的鲁棒性测试，并在Gazebo仿真与实体LeoRover上验证了仿真到现实的可迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DNN日益广泛地控制CPS，微小输入扰动即可引发系统级不安全行为；但现有方法多针对单张图像优化扰动且仅在仿真中评估，导致泛化性不足、实际有效性受限。

Method: 提出可解释性引导的多目标进化方法：先通过视觉与行为聚类选取代表性图像，再基于聚合Integrated Gradients引导变异，生成稀疏扰动；在Gazebo中针对DNN控制的LeoRover评估，开展消融实验，并在实体机器人上验证分层子集扰动。

Result: 中位成功率70.0%，优于无引导搜索的53.85%；中位超体积由0.65提升至0.73。多图像优化将成功率由50.0%提升至57.5%，XAI引导进一步提升至70.0%。仿真到现实评估中，仿真精度0.95、召回0.67，仿真与实体失效时间呈显著正相关（0.617）。

Conclusion: 多图像优化结合可解释性引导搜索可有效提升DNN控制机器人系统的鲁棒性测试效果；仿真能有效识别并优先排序可迁移失效，但仍需物理验证，因为部分真实失效无法在仿真中复现。

Abstract: **Context:** Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) increasingly control Cyber-Physical Systems (CPSs), yet small input perturbations can cause unsafe system-level behavior. Existing approaches often optimize perturbations for individual images and evaluate them only in simulation, limiting their generalizability and practical validity.
  **Objectives:** This work aims to generate robustness tests that remain effective across operational observations and to evaluate whether the resulting failures transfer from simulation to a physical robot.
  **Methods:** We propose an explainability-guided multi-objective evolutionary approach that generates sparse perturbations over representative images selected through visual and behavioral clustering. Aggregated Integrated Gradients guide mutations toward influential image regions. We evaluate the approach on a DNN-controlled LeoRover in Gazebo, conduct an ablation study, and validate a stratified subset of perturbations on the physical robot.
  **Results:** The approach achieved a median success rate of 70.0%, compared with 53.85% for unguided search, and increased median hypervolume from 0.65 to 0.73. Multi-image optimization improved the success rate from 50.0% to 57.5%, while XAI guidance further increased it to 70.0%. In the sim-to-real evaluation, simulation achieved 0.95 precision and 0.67 recall, and simulated and physical failure times showed a significant positive correlation of 0.617.
  **Conclusion:** Combining multi-image optimization with explainability-guided search improves robustness testing for DNN-controlled robotic systems. Simulation effectively identifies and prioritizes transferable failures, but physical validation remains necessary because some real-world failures are not reproduced in simulation.

</details>


### [132] [RMRRT: Riemannian Barrier Metric RRT for Inequality-Aware Steering on Equality Manifolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06863)
*Minhyeong Kang,Sanghyun Kim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出RMRRT框架，将等式与不等式约束统一为单一几何度量，用于高维机器人采样规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统采样规划中，等式约束通过投影、不等式约束通过二元有效性检查分别处理，探索效率低。

Method: 构建基于不等式敏化障碍项的环境度量，并通过与等式约束相关的G-正交投影诱导切空间度量；该度量在导向与最近邻选择中一致使用，偏向远离不等式边界，同时保持一阶等式一致性；度量由带符号距离的几何代理不等式实例化，硬可行性另行用标准有效性检查保证。

Result: 在仿真与真实环境的多种约束操作任务中达到100%成功率，且相对代表性约束规划基线减少规划时间；消融表明该度量减少被拒样本、缩短路径长度。

Conclusion: 统一几何度量的RMRRT有效提升受约束采样规划的探索质量与效率。

Abstract: This paper presents a motion planning framework that unifies equality and inequality constraints within a single geometric formulation for sampling-based planning in high-dimensional robotic systems. In conventional sampling-based planners, equality constraints are typically enforced through projection, whereas inequality constraints are handled separately through binary validity checks such as collision testing, often leading to inefficient exploration. To address this limitation, we propose Riemannian Barrier Metric RRT (RMRRT), which constructs a unified local geometry for planning on equality-constrained manifolds. RMRRT first builds an ambient barrier metric from inequality-sensitive barrier terms and then induces a tangent-space metric via a (G)-orthogonal projection associated with the equality constraints. The resulting tangent-space metric is used consistently in both steering and nearest-neighbor selection, biasing exploration away from nearby inequality boundaries while preserving first-order equality consistency. In this work, the metric is instantiated from signed-distance-based geometric proxy inequalities to provide collision-informative tangent-space directions; hard feasibility is enforced separately through standard validity checks. Experimental results show that RMRRT achieves a 100% success rate across diverse constrained manipulation tasks in both simulation and real-world settings, while reducing planning time relative to representative constrained planning baselines. Ablation studies further demonstrate that the proposed metric improves exploration quality by reducing rejected samples and shortening path length. Experiment videos and source code are available at: https://rmrrt-anonymous.github.io

</details>


### [133] [Geometric Coherence via Weighted Matching for 3D Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Reach-Avoid Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06882)
*Prajwal Vijay*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究3D异构多智能体reach-avoid博弈中的任务分配质量问题，指出仅按基数匹配会导致"几何蔓延"失效模式，提出以HJI拦截值为次级权重的基数优先加权序贯匹配方法，在35个场景基准上将平均捕获数提升22%、拦截高度提升40%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在几何结构化的3D异构多智能体reach-avoid场景中，存在多个最大基数分配方案，但仅考虑基数的匹配可能产生空间上不协调的配对和低效的追击轨迹（作者称之为"几何蔓延"），现有分配方法缺乏对几何一致性的考量。

Method: 基于Yan等人的逃逸空间框架，提出基数优先的加权序贯匹配：以Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs拦截值z_I(s,j)作为次级分配权重，每个序贯阶段用最小费用最大流求解；无权重基线使用相同求解器但移除权重项。在7个族×5种初始化变体共35个确定性场景基准上评测，含诊断性静止未匹配与混合鞍点未匹配两种设定。

Result: 加权方法在诊断设定下解决了15个几何压力测试实例中的13个（基线反复超时）；混合设定下平均捕获数从3.20提升至3.91（+22%），平均拦截高度从3.87提升至5.36（+40%）；路径曲折度和角努力代理指标更低，表明一阶仿真模型中追击轨迹更平滑。

Conclusion: 将几何一致性通过HJI拦截值引入序贯匹配权重，可有效缓解几何蔓延问题，提升3D reach-avoid博弈的分配质量与拦截效率；作者开源了仿真器与基准套件以支持分配策略的可复现评测。

Abstract: We study assignment quality in 3D heterogeneous multi-agent reach-avoid games and identify a recurring failure mode of cardinality-only matching in geometrically structured scenarios, which we term \emph{Geometric Sprawl}. In these cases, multiple maximum-cardinality assignments are available, but some induce spatially incoherent pairings and inefficient pursuit trajectories. Building on the evasion-space framework of Yan et al.~\cite{yan2022}, we introduce a cardinality-first weighted sequential matching method in which the Hamilton--Jacobi--Isaacs interception value $z_I(s,j)$ is used as a secondary assignment weight. Each sequential stage is solved with a min-cost max-flow backend, while the unweighted baseline uses the same solver with the weight term removed. We evaluate both methods on a deterministic 35-scenario benchmark (7 families & 5 initialization variants) under two regimes: a diagnostic stationary-unmatched setting and a hybrid saddle-point setting with goal-directed unmatched evaders. On this benchmark, the weighted method resolves 13 of 15 geometric stress-test instances that cause repeated timeouts for the unweighted baseline in the diagnostic regime, and under the hybrid regime improves mean captures from $3.20$ to $3.91$ (22\% increase) and mean interception height from $3.87$ to $5.36$ (40\% increase). We also report lower path tortuosity and lower angular-effort proxy values, suggesting smoother pursuit trajectories in this first-order simulation model. We release the simulator and benchmark suite at \href{https://github.com/Prajwal-Vijay/geometric-coherence-weighted-matching}{github.com/Prajwal-Vijay/geometric-coherence-weighted-matching} to support reproducible evaluation of assignment strategies for 3D reach-avoid games.

</details>


### [134] [Does a Learned Corrector Beat a Simple Retreat? Evidence from a Frozen VLA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06921)
*Chenchao Sheng,Zhuang Jiang,Liuhaichen Yang,Ningwei Bai,Zezhi Tang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 

Method: 

Result: 

Conclusion: 

Abstract: Before deploying runtime recovery for a frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policy, one must establish that an intervention improves success beyond ordinary run-to-run variation and that its complexity adds value over a simple action. We evaluate these questions on frozen $π_{0.5}$ across four RoboTwin tasks. For each test seed, we pair rollouts with and without correction and include a same-seed base-policy re-run as a placebo. Seed-cluster intervals and prespecified comparison rules assess net gains against stochastic outcome changes. Across 3,888 paired episodes, the full pipeline raises success on beat_allowbreak block_allowbreak hammer by $+13.5$\,pp (95\% interval $[+9.4,+17.7]$), with no detectable gain on the other three tasks at the deployed weight. Among failed base episodes on the responsive task, $43.2\%$ succeed on a plain re-run, compared with $63.5\%$ after correction; many nominal rescues therefore reflect the base policy's own variability. A fixed-time trigger and scripted return to an earlier joint configuration produce a net gain with no detected difference from the learned pipeline across two rounds, although our prespecified equivalence criterion is not met consistently. Pausing and a constant-action control do not yield comparable gains. On this benchmark, the decision to intervene depends strongly on the task, and a paired placebo plus a simple retreat baseline are needed to establish what learned correction contributes.

</details>


### [135] [SWAP: Stepwise Action Policy Routing for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06926)
*Mousumi Das,Aditeya Prajapati,Abrar Anwar,Jesse Thomason*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出SWAP框架，将多个VLA策略的动态组合建模为离线强化学习问题，学习路由critic在每个决策步选择最合适的策略，在真实DROID任务中成功率最高提升33%，成功轨迹动作步长减少28.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于VLA骨干的机器人操作系统通常仅使用单个VLA执行任务，但单一VLA在不同任务状态和环境下表现不佳，固定策略难以适应多样化的执行情形。

Method: SWAP将策略路由形式化为离线强化学习问题，学习一个路由critic（routing critic），在每一步决策时依据当前观测选择最合适的策略；该方法使机器人能够在线切换并执行新策略，而非在整个episode内固定采用单一策略。

Result: 在真实世界DROID操作任务和LIBERO仿真实验中评估，SWAP优于固定策略执行及路由基线，真实任务成功率绝对提升最高达33%，同时成功轨迹的机器人动作步长减少28.3%。

Conclusion: 通过将多VLA策略的动态组合建模为离线强化学习，SWAP实现了逐步的在线策略路由，显著提升了任务成功率和执行效率，验证了动态策略路由在机器人操作中的有效性。

Abstract: Robot manipulation systems using Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model backbones typically use just one VLA for task execution. However, individual VLAs do not perform well across different task states and environments. We introduce a framework for dynamically composing multiple VLA policies during execution: StepWise Action Policy Routing (SWAP). SWAP formulates policy routing as an offline reinforcement learning problem, learning a routing critic that selects the most appropriate policy at each decision step given the current observation. SWAP enables robots to select new policies to execute online rather than committing to a single policy for the duration of an episode. We evaluate SWAP on both real-world DROID manipulation tasks and LIBERO simulation experiments. SWAP improves over fixed-policy execution and routing baselines, giving absolute improvements in real-world task success up to 33% while reducing successful trajectory robot action step length by 28.3%.

</details>


### [136] [Physical Twins: Accelerating and Enabling Robot Learning with Phantom Platforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06929)
*Elizabeth Peiros,Derek Chen,Lucas Yager,Edward Lee,Kevin Wang,Zoe Samuels,Michael C. Yip*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种改进的"物理孪生"幻影装置，可复现肩关节球窝运动及肩胛、前伸/后缩运动，用于人机物理交互（pHRI）算法的真实环境强化学习测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人机物理交互研究对物理治疗、搜救和远程医疗意义重大，但人体实验受安全与伦理约束，还需IRB审批和志愿者参与，且存在可重复性、可扩展性和参与者多样性不足的问题，因此需要替代性的实物测试平台。

Method: 设计并搭建改进的幻影装置（物理孪生），除球形关节运动外，还实现肩胛骨运动和前伸/后缩运动；通过实验刻画多个三维关节限位，并使用Franka Panda机械臂感知关节限位，将该装置作为手臂开展ADL与pHRI任务交互测试。

Result: 实验表明，该装置能够渲染多个三维关节限位；Franka Panda机械臂可成功感知这些限位，并与之交互完成日常生活活动（ADL）和人机物理交互任务。

Conclusion: 该幻影装置为物理交互算法提供了一种可重复、可扩展且无需人体参与的实机测试方案，规避了人体实验的伦理与安全限制。

Abstract: Improvements in human-robot physical interaction (pHRI) can have major implications for physical therapy, search and rescue, and telemedicine. However, a major challenge concerns human constraints and safety in human-robot physical experiments. Concerns about human studies also include repeatability, scalability, and participant diversity. To conduct such experiments, an IRB and willing human participants are required. In this work, we present an improved phantom device, a physical twin, that enables real-world RL-type testing for physically interactive algorithms. The new device not only replicates the ball-and-socket motion of the shoulder but also renders scapular and protraction/retraction motions. The experiments showcase the device's ability to render multiple 3D joint limits and demonstrate a Franka Panda arm sensing limits and interacting with the device as an arm for ADLs (activities of daily living) and pHRI tasks.

</details>


### [137] [ROMA: LLM System for Real-World Object-Centric Multi-Sensory Active Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06955)
*Ruoxuan Feng,Yutong Chen,Ruihua Song,Huan Yang,Zhongyuan Wang,Guocai Yao,Di Hu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ROMA 提出基于 LLM 的以物体为中心的实世界多感官主动感知系统，融合视觉、听觉、触觉与力觉，构建 ROMI-2K 数据集与两阶段训练框架，实现主动获取缺失证据并完成长链多感官感知任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类在感官证据不足时会主动与环境交互以获取缺失信息（决定缺什么、如何获取、何时充分）。现有机器人多感官系统主要被动融合感官输入，缺乏主动获取缺失证据的能力。因此需构建能进行主动多感官感知的具身智能系统。

Method: 提出 ROMA，将视觉、音频、触觉、力觉集成到“推理—交互—反馈”闭环中：模型识别缺失证据并确定目标物体、交互方式与模态，物理接口执行交互并采集多感官反馈。构建 ROMI-2K 大规模真实多感官物体交互数据集（近2000个物体、6种原子交互、同步感官反馈）。基于该数据设计两阶段训练框架，对齐各感官模态并赋予 LLM 评估证据充分性、选择信息性交互、推理多感官反馈的能力。将主动感知刻画为“感知链”，并建立 ROMA Bench 评估单属性、长时程多属性与意图驱动主动感知。

Result: 实验表明 ROMA 能主动获取缺失证据，解决现有方法难以处理的复杂长链多感官感知任务。

Conclusion: ROMA 为主动多感官具身智能体奠定了坚实的感知基础。

Abstract: Humans inherently understand the physical world through an active process. When sensory evidence is insufficient to infer physical properties, we naturally interact with the environment by deciding what information is missing, how to acquire it, and when sufficient evidence has been obtained. In stark contrast, existing multi-sensory robot systems mainly integrate sensory inputs rather than actively acquiring missing evidence through interactions. In this work, we introduce ROMA, an LLM-based system for Real-World Object-Centric Multi-Sensory Active Perception. ROMA integrates vision, audio, tactile, and force sensing into a reasoning-interaction-feedback loop. The model identifies missing evidence and determines the target objects, interactions, and modalities, while a physical interface executes the selected interactions and collects the multi-sensory feedback. To support this capability, we construct ROMI-2K, a large-scale real-world multi-sensory object interaction dataset covering nearly 2,000 objects and 6 atomic interactions with synchronized sensory feedback. Building on these data, we develop a two-stage training framework that aligns sensory modalities and equips the LLM to assess evidence sufficiency, select informative interactions, and reason over the multi-sensory feedback. We further characterize active perception as perception chains, where acquired evidence guides subsequent interactions and reasoning, and establish ROMA Bench to evaluate single-attribute, long-horizon multi-attribute, and intent-driven active perception. Experiments show that ROMA can actively acquire missing evidence and solve complex, long-chain multi-sensory perception tasks that existing methods struggle to handle, laying a strong perceptual foundation for active multi-sensory embodied agents.

</details>


### [138] [Learning Modular Policy for Multi-Floor Object Navigation:A Factorized Framework for Diagnostic Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06958)
*Shichao Zhai,Shuhao Ye,Rong Xiong,Yue Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文针对多楼层ObjectNav中稀疏奖励问题，提出基于模块化框架的诊断研究，设计了分层分解策略（楼层内探索+楼层间切换），通过VLM蒸馏初始化楼层内策略，实验表明感知性能与爬楼稳定性是主要瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多楼层场景下的物体目标导航（ObjectNav）因长时程决策导致奖励稀疏，训练困难；同时缺少对多楼层导航失败因素的系统性诊断分析。

Method: 提出模块化框架与可学习策略进行诊断研究：设计分层分解策略，将单一全局策略解耦为楼层内探索策略与楼层间切换策略；楼层内轻量策略通过蒸馏视觉语言模型（VLM）的探索逻辑获得有效RL初始化；并在理想假设下证明分解策略在策略表示层面与单一全局策略等价。

Result: 实验结果表明，感知性能与爬楼稳定性是多楼层导航中的主要瓶颈。

Conclusion: 通过分层分解与VLM蒸馏可获得有效的诊断用策略，说明多楼层ObjectNav的核心限制来自感知与跨楼层运动稳定性，为后续改进指明方向。

Abstract: Object-goal navigation (ObjectNav) in multi-floor scenarios presents a challenge due to sparse rewards caused by long-horizon decision-making. In this paper, we propose a diagnostic study based on a modular framework with an effective learnable policy to analyze failure factors in multi-floor scenarios. To achieve an effective policy for diagnosis, we design the hierarchical factorization policy that deconstructs a single global policy into an intra-floor exploration policy and an inter-floor switching policy. To providing an effective initialization for Reinforcement Learning (RL), the lightweight intra-floor policy is learned by distilling the exploration logic of Visual Language Models (VLMs). Under idealized assumptions, we show that the factorized policy is theoretically equivalent to a single global policy at the policy-representation level. Experiment results indicate that perception performance and stair climbing stability are the primary bottlenecks in multi-floor navigation.

</details>


### [139] [ACG-WAM: World-Action Modeling via Action-Conditioned Geometric Latent Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06965)
*Jiangtao Liu,Zishang Xiang,Yage He,Lingguo Cui,Baihai Zhang,Runqi Chai,Senchun Chai*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 ACG-WAM 及其辅助目标 ACG-JEPA，通过用冻结 VGGT 编码未来槽位作为几何特征监督信号，在共享视觉嵌入上预测多时域几何特征，提升机器人策略学习的几何感知能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 world action models 联合学习视觉预测与机器人动作，但其视频与动作损失未对演示动作序列的几何后果提供显式监督目标；此外，经过时间注意力后的视觉特征可能已包含未来观测信息，不适合作为辅助预测器唯一的当前视觉输入。

Method: 引入 ACG-WAM 及辅助目标 ACG-JEPA。ACG-JEPA 以当前观测与干预动作为输入，预测多个时域上的几何特征；监督目标为冻结 VGGT 编码对当前与未来图像对中未来槽位（future slot）的表征。该监督从头部与腕部相机施加到时间混合前的共享视觉嵌入上，推理阶段移除教师与辅助模块。

Result: 在 50 个 RoboTwin 2.0 任务上，干净场景成功率 93.46%，随机化成功率 92.68% 为最优，两设置均值 93.07% 为对比方法中最佳；在真实机器人三项任务上成功率达 85.00%，部分完成得分 91.67%，分别较 Motus 高出 10.00 与 9.17 个百分点。

Conclusion: 通过将冻结 VGGT 的未来槽位作为几何预测目标施加于时间混合前的共享视觉嵌入，可为 world action models 引入显式的动作几何后果监督，且不增加推理开销，在仿真与真实机器人任务上均取得领先性能。

Abstract: World action models jointly learn visual predictionand robot actions, providing a way to use observations ofscene evolution for policy learning. Their video and actionlosses, however, provide no explicit target for the geometricconsequences of a demonstrated action sequence. Moreover,visual features taken after temporal attention can contain futureobservations, making them unsuitable as the sole current visualinput to an auxiliary predictor. We introduce ACG-WAMand its auxiliary objective, the Action-Conditioned GeometricJoint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (ACG-JEPA), whichpredicts geometric features at several horizons from the currentobservation and intervening actions, using the future slot of afrozen VGGT encoding of each current and future image pairas the target. We apply this supervision from the head and wristcameras to a shared visual embedding before temporal mixing,and remove the teacher and auxiliary modules at inference.On 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, ACG-WAM achieves 93.46%success in clean scenes, with the best randomized success(92.68%) and mean across both settings (93.07%) among thecompared methods; across three tasks on a real robot, itachieves 85.00% success and 91.67% partial completion score,exceeding Motus by 10.00 and 9.17 percentage points, respec-tively. Code:https://github.com/RoboOpus/ACG-WAM.Website:https://RoboOpus.github.io/ACG-WAM.

</details>


### [140] [ProactiveVLA: Augmenting Embodied Memory through Proactive Environment Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06999)
*Shizuo Tian,Haodong Luo,Yutong Li,Yuebing Song,Yunxin Liu,Yuanchun Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出ProactiveVLA：在冻结VLA模型上加推理智能体，用主动探索获取可复用知识，提升部署时适应能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人快速适应新环境需从有限经验中获取关于局部物体、状态与交互的有用知识。现有"推理智能体+冻结VLA"系统依赖执行反馈与记忆，因此经验选择成为效果关键；而仅反复练习目标任务可能精化已有解法，却忽略因条件变化而相关的其他交互。

Method: ProactiveVLA采用主动环境探索获取可复用知识：完成初始任务后，将剩余交互预算分配给自提出的探索目标，涵盖物体可供性、引起状态变化的交互及其组合；验证执行结果，并将任务导向经验与探索经验一并整合进记忆，用于后续规划与控制。

Result: 在相同交互轮次预算下，于LIBERO-Pro与RoboCasa365 Composite-Seen上优于基线。在LIBERO-Pro Goal-T上，评测时最多允许一次VLA原语调用的情况下，ProactiveVLA完成48%的实例，而最强任务精化基线为19%。

Conclusion: 主动探索采集的可复用经验比单纯任务重复练习更能提升冻结VLA系统的部署时适应性能，经验分配策略是此类系统有效性的核心。

Abstract: Rapid adaptation to a new environment requires a robot to acquire useful knowledge about local objects, states, and interactions from limited experience. Systems that combine a reasoning agent with a frozen vision-language-action model (VLA) can adapt through execution feedback and memory, making the choice of experience central to their effectiveness. Repeated practice of a target task may refine a familiar solution while leaving other interactions relevant to changed conditions untested. We introduce ProactiveVLA, which uses proactive environment exploration to acquire reusable knowledge for deployment-time adaptation. After completing an initial task, the agent allocates the remaining interaction budget to self-proposed goals covering object affordances, state-changing interactions, and compositions of interactions. It verifies execution outcomes and consolidates both task-directed and exploratory experience into memory that guides subsequent planning and control. ProactiveVLA outperforms the baselines under the same turn budget on LIBERO-Pro and RoboCasa365 Composite-Seen. On LIBERO-Pro Goal-T, with at most one VLA primitive invocation allowed during evaluation, ProactiveVLA completes 48% of instances, compared with 19% for the state-of-the-art task-refinement baseline.

</details>


### [141] [LEAP: Making Privileged Geometry Supervision Effective for Visuomotor Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07015)
*Han Fang,Yunpeng Jiang,Jianshu Hu,Zhiyuan Guan,Ruiguo Sun,Shujia Li,Paul Weng,Xiao Li,Yutong Ban*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 LEAP 框架：通过辅助解码器从视觉特征重建操作工作空间点云，并配合腕部视角 dropout 与局部重建目标，缓解特权 3D 监督在 RGB 视觉运动策略中的三类缺陷，在仿真与真实任务上稳定超越 Diffusion Policy 和 ACT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 特权 3D 监督在训练阶段引入几何信息以指导基于 RGB 的视觉运动策略学习，部署时无需几何输入。但低重建误差并不等于视觉表征学到了对控制有用的几何信息，现有监督方式存在三类削弱其有效性的问题：本体感知捷径（proprioceptive shortcuts）、主导视角依赖（dominant-view reliance）、以及重建目标被任务无关几何主导。作者旨在解决这些缺陷，使视觉表征真正捕获与控制相关的几何。

Method: 提出 LEAP（Latent Encoding with Aligned Privileged Geometry）。框架使用辅助解码器，仅从视觉特征重建操作工作空间内的点云；同时保留本体感知用于动作预测，以避免本体感知捷径。除完整重建外，引入腕部视角 dropout（wrist-view dropout）与与保留腕部视角相匹配的部分重建目标（partial reconstruction targets），促使编码器捕获互补的局部几何信息。推理时移除辅助解码器，策略输入仅为 RGB 观测与机器人状态。

Result: 在 RoboTwin、ManiSkill 仿真基准及真实世界任务上进行的大量实验表明，LEAP 相较 Diffusion Policy 与 ACT 取得一致且显著的性能提升；参数量仅小幅增加，推理速度无下降。

Conclusion: 通过将特权几何重建目标与部署时可用的观测通路对齐（分离本体感知、强化互补视角与局部几何），LEAP 使视觉表征更有利于控制，在几乎不增加部署成本的前提下显著提升 RGB 视觉运动策略性能。

Abstract: Privileged 3D supervision uses additional geometric information during training to guide RGB-based visuomotor policy learning, without requiring geometric inputs at deployment. However, low reconstruction error does not ensure that visual representations capture geometry useful for control. We identify three limitations that weaken this supervision: proprioceptive shortcuts, dominant-view reliance, and reconstruction objectives dominated by task-irrelevant geometry. To address these limitations, we propose Latent Encoding with Aligned Privileged Geometry (LEAP). Our framework uses an auxiliary decoder to reconstruct point clouds within the manipulation workspace from visual features alone, while retaining proprioception for action prediction. Alongside full reconstruction, we introduce wrist-view dropout and partial reconstruction targets matched to the retained wrist, encouraging the encoder to capture complementary local geometry. The auxiliary decoder is removed at inference, leaving only RGB observations and robot state as policy inputs. Extensive experiments on RoboTwin, ManiSkill, and real-world tasks demonstrate consistent and substantial improvements over Diffusion Policy and ACT, with only a small increase in parameter count and no reduction in inference speed.

</details>


### [142] [BRACE: Adapting Whole-Body References for Force and Terrain Aware Humanoid Motion Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07052)
*Sudarshan Harithas,Chen Yu,Juan Borbon,Shubhankar Mondal,Winston Zha,Srinath Sridhar,Dingqi Zhang,Jiuguang Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: BRACE 是一种全身跟踪器，将地形顺应与力/力矩转换折叠进参考轨迹，使机器人在斜坡上跟随平地参考的同时施加并补偿手部指令力，仅靠本体感知运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全身跟踪的参考轨迹采集于平地且无负载，跟踪器既不知机器人需与物体交换的力，也不知所站地形。已有控制器各解决一侧：可施力策略能指令末端力但不规定全身姿态；地形自适应跟踪器则把负载当作需要抑制的扰动而非需指令的力矩。

Method: BRACE 不把负载和坡度留给跟踪器被动吸收，而是将二者折叠进所跟随的参考中：地形顺应把落脚点与根节点提升到局部表面；一个力旋量变换求解产生该力所需的手部位移，以及其诱导的质心与压力中心偏移，并受各教师专属的手臂努力上限约束。通过 DAgger 将“施力”和“补偿”两个教师蒸馏为单一 flow-matching 学生策略，仅依赖本体感知运行，无需高度图或实测力旋量。

Result: 在 Unitree-G1 上开展了大量仿真与真机实验，验证了 BRACE 施加力、补偿力以及应对多样地形的能力。

Conclusion: BRACE 使遥操作者（即便在远程）只需提供平地轨迹，机器人即可在机载端自行解决坡度与负载问题，实现了在斜坡上跟随平地参考的同时施加与补偿手部指令力的全身跟踪。

Abstract: Whole-body tracking has become the interface through which operators drive humanoid robots, yet the references it consumes are recorded on level ground and carrying nothing, so the tracker is aware of neither the forces the robot must exchange with objects nor the terrain it must stand on. Existing controllers address one side of this gap: force-capable policies command an end-effector force but prescribe no whole-body pose, while terrain-adaptive trackers treat loads as disturbances to reject rather than wrenches to command. We present BRACE, a whole-body tracker that exerts and compensates commanded hand forces from diverse poses while following a flat-ground reference on sloped terrain. Rather than leaving the tracker to absorb the load and the slope, BRACE folds both into the reference it follows: terrain conformance lifts footholds and root onto the local surface, and a wrench transformation resolves the hand displacement that produces a force jointly with the center-of-mass and center- of-pressure shifts it induces, bounded by teacher-specific arm-effort limits. Separate exertion and compensation teachers are distilled by DAgger into one flow-matching student that runs on proprioception alone, without a height map or measured wrench, so a teleoperator (even in remote locations) can supply a flat- ground trajectory and the robot resolves slope and load onboard. We extensive experiments on the Unitree-G1 to demonstrate the ability of BRACE to exert, compensate force and handle diverse terrain in simulation and real robot experiments.

</details>


### [143] [Behavioral Cloning Mystery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07056)
*Seohong Park,Sergey Levine*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 OCBench——一个带有可控脚本策略的机器人操作基准，其策略具备类似人类演示的特性，从而在受控环境中复现并研究多种"行为克隆谜题"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行为克隆（BC）虽简单，却在现实中表现出诸多反直觉现象，例如随模型对数据集的过拟合程度加深其性能反而持续提升，以及完全闭环策略在无动作分块（action chunking）时常常彻底失败。然而，系统研究这些"行为克隆谜题"存在困难：真实世界数据集与实验成本高且难以完全可控；而合成数据的仿真中，由于脚本策略与人类演示之间存在差异，这些现象往往不易被观察到。

Method: 作者提出 OCBench：一个机器人操作基准，配备可控的脚本策略，这些策略具有与人类演示相似的关键特性。该基准借助 GPU 加速的环境与脚本策略构建受控实验平台。

Result: OCBench 通过模仿人类演示的关键特性，在受控设置下成功复现了众多与 BC 相关的传闻现象；并在 GPU 加速环境和脚本策略支持下，通过分析并反驳多种假设，展示了该基准对既往报道的 BC 相关现象进行科学研究的能力。

Conclusion: OCBench 为在受控条件下科学研究行为克隆谜题提供了有效工具，能够复现相关现象并用于假设的分析与验证。

Abstract: Behavioral cloning (BC), despite its simplicity, exhibits many counterintuitive phenomena in the real world. For example, the performance of BC often keeps increasing as the model overfits more to the dataset, and fully closed-loop policies often completely fail without action chunking. Unfortunately, properly studying these anecdotal phenomena ("behavioral cloning mysteries") is challenging: in the real world, datasets and experiments are costly and not fully controllable; in simulation with synthetic data, these phenomena are often not easily observed partly due to the discrepancy between scripted policies and human demonstrations. In this work, we propose OCBench, a robotic manipulation benchmark with controllable scripted policies that have similar properties to human demonstrations. We show that, by mimicking key properties of human demonstrations, OCBench reproduces many anecdotal BC-related phenomena in controlled settings. With its GPU-accelerated environments and scripted policies, we demonstrate how OCBench enables scientific studies of previously reported BC-related phenomena by analyzing and refuting various hypotheses. Project page: https://seohong.me/projects/ocbench

</details>


### [144] [Demo: Vision-Language Model-Guided Online Calibration of an Electromagnetic Digital Twin](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07081)
*Zerui Kang,Yishen Lim,Zhouyou Gu,Seungnyun Kim,Seung-Woo Ko,Tony Q. S. Quek,Jihong Park*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出视觉语言模型（VLM）引导的电磁数字孪生在线标定框架，用Unitree G1机器人与NVIDIA Sionna实现材料电导率在线校准与路径点规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电磁数字孪生为移动机器人提供无线态势感知，但其依赖随环境变化的材料电导率；在线标定面临初始化敏感与测量移动成本高的问题。

Method: 框架含两次VLM调用：材料分类将可见材料经ITU-R P.2040映射为电导率先验，供Sionna对累积RSS测量做梯度下降；路径点规划基于残差RSS标定误差与图像覆盖度在线选择下一测量位置。

Result: 真实室内场景中，20 m行程内归一化平均绝对电导率误差为1.74×10⁻⁴；随机初始化无法收敛，随机路径点所需行程超过两倍。

Conclusion: VLM引导的先验与主动路径点规划可有效提升电磁数字孪生在线标定的收敛性与测量效率。

Abstract: An electromagnetic (EM) digital twin gives mobile robots wireless situational awareness but depends on material conductivities that change with the environment. Online calibration faces initialization sensitivity and measurement travel costs. We demonstrate a vision-language model (VLM)-guided framework using a Unitree G1 robot and NVIDIA Sionna, with two VLM calls: material classification maps visible materials through ITU-R P.2040 to conductivity priors for Sionna's gradient descent on accumulated received signal strength (RSS) measurements; waypoint planning selects the next measurement location online using residual RSS calibration error and image coverage. In a real indoor scenario, the framework achieves a normalized mean absolute conductivity error of $1.74\times10^{-4}$ within 20 m of travel; random initialization never converges, while random waypoints require over twice the travel.

</details>


### [145] [TeleHairing: A Teleoperation Baseline for Robotic Haircutting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07096)
*Zhendai Huang,Aleksi Vilkki,Jianan Huang,Bolin Liao,Chunbo Luo,Leopoldo Angrisani,Shuai Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出闭环遥操作架构TeleHairing，在假人上评测机器人理发在本地、中继与远程部署下的时序、轨迹与中断行为，为后续自主化与安全性研究提供定量基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人理发需要在头部附近受控运动工具，同时处理通信、视觉反馈、工具驱动与中断处理等耦合行为；现有研究缺乏在人体验证前或更强自主性之前的"操作者在环"参考基准。

Method: 构建TeleHairing闭环遥操作架构，在假人（mannequin）上进行机器人理发评测，覆盖本地、中继（relay）与远程三种部署条件；通过日志时序分析、轨迹跟随误差分析及检测丢失（detection-loss）试验进行评估。

Result: 远程模式总体时序达190.5 ms，主要延迟增量发生在机器人侧控制端点之前，而机器人侧命令队列、控制处理与控制到机器人的时序在各模式间相近；远程命令跟随误差主要由末端撤回段主导而非全程累积，剔除该段后远程RMSE由45.1 mm降至9.6 mm；检测丢失试验中rebase事件恢复运动且未出现大的目标跳变。

Conclusion: 结果阐明了部署方式、执行过程与中断如何影响机器人理发遥操作环路，为未来自主性、安全性和面向用户的研究提供定量参考。

Abstract: Robotic haircutting requires controlled tool motion near the head while simultaneously accounting for communication, visual feedback, tool actuation, and interruption handling. Existing studies still lack an operator-in-the-loop reference for analyzing these coupled behaviors before human trials or stronger autonomy. This paper presents TeleHairing, a closed-loop teleoperation architecture for mannequin-based robotic haircutting evaluation under local, relay, and remote deployment conditions. Logged timing shows that the main remote latency increase occurs before the robot-side control endpoint: overall timing reached 190.5~ms in remote mode, while robot-side command queue, control processing, and control-to-robot timing remained similar across modes. Trajectory analysis shows that the larger remote command-following error was dominated by the terminal withdrawal segment rather than accumulated uniformly over the path; excluding this segment reduced remote root-mean-square error (RMSE) from 45.1 mm to 9.6 mm. Detection-loss trials further show that rebase events resumed motion without a large target jump under the tested condition. These results clarify how deployment, execution, and interruption affect the robotic haircutting teleoperation loop, providing a quantitative reference for future autonomy, safety, and user-facing studies.

</details>


### [146] [AIM: Adaptive Interaction Modeling Networks for Real-to-Sim Soft-Body Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07116)
*Tiancheng Yang,Dingshuo Chen,Tianle Chen,Zhaocheng Liu,Qiang Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出AIM框架，将真实到仿真的软体仿真建模为局部-全局交互建模问题，在PhysTwin和PGND上提升运动精度与视觉保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可变形物体操作（如叠衣、处理食物）需机器人控制形状变化与物体运动，预测性软体仿真可预测交互下的形变。但空间邻域可能错表形变依赖关系，造成累积局部误差；且针对单一场景拟合的模型难以适应物体几何与操作条件的变化。

Method: 提出AIM（自适应交互建模）框架，将真实到仿真软体仿真视为局部-全局交互建模问题：利用运动历史与几何自适应调整粒子关系（覆盖当前空间邻居与保留连接）；采用几何条件化的全局通信协调物体整体响应；设计统一运动学控制点接口表示不同操作配置；并通过多步自回归监督在模型自身预测轨迹上训练。

Result: 在PhysTwin与PGND上实验：相对PhysTwin未来预测跟踪误差降低20.0%；相对PGND在六类物体上长时程平均粒子误差降低22.8%；运动精度与视觉保真度均提升；支持跨动作、跨物体实例与跨场景迁移，包括从机器人交互到人类操作的零样本迁移（无需目标域动力学拟合）。

Conclusion: AIM通过局部-全局交互建模与自适应粒子关系、全局通信、统一控制点接口及多步自回归监督，有效缓解局部误差累积并提升泛化性，实现真实到仿真软体仿真的高精度预测与跨域迁移。

Abstract: Deformable-object manipulation is essential for robotic tasks such as folding laundry and handling food, where robots must control shape changes as well as object motion. Predictive soft-body simulation supports these tasks by anticipating deformation under external interactions. However, spatial neighborhoods can misrepresent deformation dependencies, introducing local errors that accumulate over successive predictions. Models fitted to individual scenes must also accommodate changes in object geometry and manipulation conditions. In this work, we propose AIM, an Adaptive Interaction Modeling framework that treats real-to-sim soft-body simulation as a local-global interaction modeling problem. AIM uses motion history and geometry to adapt particle relations over current spatial neighbors and retained connections, while geometry-conditioned global communication coordinates object-wide responses. A unified kinematic control-point interface represents different manipulation configurations, and multi-step autoregressive supervision trains the model on its own predicted trajectories. Experiments on PhysTwin and PGND demonstrate improved motion accuracy and visual fidelity, with a 20.0% reduction in future-prediction tracking error relative to PhysTwin and a 22.8% reduction in mean long-horizon particle error across six object categories relative to PGND. The framework further supports transfer across actions, object instances, and scenes, including zero-shot transfer from robot interactions to human manipulation without target-domain dynamics fitting.

</details>


### [147] [RoboCap: A New Platform for Egocentric Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07217)
*Grounded Superintelligence,BitRobot*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出RoboCap（一款250克、六相机双IMU的帽子式硬件）与Grounded API（设备无关的3D算法套件），用于大规模采集野外第一人称操作数据，并在公开基准上取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 第一人称（egocentric）操作数据对机器人学习扩展极具潜力，但当前数据稀缺。规模化采集需将符合人体工学的硬件与厘米级精度的3D算法垂直整合，而这一精度此前尚无公开验证。

Method: 设计250克、六相机、双IMU的帽子式采集设备RoboCap，实现野外第一人称数据采集；并配套开发设备无关的3D算法套件Grounded API，针对RoboCap进行调优，涵盖硬件、标定与3D算法的协同设计与交互。

Result: 在多个公开基准上达到当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能：在不同场景与设备配置下的SLAM、第一人称场景下的深度估计，以及迁移至第三方设备时的手部追踪。

Conclusion: 通过硬件、标定与3D算法的协同设计，可实现高精度、可扩展的第一人称数据采集，为机器人学习的规模化发展提供支持。

Abstract: Despite its promise for scaling robot learning, egocentric manipulation data is still scarce today. Collection at scale requires vertically integrating ergonomic hardware with centimeter-precise 3D algorithms, at a precision that has not been publicly demonstrated. To address this gap, we introduce RoboCap, a 250\,g six-camera dual-IMU hat designed for in-the-wild egocentric data capture, and the Grounded API, a suite of device-agnostic 3D algorithms tuned for RoboCap. In this report, we demonstrate how hardware, calibration, and 3D algorithms interact to achieve state-of-the-art performance on the public benchmarks: our SLAM across diverse settings and rigs, our depth estimation on egocentric settings, and our hand tracking when adapted to third-party devices.

</details>


### [148] [Monocular Navigation Relative to Unknown Spacecraft Using a Transformer-Aided Kalman Filter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07231)
*Pol Francesch Huc,Simone D'Amico*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种仅用单目图像的未知航天器位姿估计学习管线，将Transformer网络与MSCKF结合，估计相对轨道根数、姿态及角速度，对未见目标实现姿态中位误差3.7°、ROE距离误差2.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉位姿估计方法依赖目标形状或惯量先验知识、需要深度/激光/双目等额外传感器，或仅能恢复尺度未知的平移，难以适用于未知目标的交会与接近操作。

Method: 用SuperPoint特征与LightGlue匹配，Transformer网络估计尺度未知的图像间里程计；将伪量测输入MSCKF，结合轨道与姿态运动学模型直接估计相对轨道根数、目标相对相机姿态及角速度；通过服务航天器姿态机动恢复距离全可观性。

Result: 在重新渲染的高分辨率SPE3R数据集（103个航天器，11个留出）上训练评估，留出目标的蒙特卡洛仿真显示姿态中位误差3.7°、距离误差为ROE的2.2%。

Conclusion: 学习式视觉管线作为卡尔曼滤波前端，可在无先验、单目条件下对未知目标实现有效导航，验证了该范式在交会与接近操作中的可行性。

Abstract: This work presents a novel learning-based pipeline for pose estimation of unknown spacecraft using only monocular images from a single servicer. The approach combines a transformer-based neural network with a Multi-State Constraint Kalman Filter (MSCKF) to estimate the pose (i.e., position and orientation of the target spacecraft relative to the camera) throughout rendezvous and proximity operations. Unlike existing vision-based methods that require prior knowledge of the target shape or inertia properties, rely on additional sensing modalities such as depth, lidar, or stereo, or only recover translation up to scale, the proposed pipeline generalizes to previously unseen spacecraft using a single monocular camera. The transformer network estimates the odometry, the change in pose between images up to scale, from SuperPoint features matched by LightGlue. The MSCKF uses these pseudo-measurements along with an orbit and attitude kinematics model to estimate the pose of the target. In particular, the relative orbit elements, the target's attitude with respect to the servicer's camera, and the associated angular velocity are estimated directly by the filter. Given the monocular approach and short distance to the target, the full observability of the range to the target is recovered via attitude maneuvers by the servicer. The method is trained and evaluated on a re-rendered high-resolution version of the SPE3R dataset, which includes synthetic images of 103 spacecraft. Eleven of these spacecraft are held out during training to evaluate the generalization to unseen targets. Monte Carlo simulations are then used to evaluate the navigation pipeline on rendered trajectories of the held out spacecraft. The results demonstrate that learned vision pipelines as a front-end for Kalman filters provide median errors of 3.7° in attitude and 2.2% of range in ROE when navigating about unknown targets.

</details>


### [149] [Robust Nonprehensile Object Transport with Quadruped Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07245)
*Ainoor Teimoorzadeh,Riccardo Pretto,Mario Selvaggio,Gokhan Alcan,Sami Haddadin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种面向四足机器人的鲁棒非抓取式物体运输框架，通过不确定性感知轨迹优化与耦合凸MPC+全身QP控制，在仿真与实机实验中显著减少物体滑动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 四足机器人以非抓取（如背部承载）方式运输物体时，物体惯性参数存在不确定性，易导致物体相对机器人滑动，影响运输稳定性与可靠性。

Method: 1) 不确定性感知轨迹优化，生成对不确定参数闭环敏感度最小的物体运动；2) 以耦合凸模型预测控制（MPC）跟踪参考轨迹，同时预测四足机器人质心动力学与负载动力学；3) 通过全身QP（whole-body QP）施加地面反作用力约束。

Result: 在物体惯性参数变化下进行大量仿真与真实世界实验，并与固定朝向轨迹和直线轨迹两种基线对比：优化后的物体运动使滑动量较固定朝向基线减少约50%，较直线基线减少约30%，同时机器人质心跟踪误差更小。

Conclusion: 所提框架能有效提升四足机器人非抓取运输对物体惯性参数不确定性的鲁棒性，兼顾减小物体滑动与改善机器人质心跟踪性能。

Abstract: In this paper, we present a robust nonprehensile object transportation framework for quadruped robots. An uncertainty-aware trajectory optimization method generates object motions with minimal closed-loop sensitivity to uncertain parameters. The resulting reference trajectory is tracked using a coupled convex model predictive controller that jointly predicts the CoM dynamics of the quadruped and the payload followed by a whole-body QP that enforces ground reaction constraints. The approach is evaluated through extensive simulations and real-world experiments under variations in the object's inertial parameters. Its performance is compared with fixed-orientation and straight-line trajectories as baseline. The results show that the optimized object motion reduces the sliding by approximately 50% compared with the fixed-orientation baseline and 30% compared with the straight-line baseline, while also achieving lower robot CoM tracking errors.

</details>


### [150] [Fluorescence-enhanced Whisker Array with Vision-based Deformation Analysis for Underwater Source Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07275)
*Xiaochi Xie,Hao Li,Shixuan Zhao,Siyue Yao,Shuran Song,Mark R. Cutkosky*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出荧光增强触须阵列感知系统，通过局部光学读出定位水动力源，池中实验平均定位误差88 mm，支持动态场景实时定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深海生物观测中，传统光学与声学方法会引入刺激，改变动物行为并导致观测偏差，因此需要一种不直接成像、对生物干扰更小的水动力源定位手段。

Method: 制备五根空间取向的触须，采用镍钛合金芯与荧光聚氨酯外壳，结合紫外激发与单目相机进行局部光学读出；通过图像增强与分割追踪触须形变；利用轻量级卷积神经网络从2 s序列中提取时序与跨触须特征，估计水动力源位置。

Result: 在600 mm、±30°测试区域内，池中实验平均空间定位误差为88 mm，其中半径误差73.5 mm、角度误差2.5°；移动推进器的实时定位验证了动态场景下的定位能力。

Conclusion: 该荧光增强触须阵列系统可在低光环境下实现水动力源检测、定位与跟踪，具备集成到水下机器人中的潜力，为低干扰生物观测提供了新途径。

Abstract: Deep-water biological observation is essential for understanding marine organisms and their interactions with the environment. However, conventional optical and acoustic approaches can introduce stimuli that alter animal behavior and bias biological observations. This paper proposes a fluorescence-enhanced whisker array sensing system that pinpoints underwater hydrodynamic sources through local optical readout rather than direct source imaging. Five spatially oriented whiskers, fabricated with nitinol cores and fluorescent urethane shells, are integrated with ultraviolet excitation and a monocular camera. Image enhancement and segmentation are applied to track the whisker deformation. A lightweight convolutional neural network captures temporal and cross-whisker features from 2 s sequences to estimate source localization. Pool experiments achieve a mean spatial localization error of 88 mm, with 73.5 mm in radius and $2.5^\circ$ in angle, across a test region of 600 mm with $\pm30^\circ$. Real-time localization of a moving thruster demonstrates the capability of the proposed method in dynamic scenarios, highlighting its potential for integration into underwater robots for hydrodynamic source detection, localization, and tracking in low-light environments.

</details>


### [151] [Distribution-Transfer Safe-Horizon MPC under Mode Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07277)
*Stephen Crawford,Nora Ayanian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 针对场景化MPC在分布失配下的敏感性，本文在切换动态模式障碍的SH-MPC框架中构建类别模式律置信集，并推导乘性支配界，将碰撞风险证书从采样分布转移到置信集内任意分布；结合Wasserstein几何正则化概率重分配与碰撞风险代理偏置采样，显式量化分布失配所需的额外保守紧化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 场景化MPC通过有限采样场景近似不确定性，是机会约束运动规划的有效策略，但其作为采样方法对分布失配敏感；尤其是在障碍物由切换动态模式支配、真实类别模式律未知且仅有有限模式观测的情形下，采样分布与真实分布不一致会削弱安全证书的有效性。

Method: 1) 从有限模式观测构建未知类别模式律的置信集；2) 推导乘性支配界，将安全视界碰撞风险证书从选定场景采样分布传递到置信集内每一个分布；3) 用Wasserstein几何按模式诱导轨迹预测的相似性正则化模式间概率重分配；4) 引入碰撞风险代理，使采样偏向危险模式。

Result: 所得证书显式量化了分布失配下所需的额外紧化量，并揭示当多个逐障碍传递因子组合时出现的乘性保守性。

Conclusion: 该工作为分布失配下的场景化SH-MPC提供了可传递的风险证书与量化保守性分析，Wasserstein正则化与风险代理采样在保持安全保证的同时刻画了多障碍组合带来的乘性保守代价。

Abstract: Scenario-based MPC is an attractive strategy for chance-constrained motion planning that approximates uncertainty via a finite set of sampled scenarios. As a sampling-based method, scenario-based MPC is sensitive to distribution mismatch. We address this problem in the context of Safe-Horizon Model Predictive Control (SH-MPC) with obstacles governed by switching dynamic modes. From finite mode observations, we construct a confidence set for the unknown categorical mode law and derive a multiplicative domination bound that transfers a Safe-Horizon collision-risk certificate from a selected scenario-sampling distribution to every law in the confidence set. Wasserstein geometry is used to regularize probability reallocation among modes according to the similarity of their induced trajectory predictions, while a collision-risk surrogate biases sampling toward dangerous modes. The resulting certificate explicitly quantifies the additional tightening required under distribution mismatch and exposes the multiplicative conservatism that arises when several obstacle-wise transfer factors are combined

</details>


### [152] [Embedded Bare-Metal Radar-Inertial Odometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07278)
*Nicolai Adil Øyen Aatif,Morten Nissov,Kostas Alexis*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种面向低算力平台的嵌入式雷达-惯性状态估计器，所有驱动、数据处理与惯性导航在单核MCU上运行；飞行实验达到平移APE 0.51–0.82 m、RPE<3%，并实现PX4闭环飞行，固件与PCB开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 紧凑型行星探测车与微型无人机需在算力受限且环境恶劣条件下实现鲁棒状态估计；基于视觉或LiDAR的方案计算开销大且易受感知退化影响，不适合资源受限平台，因此需寻找兼具鲁棒性与计算效率的替代传感与估计方案。

Method: 采用FMCW雷达，其可直接提供速度测量并具抗感知退化能力；设计嵌入式雷达-惯性估计器，将全部传感器驱动、数据处理与辅助惯性导航集成在单核微控制器上运行，并与PX4飞控栈进行闭环集成。

Result: 飞行实验显示相对动捕的平移APE为0.51–0.82 m，RPE<3%，并通过未修改的PX4栈完成闭环飞行；验证了单核MCU上的计算效率与可行性。

Conclusion: FMCW雷达-惯性嵌入式方案可在低算力平台上实现鲁棒且高效的状态估计，减少对人工监督的依赖，保障平台在挑战性环境中的安全；相关固件与PCB设计已在GitHub开源。

Abstract: Compact extraplanetary rovers and micro aerial vehicles require robust state estimation frameworks designed to operate under strict computational constraints in unforgiving environments. Typical solutions involving vision- or LiDAR-based sensing are computationally expensive and vulnerable to environments with perceptual degradation, making them poorly suited for resource-constrained platforms and austere conditions. Alternatively, Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave (FMCW) radar offers both robustness and computational efficiency by directly providing velocity measurements coupled with inherent resilience to perceptual degradation. These factors enable robust estimation, thereby reducing reliance on human operators for supervision to ensure platform safety in challenging environments. In this manuscript, we propose an embedded radar-inertial estimator tailored for low-compute platforms. All sensor drivers, data processing, and aided inertial navigation are performed on a single-core microcontroller, demonstrating its computational efficiency. Flight experiments show translational APE of $0.51-0.82\,\mathrm{m}$ and RPE of $<$3\,\% against motion capture, alongside closed-loop flight through an unmodified PX4 stack. The firmware and printed circuit board design are openly available on GitHub at \href{https://github.com/ntnu-arl/embedded_rio}{ntnu-arl/embedded\_rio} and \href{https://github.com/ntnu-arl/embedded_rio-pcb}{ntnu-arl/embedded\_rio-pcb} respectively.

</details>


### [153] [Lego-Like Stiffness Configuration of Planar Compliant Modules for Task-Specific Flexible Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07319)
*Siyue Yao,Xiaochi Xie,Shixuan Zhao,Yutong Li,Hao Li,Mark R. Cutkosky,Genliang Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出基于可堆叠平面柔顺模块的乐高式刚度配置方法，实现任务定制刚度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同任务需要不同刚度特性，但受限于几何设计空间和刚度分量间的固有耦合，往往需针对任务重新优化与设计。

Method: 引入三种互补模块几何，通过梁宽、板厚和模块朝向来调节刚度；建立统一刚度模型；采用两阶段优化（遗传算法配置+序列二次规划参数细化）。

Result: 仿真刚度偏差低于6.5%；柔性腕关节在1 m/s高速运动下保持柔顺避障，最大测试角柔度约15°。

Conclusion: 该框架为构建具有任务特定刚度特性的柔性接口提供了系统化方法。

Abstract: Compliant mechanisms provide compact and intrinsic structural compliance for regulating physical interactions between mechanisms and environments. However, different tasks demand distinct stiffness characteristics, often requiring task-specific optimization and redesign due to limited geometric design space and inherent coupling among multiple stiffness components. This paper presents a Lego-like stiffness configuration approach using stackable planar compliant modules. Three complementary module geometries are introduced, with their stiffness characteristics further regulated through beam width, plate thickness, and module orientation. A unified stiffness model is established for quantitative analysis of individual and composed modules. Further, a two-stage optimization method is presented to achieve desired stiffness profiles, combining a genetic algorithm for configuration and sequential quadratic programming for parameter refinement. Experimental verification shows deviations below 6.5% for simulated stiffness. A flexible wrist is further developed as a representative implementation, exhibiting distinct compliant and dynamic responses under different stiffness characteristics. An optimized modular composition realizes prescribed stiffness values and maintains compliant obstacle interaction during high-speed motion at 1 m/s, with a maximum tested angular compliance of approximately $15^\circ$. The proposed framework provides a systematic approach for constructing flexible interfaces with task-specific stiffness characteristics.

</details>


### [154] [Towards Decentralized Formation of Minimum-Length Communication Networks Using Robot Swarms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07320)
*Genki Miyauchi,Mohamed S. Talamali,Julian Rau,Roderich Groß*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种全去中心化框架，使机器人在无定位基础设施下仅凭局部交互构建并动态维护通信网络，性能接近集中式欧氏Steiner树。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在基础设施缺失环境（如地下探索、行星任务）中，空间分离位置间需要可靠通信链路，但缺乏集中式拓扑规划与全局定位基础设施，需要机器人自主组织自适应的自组网通信基础设施。

Method: 完全去中心化的框架，不依赖集中式拓扑规划或全局定位；机器人仅通过局部交互重配置局部网络拓扑并调整物理位置，以在满足通信约束下最小化整体网络长度。

Result: 形式化分析证明局部重配置操作保证网络连通性持续、每次分支转移都严格缩短网络长度，并将最坏情况性能限制为最短星形树；实体仿真与真实多机器人实验验证网络长度接近集中式计算的欧氏Steiner树，且能动态适应移动目标、仅使用必要连接机器人并保留多余机器人用于辅助任务。

Conclusion: 该工作使自主集群能在通信受限环境中自组织自适应自组网通信基础设施，可支持从地下探索到行星任务等多种应用。

Abstract: Multi-robot missions in infrastructure-denied environments frequently rely on reliable communication links between spatially separated locations. We propose a fully decentralized framework for constructing and dynamically maintaining communication networks without centralized topology planning or global positioning infrastructure. Driven strictly by local interactions, robots reconfigure local network topologies and adjust their physical positions to minimize overall network length while adhering to communication constraints. Formal analysis shows that our local reconfiguration operations guarantee continuous network connectivity, strictly decrease network length with every branch transfer, and bound worst-case performance to the shortest starlike tree. Embodied simulations and physical multi-robot experiments confirm that our approach forms networks near the length of centrally computed Euclidean Steiner trees. Additionally, the system dynamically adapts to moving targets and optimizes deployment by utilizing only necessary connectors, preserving excess robots for auxiliary tasks. This work enables autonomous swarms to self-organize adaptive ad hoc communication infrastructure in communication-denied environments, which could support applications varying from subterranean exploration to planetary missions.

</details>


### [155] [SharedKV-BT: Node-Local Typed Decisions for Behavior-Tree Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07327)
*Naoki Wake,Justin Wagle*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SharedKV-BT 将行为树节点作为决策单元，用 Shared-KV 并行打分候选动作，实现比自回归解码快 2.36–4.15 倍的带类型决策，并在操作、导航与计算机使用任务中提升准确率与闭环成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体任务需要相互依赖的决策序列。自回归模型虽提供比传统分类器更灵活的决策接口，但逐个 Token 生成带来高延迟；现有共享前缀方法虽通过复用编码上下文并行打分降低开销，却不建模决策间依赖，也不验证执行结果。

Method: 提出 SharedKV-BT：以行为树（BT）的每个活动节点暴露阶段局部字段与候选动作，由 Shared-KV 对这些候选并行打分，并将选中的决策传给独立的执行系统，从而在保留决策依赖结构的同时避免逐 Token 生成。

Result: 在机器人操作、移动导航与计算机使用三类任务上测试。三类任务中，SharedKV-BT 生成带类型决策比提示匹配的自回归解码快 2.36–4.15 倍；在操作任务上，节点局部 Shared-KV 将联合决策准确率从 75% 提升至 94%，闭环成功率从 0% 提升至 60%。固定打分策略回放表明，阶段门控避免了乱序动作，外部后置条件避免了过早完成。

Conclusion: 将行为树的结构化阶段约束与共享 KV 并行候选打分结合，可在显著降低决策延迟的同时提升决策准确率、闭环成功率与执行顺序正确性，为智能体决策提供了一种兼顾灵活性与效率的接口。

Abstract: Agent tasks require sequences of interdependent decisions. Autoregressive models support more flexible decision interfaces than conventional classifiers but incur the latency of token-by-token generation. Recent shared-prefix methods reduce this cost by reusing encoded context and scoring multiple decisions in parallel, but do not model decision dependencies or verify execution. We propose SharedKV-BT, where each active node of a behavior tree (BT) exposes stage-local fields and candidates, and Shared-KV scores the candidates in parallel and passes the selected decision to a separate execution system. We tested SharedKV-BT on robot manipulation, mobile navigation, and computer-use tasks. Across three tasks, SharedKV-BT made typed decisions 2.36-4.15 times faster than prompt-matched autoregressive decoding. On the manipulation task, node-local Shared-KV improved joint decision accuracy from 75% to 94% and closed-loop success from 0% to 60%. Fixed-score policy replay showed that stage gating prevented out-of-order actions and external postconditions prevented premature completion.

</details>


### [156] [ScanSTL: Parallel Robustness Evaluation for Signal Temporal Logic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07346)
*Gokhan Alcan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ScanSTL 通过关联式时间聚合、并行扫描与有序块归约，实现 STL 鲁棒性的精确、可并行、可微分计算，在 CPU/GPU 上显著优于 STLCG++。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: STL 鲁棒性的反复评估与求导在机器人规划控制中成为计算瓶颈：时序递推限制并行性，稠密掩码增加内存开销。已有实现（如 STLCG、STLCG++）难以兼顾精确性、并行深度与内存效率。

Method: 提出 ScanSTL，将关联式时间聚合与并行扫描（parallel scans）及有序块归约结合：Eventually/Always 采用区间极值，包含式强 Until 通过组合紧凑段表示实现；统一区间引擎处理有界与平移区间，并包含延迟 Until 见证所需的前置守卫。每个精确时序算子以线性工作量与存储、对数并行深度计算完整鲁棒性轨迹；提供开源 JAX 实现，支持自动微分、批处理与编译。

Result: 在 CPU/GPU 算子基准与九个复合规范上对比 STLCG 和 STLCG++：在 512 采样点、九个规范上，ScanSTL 在 JAX CPU 上相对 STLCG++ 的前向评估几何平均加速 243 倍，梯度计算加速 104 倍。RTX 5090 GPU 上，ScanSTL 对超过两百万采样点的无界 Until 前向评估中位时间低于 0.1 ms，梯度计算低于 0.25 ms。机器狗模拟护送与巡逻实验显示，违反规范计划的修复更快，MPC 求解器容量更大。

Conclusion: ScanSTL 为 STL 鲁棒性评估与微分提供了精确、线性复杂度、对数并行深度且可编译的高效方案，在大规模信号与实时机器人控制任务中具备显著计算优势。

Abstract: Repeated evaluation and differentiation of Signal Temporal Logic (STL) robustness can become a computational bottleneck in robot planning and control. Sequential temporal recurrences limit parallelism, while dense masking increases memory requirements. We propose ScanSTL, which combines associative temporal aggregation with parallel scans and ordered block reductions. Eventually and Always use range extrema, while inclusive strong Until composes compact segment representations. A common range engine handles bounded and shifted intervals, including the guards required before delayed Until witnesses. Each exact temporal operator computes complete robustness traces with linear work and storage and logarithmic parallel depth on uniformly sampled finite signals. An open source JAX implementation supports automatic differentiation, batching, and compilation. We compare ScanSTL with STLCG and STLCG++ using CPU and GPU operator benchmarks and nine composed specifications. Across these nine specifications at 512 samples, ScanSTL achieves geometric mean speedups of 243 times for forward evaluation and 104 times for gradient computation over STLCG++ in JAX on the CPU. On an RTX~5090 GPU, ScanSTL evaluates unbounded Until over more than two million samples with median times below 0.1 ms for forward evaluation and 0.25 ms for gradient computation. Simulated escort and patrol experiments with a robot dog further demonstrate faster repair of violating plans and greater solver capacity in model predictive control.

</details>


### [157] [Expressiveness, Equivalence, and Uncertainty in Velocity Obstacles and Closest Point of Approach Metrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07371)
*Elizabeth Dietrich,Liam M. Imagawa,Hanna Krasowski,Aurora Haraldsen,Murat Arcak,Kristin Y. Pettersen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文在理想状态信息下建立了TCPA、DCPA与VO之间的关系及等价条件，并在有界不确定性下将其推广为凸相对状态集，指出独立计算的TCPA/DCPA边界会丢失VO隶属所需的联合关系，而考虑不确定性的VO通过集合值表示保留了该关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TCPA、DCPA与速度障碍（VO）广泛用于自主导航中的碰撞风险评估与规避，但三者之间的关系以及在不确定性下的行为尚未被充分研究。

Method: 在完美状态信息假设下，分析有限与无限预测时域内三种表示之间的关系并推导其等价表征碰撞风险的条件；在有界不确定性下，将CPA度量与VO扩展到凸相对状态集，并对比独立计算的TCPA/DCPA边界与集合值VO的表现。

Result: 在完美信息假设下给出了TCPA、DCPA与VO的等价条件；在有界不确定性下，独立计算的TCPA与DCPA边界丧失了VO隶属所需的联合关系，而考虑不确定性的VO能够通过碰撞诱发速度的集合值表示保留该关系。

Conclusion: TCPA、DCPA与VO在理想条件下可等价刻画碰撞风险，但在不确定性下只有集合值形式的VO能保持其联合关系，为不确定性感知的碰撞风险评估提供了理论依据。

Abstract: Time to Closest Point of Approach (TCPA), Distance to Closest Point of Approach (DCPA), and Velocity Obstacles (VOs), are widely used to assess and mitigate collision risk in autonomous navigation, yet their relationship and behavior under uncertainty remain largely unexplored. Assuming perfect state information, we establish a relationship between these representations over finite and infinite prediction horizons and derive conditions under which they provide equivalent characterizations of collision risk. Under bounded uncertainty, we extend the Closest Point of Approach (CPA) metrics and VO to convex relative-state sets. We show that in this setting, independently computed TCPA and DCPA bounds lose the joint relationship required for VO membership, while uncertainty-aware VOs preserve this relationship through a set-valued representation of collision-inducing velocities.

</details>


### [158] [Toward Trustworthy Physical AI for Human Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07382)
*Niccolò Pagliarani,Maximilian Stölzle,Cosima du Pasquier,Jeff Lui,Andrew Sabelhaus,Cecilia Laschi,Gentiane Venture,Daniela Rus,Matteo Cianchetti*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出面向具身物理AI的可信框架，统合安全性、行为可理解性与感知一致性，覆盖具身、控制、认知与设计四个层面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人进入人类空间的速度远超人们建立对其信任评判标准的速度，亟需一套系统化的可信物理AI理论框架。

Method: 构建一个跨层级的可信物理AI框架，将安全性（Safety）、行为可理解性（Behavioral Intelligibility）与感知一致性（Perceptual Alignment）三者整合到具身（embodiment）、控制（control）、认知（cognition）和设计（design）四个维度之中。

Result: 该框架指出可信性源于物理能力、可观测行为与人在交互中形成的期望三者之间的对齐。

Conclusion: 可信物理AI的实现依赖能力、行为与人类期望的协同一致，为后续机器人信任研究提供了整合性的概念框架。

Abstract: Robots are entering human spaces faster than we can establish when they deserve trust. We propose a framework for trustworthy physical AI that integrates Safety, Behavioral Intelligibility, and Perceptual Alignment across embodiment, control, cognition, and design. Trustworthiness emerges from aligning physical capabilities, observable behavior, and expectations people form during interaction.

</details>


### [159] [AeroBuoy: A Drone Deployable, 3D Printed, Autonomous Robotic Buoy for Environmental Inspection in Remote and Hazardous River Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07390)
*Reuben O'Brien,Angus Lynch,Minas Liarokapis*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种由无人机部署的自主数据采集浮标环境巡检系统，利用河流自然流动、结合GPS与磁力计自主导航，可测量水温并扩展多种传感器，并在新西兰Ōrewa River完成系统演示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 偏远及危险河流的监测对评估施工径流、气候变化等外部因素影响至关重要。通用自主机器人船虽能提供环境巡检方案，但在机动性方面存在不足，难以适应难以进入的河流系统。

Method: 设计一种可由无人机部署到不可达河流系统的自主数据采集浮标系统，支持按地点与监测任务需求进行投放与回收；浮标利用河流自然流动顺流而下，通过GPS和磁力计自主转向以维持期望轨迹；可测量水温，并可搭载水氧仪、河床探测声纳、浊度计等传感器。

Result: 给出了系统设计描述、浮标自扶正能力分析，并在新西兰奥克兰Ōrewa River进行了完整系统演示。

Conclusion: 该无人机部署的自主浮标系统为偏远、危险或受保护水域的环境巡检与监测提供了一种可行方案，具备自扶正能力与多传感器扩展性，并已通过实地演示验证。

Abstract: Monitoring of waterways such as remote and hazardous rivers and streams is important so as to assess the impact of external factors including construction runoff or climate change. Versatile, autonomous robotic boats can offer excellent environmental inspection and monitoring solutions for remote, dangerous, or access protected water bodies but they have several shortcomings in terms of maneuverability. This paper proposes an environmental inspection system consisting of an autonomous data collection buoy which is designed to be deployed to inaccessible river systems using a drone. The system can perform a drop off and pickup of the buoy depending on the requirements of a particular location and monitoring task. Utilising the natural flow of the river the buoy autonomously steers down, using GPS and magnetometers so as to maintain the desired trajectory. The buoy is capable of measuring water temperature but it can also be equipped with a range of sensors such as water oxygen meter, sonar for river bed inspection, or turbidity for water clarity. This paper describes the system design, presents an analysis of the self-righting capabilities of the buoy, and shows a full system demonstration at the Ōrewa River in Auckland, New Zealand.

</details>


### [160] [What the Elevation Map Cannot See: Semantic-Aware Locomotion and Execution-Aware Navigation for Humanoid Robot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07396)
*Shunyu Yao,Songyang Liu,Dinghao Chen,Yuanyuan Lei,Shuai Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文指出现有VLN基准假设所有危险可从高程图观测、且实际运动与期望运动一致，提出同时建模细微高程危险与执行偏差的新基准及闭环VLN+运动控制框架，仿真评估并在Unitree G1实体机器人上验证运动策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人导航的实机大规模评估受成本与安全限制而不可行，故需仿真基准。但现有VLN基准存在两点不现实假设：一是所有危险都能从高程图中观测到（现实中倒下的瓶子在高程图中模糊，手机与水渍难以区分）；二是实际执行运动与期望运动高度吻合（运动策略避障会导致实际轨迹偏离VLN策略意图路径），这种命令-执行失配会累积并将机器人导向非预期位置。

Method: 提出一个同时建模高程细微危险（elevation-subtle hazards）与执行偏差的基准，并构建闭环VLN+运动控制框架，持续将高层导航与机器人实际状态重新对齐；在仿真中评估导航，并在实体Unitree G1人形机器人上验证运动策略。

Result: 语义输入可减少与高程图中表征不佳的危险的接触；抗偏差（anti-deviation）机制提升了导航成功率。

Conclusion: 人形机器人导航评估需同时从路径完成度与危险规避两方面进行联合考量。

Abstract: Navigation for humanoid robots is critical, yet large-scale evaluation on physical hardware is often impractical due to cost and safety concerns, making simulation benchmarks essential. Existing VLN benchmarks achieve physically executable navigation, but still assume (1) all hazards are observable from elevation maps; (2) realized motions closely match desired motions. In real environments, however, fallen bottles may be ambiguous in elevation maps, while phones and water spills may be difficult to differentiate; hazard avoidance by the locomotion policy can cause the robot's actual trajectory to deviate from the path intended by the VLN policy. Such command-execution mismatch can accumulate and lead the robot toward unintended locations. To expose these failure modes, we introduce a benchmark that models both elevation-subtle hazards and execution deviations, together with a closed-loop VLN + locomotion control framework that continuously realigns high-level navigation with the robot's actual state. We evaluate navigation in simulation and further validate the locomotion policy on a physical Unitree G1 humanoid robot. Results show that semantic input reduces contact with hazards poorly represented in elevation maps, while anti-deviation improves navigation success. These findings highlight the need to evaluate humanoid navigation jointly in terms of route completion and hazard avoidance.

</details>


### [161] [An Autonomous, 3D Printed, Waterjet-Powered, Open-Source Robotic Trimaran for Environmental Inspection and Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07398)
*Reuben O'Brien,Martin Lambrechtse-Reid,Minas Liarokapis*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种低成本、可复现的自主水翼三体无人船平台，用于偏远或受保护水域的环境监测，成本600-1500美元、自重不足5 kg、最高航速2 m/s，可完成水深测量与水质检测并具备避障能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 偏远、危险、难以抵达或受保护水域的环境巡检与监测需求难以被资源密集型科考船满足，尤其在新西兰（Aotearoa）多样水域环境中缺乏高效、经济的水下监测手段。

Method: 设计并搭建一艘自主、低成本、喷水推进的三体无人船：采用现成商用组件与3D打印技术制造，搭载传感系统（水深测量与水质检测），通过喷水推进适应浅水作业，并进行以水深测量为重点的测试验证，包括对岩石等自然特征的避障测试。

Result: 平台开发成本为600-1500美元（取决于传感系统配置），自重低于5 kg，最高航速可达2 m/s，可实现岩石等自然障碍物规避，在水深测量和水质检测任务中表现良好；得益于现成组件与3D打印，具备良好的可复现性与鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 该三体无人船为资源密集型科考船提供了高效、低成本、易复制的替代方案，论文详细阐述了设计特性与传感系统，并指出该平台在未来研究与数据采集方面的应用潜力。

Abstract: Versatile, autonomous robotic boats can offer excellent environmental inspection and monitoring solutions for remote, dangerous, hard to reach, or access protected water bodies. This paper introduces such a platform in the form of an autonomous, cost-effective, waterjet-powered robotic trimaran. Motivated by the need for an efficient aquatic monitoring, particularly in Aotearoa - New Zealand's diverse environments, the trimaran provides an efficient, low-cost, and easy to replicate alternative to resource-intensive research vessels. The proposed platform, costs $600-1,500 USD to develop (depending on the sensing system configuration), weighs under 5 kg, and excels in bathymetry and water quality testing. The trimaran can reach speeds of up to 2 m/s offering obstacle avoidance of natural features, such as rocks. Utilizing off-the-shelf components and 3D printing technology, the proposed platform offers excellent reproducibility and robustness while operating in shallow waters with its jet propulsion system. The paper presents in detail the design characteristics, the sensing system employed, testing results focusing on bathymetry, and highlights the ability of vessel and the potential for future research and data collection.

</details>


### [162] [RACER: Residual-Adaptive Closed-Loop Estimation for Sampling-Based Planning in Wheeled-Quadruped Racing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07409)
*Yuxiang Liu,Marla Eisman,Lizhi Yang,Aaron Ames,Francesco Borrelli*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RACER：一种面向轮足式四足机器人竞速的分层控制框架，MPPI规划器结合学习到的残差动力学模型与底层RL速度跟踪器，并提出LoRRA低秩残差自适应方法在有限真实数据下训练残差模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 轮足式四足机器人高速竞速中，RL速度跟踪器存在闭环跟踪误差（尤其高速转弯时），而纯标称运动学模型难以刻画该误差；同时真实世界数据有限，残差模型训练面临数据稀缺与域间差距问题。

Method: 分层控制框架：MPPI规划器 + 学习到的残差动力学模型 + 底层RL速度跟踪器；规划器在标称独轮车运动学模型上叠加神经残差项以捕捉RL策略的闭环跟踪行为。提出LoRRA两阶段方法：先在大规模仿真数据上预训练获得广泛覆盖，再用小规模真实数据在低秩约束下微调。

Result: 仿真验证三项结论：(A) 残差动力学通过捕捉高速转弯时RL速度跟踪器的跟踪误差提升整体性能；(B) 源域+目标域数据训练的残差动力学显著优于仅用目标域数据；(C) 当地面系数或关节增益的域间差距增大时，目标域自适应中的低秩约束相比全量微调和从头训练具有更高成功率和性能。

Conclusion: 在MPPI规划中引入神经残差动力学建模RL底层策略的闭环行为，并配合LoRRA的低秩域自适应，可有效缓解真实数据稀缺与域间差距问题，提升轮足式四足机器人竞速的鲁棒性与表现。

Abstract: We present RACER, a hierarchical control framework for wheel-based quadruped racing that combines an MPPI planner with a learned residual dynamics model and a low-level RL velocity tracker. The planner augments a nominal unicycle kinematic model with a neural residual term to capture the closed-loop tracking behavior of the RL policy. To train this residual model under limited real-world data, we propose Low-Rank Residual Adaptation (LoRRA), a two-stage approach that pre-trains on large-scale simulation data for broad coverage and then fine-tunes on a small real-world dataset with a low-rank constraint. In simulation, we empirically validate our engineering choices by showing (A) Residual dynamics improve the overall performance of our pipeline by capturing the tracking error of RL velocity tracker at high-speed cornering. (B) Residual dynamics trained with both source-domain and target-domain data gives racing performance significantly better than the residual dynamics trained with only target-domain data. (C) Low-rank constraint at target-domain adaptation gives higher success rates and higher performance than full-tune and from-scratch when domain gap in ground coefficient or joint gain increases.

</details>


### [163] [Entropy-Gated Belief Coordination for Decentralized Multi-Agent Search Under Intermittent Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07432)
*Mohamed Abdelnaby,Kevin Leahy*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出熵门控信念协调（EG-TDP），在泊松间歇通信的多智能体目标搜索中仅于利用阶段融合信念，显著优于算术均值与访问加权融合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准无条件信念融合在通信机遇稀缺、且处于高熵探索阶段时强迫同步，会牺牲独立信念带来的覆盖多样性，过早达成一致；因此需要一种按探索/利用阶段选择性融合的协调机制。

Method: （1）熵门控信念协调：当集体熵比超过阈值θ时跳过融合，仅在利用阶段合并，其合理性来自非线性意见动力学的分岔结构与逐步信息增益目标的子模性；（2）推导 I_step(α,β)，即两智能体二元传感器每观测步的期望互信息，作为无通信、可解释的传感器信息量度量，用于指导门控设计；（3）EG-TDP 规划器：在利用模式加入检测概率规划器切换。
