Method: 提出LCAM（Loss-Conditioned Activation-Moment）剪枝，一种面向预训练机器人操作策略的非结构化剪枝免训练方法。具体地：利用行归一化权重贡献、在校准演示上测得的激活矩，以及输出方向对动作预测损失的敏感度来对连接排序；并设计自递归由粗到细流程：在每次嵌套的粗剪枝阶段后重新校准重要性，在稀疏度拐点之后用留出的离线动作失真指导细粒度预算分配。该方法在剪枝后无需昂贵的恢复训练与仿真回放。

Result: 在三个LIBERO套件上的竞争性机器人策略实验，以及在OpenVLA上的评估表明，LCAM在广泛的剪枝率范围内取得有竞争力的性能。在LIBERO-Object上结合OpenVLA，50%非结构化剪枝下达到84.0%成功率，保留了稠密策略90%以上的成功率。真实世界机器人乒乓球实验的积极结果进一步验证了该剪枝算法的有效性。

Conclusion: LCAM通过将剪枝重要性度量与动作预测损失及闭环行为对齐，提供了一种免训练、无需仿真回放的非结构化剪枝方案，在高剪枝率下仍能较好保持机器人操作策略的性能，并在仿真与真实任务上得到验证。

Abstract: Network pruning can reduce parameter redundancy in robotic policies. However, generic pruning criteria are tailored for image recognition tasks and commonly designed to preserve weight magnitude, local reconstruction, or language-model likelihood rather than closed-loop action behavior. Directly applying these pruning algorithms to robotic tasks yields unsatisfactory performance. In this paper, we propose Loss-Conditioned Activation-Moment (LCAM) pruning, a training-free method for unstructured pruning of pre-trained robotic manipulation policies. Specifically, we first rank connections using row-normalized weight contribution, activation moments measured on calibration demonstrations, and the sensitivity of output directions to the action-prediction loss. We further design a self-recursive coarse-to-fine procedure: importance is recalibrated after each nested coarse pruning stage, while held-out offline action distortion guides fine-grained budget allocation after a sparsity knee. Our algorithm is free from costly recovery training and simulator rollouts after pruning. Experiments on three LIBERO suites with competitive robotic policies, together with evaluations on OpenVLA, show that LCAM attains competitive performance across a broad range of pruning ratios. Notably, on LIBERO-Object with OpenVLA, our LCAM achieves 84.0% success at 50% unstructured pruning, retaining over 90% of the dense policy's success rate. Promising results on real-world robotic ping pong further demonstrate the effectiveness of our pruning algorithm.

</details>


### [234] [One for All, All for One: Coordinated Multi-Agent Diffusion Steering via Stochastic Optimal Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08595)
*Riccardo Barbano,Vincent Pauline,Runchang Li,George Webber,Alexander Denker,Željko Kereta,Stefan Bauer,Francisco Vargas,Esmeralda S. Whitammer*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出协调多智能体扩散引导（CMDS），将冻结的预训练扩散模型视为可复用生成基元，通过学习控制来协调其反向过程，从而以模块化方式生成结构化输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度生成模型常需生成由相互作用组件构成的结构化输出，单一模型需同时学习组件分布及其交互，耦合度高、难以复用。论文希望采用模块化方案，复用独立训练好的组件生成器，仅学习如何协调它们以产生一致的结构化输出。

Method: 将协调建模为随机最优控制问题：在装配级奖励（刻画组合输出的期望属性）与偏离预训练动力学之间进行权衡；学习一个控制策略来摊销该优化，使其可泛化到新的任务实例，并用于协调多个冻结扩散模型的反向过程。

Result: 实验表明CMDS能恢复已知目标分布；用同一训练得到的控制满足不同空间约束；从退化混合中恢复各个源；在多智能体迷宫导航、关节机器人规划以及文本条件人体运动任务中，将冻结模型转化为协调的多智能体生成器。

Conclusion: CMDS提供了一种模块化协调预训练扩散模型的有效框架，通过随机最优控制与策略摊销实现跨任务复用的多智能体结构化生成，无需重新训练组件生成器。

Abstract: Deep generative models often produce structured outputs composed of interacting components. Modelling these outputs with a single model requires learning both the component distributions and their interactions. We pursue a modular alternative: reuse independently trained component generators and learn only how to coordinate them to produce coherent structured outputs. Our framework, Coordinated Multi-Agent Diffusion Steering (CMDS), treats frozen pretrained diffusion models as reusable generative primitives and coordinates their reverse processes through a learned control. We formulate coordination as a stochastic optimal control problem, balancing an assembly-level reward that specifies the desired properties of the combined output against deviations from the pretrained dynamics. The learned control amortises this optimisation, allowing reuse across new task instances. Experiments show that CMDS can recover a known target distribution, satisfy different spatial constraints with the same trained control, and recover individual sources from degraded mixtures. Across multi-agent maze navigation, articulated robot planning, and text-conditioned human motion, CMDS turns frozen models into coordinated multi-agent generators.

</details>


### [235] [A Swarm-Coordinated Multi-Robot System for Early Stress Detection in Agricultural Rows Using Multimodal Leaf Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08603)
*Rishi Gupta,Astha Goyal,Vinay Vishwakarma*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CropSentry是一种低成本地面多机器人系统，通过多模态叶片传感连续监测作物健康并追踪胁迫水平，分类准确率达84.12%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当今早检测作物胁迫对提升效率、减少时间/资金/人力浪费十分必要，但高光谱成像与AI系统等现代技术对中小农户而言成本过高、过于复杂，难以落地。

Method: 系统由两个自主机器人组成，逐行连续检测叶片颜色与环境数据，观测结果进行空间映射后传至主机器人；主机器人以颜色编码的行段生成实时网页仪表盘以展示作物健康。实验共采集63次观测。

Result: 总体作物健康分类准确率为84.12%，其中健康植株82.60%、营养缺乏植株88%、病害植株80%；10次从机观测的无线通信成功率达100%。

Conclusion: 多机器人近距离叶片巡检可在保持可负担、可获取、可扩展的前提下检测作物早期胁迫，为农户提供及时信息以改进资源利用与作物管理。

Abstract: Early stress detection in crops is a necessity today to improve efficiency and reduce waste of time, money, and effort. However, most modern techniques, such as hyperspectral imaging and AI-based systems, are too costly and complex for medium and small-scale farmers to implement. This paper showcases CropSentry, a low-cost, ground-based multi-robot system that uses multimodal leaf sensing to continuously monitor crop health by tracking stress levels. The system comprises two autonomous bots that continuously detect leaf color and environmental data row by row. The observations are spatially mapped and sent over to the master bot, which uses color-coded row segments to generate a real-time web-based dashboard displaying crop health. After 63 observations were collected during the experiments, the results showed an overall crop health classification accuracy of 84.12%, with 82.60% for healthy plants, 88% for nutrient-deficient plants, and 80% for diseased plants. Also, 100% wireless communication success rate across 10 slave observations was achieved. Close-range leaf inspection across multiple bots can detect early stress in crops while remaining affordable, accessible, and scalable. It provides farmers with timely information to improve resource utilization and crop management.

</details>


### [236] [Feeling Through the Load: Compliant Quadruped Locomotion under Payload Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08637)
*Shaunak A. Mehta,Mayank Mishra,Prajit KrisshnaKumar,Sebastian Scherer,Koichiro Niinuma*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种力感知运动框架，将无约束负载上的人际交互视为指令来塑造机器人-负载系统的运动；该方法分离了力感知运动学习与力估计，结合柔顺载物策略与因果力估计器，并通过"估计器在环"的数据聚合与微调训练，用机载测量推断交互力，实现稳定载物行走、柔顺响应外力并支持人引导的轨迹变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 四足机器人日益需要在人类环境中携带物体行走，但现有研究多关注人与机器人本体的直接交互。当人直接作用于无约束负载时，机器人仍须区分"有意的外部交互"与"负载的普通运动"，同时保持负载平衡与行走稳定。如何仅凭机载测量推断此类交互并柔顺响应，是本文的核心问题。

Method: 提出力感知运动框架，将负载交互建模为塑造"机器人-负载"组合系统运动的指令。方法上对两项任务解耦：一是学习力感知运动（柔顺载物策略），二是估计无约束负载上的力（因果力估计器）。二者通过"估计器在环"（estimator-in-the-loop）的数据聚合与微调进行联合训练，使估计器从机载机器人测量中预测交互力。

Result: 仿真与真实世界实验表明，所得控制器能够：维持稳定的负载携带行走；对外部交互表现出柔顺顺从；并利用推断出的力支持人类引导下的机器人轨迹改变。

Conclusion: 结果表明，仅依靠机载测量即可实现"力感知+柔顺响应"的载物四足运动，为人-负载-机器人三者交互提供了可行方案。将交互力作为运动指令、并将运动学习与力估计解耦的思路，对四足机器人物理人机交互具有推广价值。

Abstract: Quadruped robots are increasingly expected to carry objects while moving through human environments. But what happens when a person interacts directly with the payload rather than with the robot? If the payload is unrestrained, the robot must distinguish intentional external interactions from ordinary payload motion, while still keeping the load balanced and maintaining stable locomotion. How can a quadruped infer and compliantly respond to such interactions using only onboard measurements? In this work, we develop a force-aware locomotion framework that treats payload interactions as commands that shape the motion of the combined robot-payload system. Our approach separates the learning of force-aware locomotion and force estimation on an unrestrained payload. We combine a compliant load-carrying policy with a causal force estimator, trained through estimator-in-the-loop data aggregation and finetuning, to predict interactions from onboard robot measurements. Our simulations and real-world experiments show that the resulting controller can maintain stable payload-carrying locomotion, yield compliantly to external interactions, and use the inferred force to support human-guided changes in the robot's trajectory.

</details>


### [237] [RIWANav: Recursive World-Action Models with Self-Improvement for Urban Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08640)
*Jing Xie,Shouwei Ruan,Yubin Wang,Yuxiang Zhang,Haitao Yang,Songchang Jin,Dianxi Shi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RIWANAV：一种面向长时程城市导航的后训练框架，将世界模型与动作模型的耦合自适应建模为任务特定的递归自我改进（RSI）循环，在想象反馈与自课程之间交替更新，性能优于现有基线并完成真实验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程城市导航依赖序列化的局部决策，误差会随时间累积。模仿学习（IL）难以从失败中学习，而真机试错式强化学习（RL）代价高昂。动作条件世界模型虽可通过对候选动作预测视觉后果来提供想象反馈，但冻结的世界模型会随策略演化而逐渐失准，因此需要世界模型与策略的协同自适应。

Method: 提出 RIWANAV 后训练框架，将世界模型与动作模型（策略）的耦合自适应形式化为任务特定的递归自我改进（RSI）。每一轮交替执行两步更新：（1）世界模型通过想象结果评估策略动作，为组相对策略优化（GRPO）提供对比反馈；（2）改进后的策略构建有依据的自课程，依据行为新颖性与预测误差挑选专家一致的动作-视频对。精炼后的世界模型再为下一轮策略更新提供反馈，从而闭合递归自我改进回路。

Result: 实验表明 RIWANAV 优于训练基线与先前方法，验证了策略与世界模型之间递归自我改进回路的有效性；真实世界试验进一步证明了其实际可用性。

Conclusion: 通过将世界模型与策略的协同演化组织成递归自我改进循环，RIWANAV 缓解了冻结世界模型随策略漂移而失效的问题，为长时程城市导航提供了一种可行且可落地的后训练方案。

Abstract: Long-horizon urban navigation requires sequential local decisions whose errors can compound over time. Imitation learning (IL) rarely learns from failures, while physical trial-and-error reinforcement learning (RL) is costly. Action-conditioned world models can provide imagined feedback by predicting visual consequences for candidate actions. However, a frozen world model may become less reliable as the policy evolves. In this paper, we introduce RIWANAV, a post-training framework that casts the coupled adaptation of a world model and an action model (policy) as task-specific recursive self-improvement (RSI). Each cycle alternates two updates. The world model evaluates policy actions through imagined outcomes, providing comparative feedback for group-relative policy optimization (GRPO). The improved policy then constructs a grounded self-curriculum, selecting expert-consistent action-video pairs by behavioral novelty and prediction error. The refined world model supplies feedback for the next policy update, closing the recursive self-improvement loop. Experiments show that RIWANAV outperforms training baselines and prior methods, validating the proposed recursive self-improvement loop between the policy and world model. Real-world trials further demonstrate its practical applicability.

</details>


### [238] [HygieneRoboBench: Benchmarking Hygiene-Aware Planning for Household Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08642)
*Yurun Chen,Josh Qixuan Sun,Jason Qin,Chengtai Li,Tianyi Wang,Mark Crowley,Wentao Zhu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 HygieneRoboBench 基准与 Hygiene-NSP 方法，用于评估和实现家用机器人在接触污染历史下的安全任务规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 家用机器人通过夹爪、工具和共用表面接触污染对象会传播风险，新接触可能使原计划不再安全。现有基准无法联合评估规划器如何从接触历史识别卫生风险，并在新接触事件后规划安全续行方案，同时满足时间、资源和用户优先级约束。

Method: 构建 HygieneRoboBench，含 624 个实例、134 个任务族，从给定执行历史评估家用任务的安全求解；任务涵盖两个夹爪与共用对象的污染、处理成本及用户优先级。采用受控的历史、画像与事件对比，配合独立计划评估，考察安全求解、用户优先级下的成本效率及对接触事件的响应。提出 Hygiene-NSP，结合 LLM 接地、接触历史重建与 CP-SAT，联合规划卫生处理与任务执行。

Result: 对基于 LLM 和符号规划器的评估表明，安全完成任务并不保证在用户优先级下具有最低执行成本。Hygiene-NSP 的安全求解率与最优安全求解率分别达 94.4% 与 90.4%，在全数据集上均高于所评估的基线规划器。

Conclusion: HygieneRoboBench 填补了接触历史驱动卫生风险与安全续行规划联合评估的空白，Hygiene-NSP 在安全性与成本最优性上优于基线，表明需将卫生处理与任务执行联合优化。

Abstract: Contact with contaminated objects can spread hazards through a household robot's grippers, tools, and shared surfaces, while new contacts can make an existing plan unsafe. Existing benchmarks do not jointly assess how planners identify hygiene risks from contact history and plan safe continuations after new contact events. Planners must do so within time and resource limits while respecting user priorities. We introduce HygieneRoboBench, with 624 instances across 134 task families, to evaluate safe resolution of household tasks from a given execution history. Tasks capture contamination through two grippers and shared objects, treatment costs, and user priorities. We combine controlled history, profile, and event comparisons with independent plan evaluation. These assess safe resolution, cost efficiency under user priorities, and responses to contact events. Evaluation of LLM-based and symbolic planners shows that safely completing a task does not guarantee the lowest execution costs under the user's priorities. To address this problem, we introduce Hygiene-NSP. It combines LLM-based grounding, contact-history reconstruction, and CP-SAT to jointly plan hygiene treatment and task execution under user priorities. Hygiene-NSP achieves safe resolution and optimal safe resolution rates of 94.4% and 90.4%, respectively. Both rates are higher than those of the evaluated baseline planners on the full dataset. Project page: https://euron-zc.github.io/HygieneRoboBench/.

</details>


### [239] [Fast Non-Parametric Heteroscedastic Imitation Learning With Geometric Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08650)
*Maximilian Mühlbauer,Arne Sachtler,Markus Knauer,Cem Küçükgenç,Yanlong Huang,Alin Albu-Schäffer,João Silvério*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种利用几何先验的非参数概率建模方法，以少样本、异方差不确定性条件下学习流形上的概率策略，支持快速更新与自适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从人类演示中学习概率策略需要数据高效且能快速适应新场景。现有非参数（通常基于核）方法要么忽略机器人中常见的流形几何结构，导致数据效率受限；要么虽几何感知，但不确定性估计不可靠或需要重新训练才能适应。

Method: 采用非参数方法，在数据稀缺与异方差不确定性场景中引入几何先验进行概率建模。基于时间或机器人状态构建策略，使用不可分离对角核捕捉相同维度输入输出各自由度之间的不确定性关系；通过优化公式实现快速更新（含位置与姿态的轨迹更新少于3 ms）。方法支持流形输入与流形输出（含大姿态变化），并借助任务参数化适配不同物体位姿。

Result: 在若干玩具示例及真实机器人操作任务中（自主执行与共享控制场景）进行了评估；更新速度上，含位置与姿态的轨迹更新少于3 ms。

Conclusion: 该方法兼顾流形几何感知、可靠不确定性估计与快速自适应更新，适用于数据稀缺下的概率策略学习及不同物体位姿的适应，在自主与共享控制任务中表现有效。

Abstract: When learning probabilistic policies from human demonstrations, data-efficient learning and fast adaptations to new scenarios are key requirements. One popular way to achieve intuitive and reliable adaptations is through non-parametric, typically kernel-based, methods. However, existing solutions either fail to account for the geometry of manifolds common in robotics, limiting data efficiency, or, when geometry-aware, provide unreliable uncertainty estimates or require retraining to adapt. We propose a non-parametric approach leveraging geometric priors in scenarios of data scarcity and heteroscedastic uncertainties for probabilistic modeling. We utilize the method to formulate policies based on time or robot state, where non-separable diagonal kernels allow capturing uncertainty relations between degrees of freedom for same-sized in- and outputs. Fast updates, requiring less than 3 ms for a trajectory involving both position and orientation are possible through an optimized formulation. Our approach supports both manifold-valued input and manifold-valued output with large orientation changes. Using task parameterization, adaptation to different object poses is easily possible. We evaluate the approach on a set of toy examples and on real robot manipulation tasks both in autonomous execution and in shared control scenarios.

</details>


### [240] [Magnet-Aware Control of Legged Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08653)
*J. Playan Garai,S. B. Djuve,C. McGreavy,M. Khadiv*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一套用于腿足机器人磁场建模、估计与动态补偿的控制框架，通过MuJoCo物理插件、逆磁场估计、磁感知MPC与WBC，使机器人可在更强磁场中稳定行走，抗扰能力提升2.5倍（力空间）与1.6-2倍（力矩空间），可运行区域增加29.34%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大科学装置中自主机器人可提升运行时间并减少人员暴露，但其强磁场会干扰传感器，并产生随位姿变化的机械力/力矩扰动（磁力扳量），使机器人失稳，传统反应式控制器难以应对。因此需要一个能建模、估计并动态补偿空间变化磁场扰动的控制框架。

Method: 1) 为MuJoCo开发自定义物理插件，对刚体单元所受磁力进行建模；2) 提出逆磁场估计框架，从四足机器人动力学响应及任意数量传感器读数中推断潜在磁场；3) 构建磁感知模型预测控制（MPC）与全身控制（WBC）架构，在运动过程中预测并抵消磁扰动。

Result: 通过仿真与实机硬件实验验证：相比未补偿系统，本方法在力空间将最大可抑制磁扰提升约2.5倍，在力矩空间提升约1.6–2倍；在所提磁场范围内，机器人可运行面积增加29.34%，其中10.84%的区域此前会导致未补偿控制器立即崩溃。

Conclusion: 该框架可有效提升腿足机器人在强磁场环境下的鲁棒性与可运行范围，为大科学设施中的自主机器人作业提供了建模、估计与控制一体化的解决方案。

Abstract: Autonomous robots can increase uptime and reduce human exposure in Big Science facilities, but strong magnetic fields needed for their operation corrupt sensors and induce pose-dependent mechanical wrenches that destabilize robots and challenge conventional reactive controllers. This paper presents a control framework for modeling, estimating, and dynamically compensating for spatially varying magnetic wrenches acting on legged robots to improve robustness in these fields. We introduce a custom physics plugin for the MuJoCo simulator to model magnetic forces on rigid-body elements, alongside an inverse field-estimation framework to infer the latent magnetic field directly from quadruped dynamic responses and any number of sensor readings. Furthermore, we develop a Magnet-Aware Model Predictive Control (MPC) and Whole-Body Control (WBC) architecture that predicts and counteracts magnetic perturbations during locomotion to increase the range of magnetic fields in which the robot can operate. The effectiveness of the framework is validated through both simulation and physical hardware experiments. We show our method increases the the maximum rejectable disturbances from magnetic field in the force space by a factor of 2.5 and and between 1.6-2 times in torque space compared to a non-compensated system. Within the proposed magnetic field, this constitutes an increase in the area in which the robot can operate by 29,34% of which 10,84% would have previously caused an immediate collapse to non-compensated controllers.

</details>


### [241] [NMPP: Nonlinear Model Predictive Planning for Agile UAV Flight in Cluttered Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08695)
*Ondřej Procházka,Juraj Pauko,Robert Pěnička,Martin Saska*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出非线性模型预测规划（NMPP），将感知障碍作为硬几何约束，为无障碍SE(3)控制器提供全状态参考，显著降低跟踪误差并提升高速避障飞行成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 四旋翼在杂乱环境中飞行要求参考轨迹既无碰撞、又动态可行且满足执行器限制。现有方法或是仅在凸走廊内优化光滑多项式（敏捷性受限），或将障碍作为软代价与跟踪性能折中。

Method: 采用非线性模型预测规划（NMPP），把感知到的障碍建模为硬几何约束，并将全状态参考轨迹交给对障碍“盲”的SE(3)控制器进行精确跟踪。

Result: 相比线性模型预测控制轨迹规划器位置RMSE降低58–67%，相比多项式轨迹规划器降低41–70%；在森林飞行中最高9.5 m/s无碰撞完成全部飞行；在更激进速度剖面下成功率达86%，而某最优规划器仅26%；真实环境部署中可靠飞行至5.5 m/s。

Conclusion: 将障碍作为硬约束并由全状态SE(3)控制器跟踪，可在保持动态可行性的同时显著提升敏捷性与高速避障飞行可靠性，并在真实未知杂乱环境中得到验证。

Abstract: Flying a quadrotor through a cluttered environment requires not only planning a collision-free reference trajectory based on perceived obstacles, but the reference also needs to be dynamically feasible and within the actuation limits of the vehicle, so that the controller can track it precisely. Existing methods either optimize a smooth polynomial inside a convex corridor, which limits agility, or treat obstacles as soft costs traded against tracking performance. We propose a Nonlinear Model Predictive Planning (NMPP) that imposes perceived obstacles as hard geometric constraints and hands a full-state reference to an obstacle-blind SE(3) controller. Our planner achieves a 58-67 % lower position RMSE than a linear Model Predictive Control trajectory planner and a 41-70 % lower RMSE than a polynomial trajectory planner. It also completes all forest flights with up to 9.5 m/s speed without collisions, and achieves 86 % flight success rate under a more aggressive speed profile where a state-of-the-art planner has only 26 % success rate. The real-world deployment showed reliable execution flying up to 5.5 m/s in an unknown cluttered environment.

</details>


### [242] [EgoLAP: Learning from Egocentric Human Data through Language-Action Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08726)
*Lihan Zha,Shresth Grover,Tenny Yin,Samuel M. Bateman,Hengkai Pan,Mengchao Zhang,Aykut Onol,Allen Z. Ren,Dhruv Shah,Anirudha Majumdar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: EgoLAP通过共享的语言化动作思维链，将人类与机器人轨迹联合预训练，把具身无关的运动意图作为可迁移监督信号，实现跨具身VLA学习，真实任务进度达80.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器演示数据昂贵，自我中心人类数据可扩展机器人学习，但人类与机器人存在具身差异（embodiment gap），原始人类轨迹的低层动作难以直接作为控制监督目标。

Method: 提出EgoLAP，一种VLA预训练框架：将运动意图表示为结构化、时间抽象的语言动作，构建共享的语言化动作思维链（action chain-of-thought），并搭配基于场景几何、物理与物体可供性的运动级推理，联合学习人类与机器人轨迹。

Result: 在大量真实与仿真实验中，EgoLAP比替代动作表示更有效地将人类经验迁移至机器人控制，真实任务平均进度达80.1%，性能提升2.3倍；运动级推理优于由子任务、物体框与视觉轨迹推理组成的复合推理格式。

Conclusion: 低层动作虽具身相关，但其背后的运动意图可捕捉跨人类与机器人共享的任务结构；以语言化动作思维链为桥梁的预训练范式是跨具身迁移的有效路径。

Abstract: Egocentric human data offer a path to scaling robot learning beyond costly robot demonstrations, yet the embodiment gap makes raw human trajectories a poor supervisory target for control. Our key insight is that, although low-level actions are embodiment-specific, their underlying motion intent can capture task-relevant structure that transfers across humans and robots. We introduce EgoLAP, a VLA pre-training framework that jointly learns from human and robot trajectories through a shared language-based action chain-of-thought. EgoLAP expresses motion intent as structured, temporally abstracted language actions and pairs them with motion-level reasoning grounded in scene geometry, physics, and object affordances. Across extensive real-world and simulated experiments, EgoLAP transfers human experience to robot control more effectively than alternative action representations and reaches 80.1% mean real-world task progress, a 2.3x performance gain over alternative action representations. Motion-level reasoning also outperforms a composite reasoning format that combines subtask, object-box, and visual-trace reasoning.

</details>


### [243] [Towards an Extensible Benchmark for Spoken Dialogue with Social Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08733)
*Casey Kennington,Ross Mead,Saad Elbeleidy,Jesse Thomason*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于人机口语对话交互的基准，聚焦澄清请求、打断、具身信号和时间约束等口语对话现象，并提出用Retico实时通信框架支撑该基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型为人机交互提供了即插即用接口，但当涉及语音、对话、快速交互与协作时仍存在重要挑战。现有研究缺乏针对机器人与人类之间常见口语对话现象的标准化评测手段。

Method: 提出一个面向社区的基准，用于探索人机之间的典型口语对话现象，包括澄清请求、打断、具身信号（如点头或面部线索）以及时间约束；同时提出使用实时通信框架Retico来满足机器人实现口语对话能力的关键技术需求，并阐述了将基准扩展到其他人机交互方面的设想。

Result: 论文主要贡献为提出该基准及配套的Retico实时通信框架，用于支持机器人口语对话能力的实现；摘要未给出具体实验数据或定量结果。

Conclusion: 通过提供标准化基准与实时通信框架，可推动人机口语对话交互研究，并具备向更广泛人机交互问题扩展的潜力。

Abstract: Language models provide a plug-and-play interface between humans and robots, but important challenges remain when speech, dialogue, fast interaction, and collaboration are required. We propose a benchmark for the community to use as a way to explore common spoken dialogue artifacts between robots and humans, including requests for clarification, interruptions, embodied signals (e.g., head nods or facial cues), and time constraints. We also explain our vision to extend the benchmark for other aspects of human-robot interaction that are important to the larger research community. To facilitate the benchmark, we further propose using \textit{Retico}, a real-time communication framework that fulfills important technical requirements to enable robots to have spoken dialogue capabilities.

</details>


### [244] [PhoneBot: A Low-Cost Open Humanoid Robot Platform Reusing Smartphones](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08737)
*Ruochen Hou,Quanyou Wang,Daniel Koh,Dennis W. Hong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出PhoneBot：以智能手机作为感知与计算核心的低成本开源人形机器人平台，通过13个低成本执行器驱动模块化下肢，实现稳定行走及视觉跟随、对话交互、拍摄与移动临场感等功能，并验证了可靠性与易部署性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人在教育与研究中的普及受限于高硬件成本、复杂传感系统与高算力需求，亟需低成本、易复现的替代方案。

Method: 将商用智能手机复用为机器人的主要感知与计算单元，利用其IMU、摄像头、无线通信与本地处理能力；采用模块化下肢结构，由13个低成本执行器驱动，躯干搭载手机承担感知、控制计算与人机交互；并设计机械结构、软件架构与实时通信框架以支撑稳定运动与多种交互能力。

Result: 实验评估显示机器人可实现可靠行走、感知驱动的交互，并可用市售消费级智能手机直接完成部署。

Conclusion: PhoneBot以全开源软硬件设计提供了可负担、可复现的平台，适用于教育、研究与快速原型开发。

Abstract: The adoption of humanoid robots in education and research remains limited by high hardware costs, complex sensing systems, and substantial computational requirements. This paper presents PhoneBot, a low-cost, open-source humanoid robot platform that repurposes commodity smartphones as its primary sensing and computing unit. By using a smartphone's integrated inertial measurement unit (IMU), camera, wireless connectivity, and onboard processing capabilities, PhoneBot reduces hardware costs and simplifies the system architecture. The robot combines a modular lower-body structure driven by 13 low-cost actuators with a torso-mounted smartphone that supports perception, control computation, and user interaction. We describe the mechanical design, software architecture, and real-time communication framework that support stable locomotion and capabilities including vision-based human following, conversational interaction, filming, and mobile telepresence. Experimental evaluations demonstrate reliable walking, perception-driven interaction, and straightforward deployment using off-the-shelf consumer smartphones. With fully open-source hardware and software designs, PhoneBot provides an affordable, reproducible platform for education, research, and rapid prototyping. More details are available at https://phonebot.dev.

</details>


### [245] [LBA-CBF: Rapidly Adaptive Safety Filters via Parallel Dynamics Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08765)
*Maitham F. AL-Sunni,Timeea-Andreea Radu,Hassan Almubarak,Henry Z. Liao,Michael Görner,Francesco Maurelli,John M. Dolan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: LBA-CBF通过短回溯窗口内预测误差对候选动力学模型库排序，并对最优模型容差范围内的所有模型施加高阶CBF约束，从而在突发未测工况变化下保持安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 控制屏障函数（CBF）基于假定动力学模型认证控制指令，当发生突发且不可测的工况变化（如风反转、载荷变化）时，模型失配会使安全证书在安全最关键的時刻失效。需要一种无需切换模型或连续参数估计器、能应对非线性未知参数的自适应安全控制方法。

Method: 提出Look-Back Adaptive Control Barrier Functions（LBA-CBF）：维护一个有限候选动力学模型库，利用短回溯窗口内的近期预测误差对模型进行排序；对与最优模型误差在容差内的所有模型均施加高阶CBF条件，实现从最优拟合自适应到全库鲁棒滤波的连续谱。动力学可对未知参数非线性依赖，无需切换模型或连续参数化估计器。

Result: 理论上证明：只要保留了一个安全代表性候选模型，任何可行的滤波后输入均满足真实CBF条件。四旋翼仿真中面对突发风反转与未知载荷，LBA-CBF在所有随机初始条件下均安全并到达目标，与oracle相当，而自适应与鲁棒基线成功率仅0-88%。模型库规模达250,000仍可实时运行在控制回路内；Crazyflie 2.1与F1TENTH实验验证了其对风、载荷释放及轮胎-路面摩擦变化的适应性。

Conclusion: LBA-CBF提供了一种可扩展、无需显式切换或连续估计的自适应安全控制框架，通过误差排序与容差内多模型约束兼顾适应性与鲁棒性，在仿真与实物平台上均验证了其在突发工况变化下的安全性与有效性。

Abstract: Control barrier functions (CBFs) certify commands through an assumed dynamics model, so an abrupt, unmeasured regime change can undermine the certificate exactly when safety matters most. We present Look-Back Adaptive Control Barrier Functions (LBA-CBF), which rank a finite bank of candidate dynamics by recent prediction error over a short look-back window and enforce the high-order CBF condition against every model within a tolerance of the best, spanning best-fit adaptation to full-bank robust filtering. The dynamics may depend nonlinearly on the unknown parameters, and no switching model or continuously parameterized estimator is required. We prove that any feasible filtered input satisfies the true CBF condition whenever a safety-representative candidate is retained. In quadrotor simulation with abrupt wind reversals and an unknown payload, LBA-CBF is safe and reaches the goal from all random initial conditions, matching an oracle, while adaptive and robust baselines achieve 0-88% success. Banks of up to 250,000 models run inside the control loop, and Crazyflie 2.1 and F1TENTH experiments demonstrate adaptation to wind, payload release, and varying tire-road friction. Code, videos, and project details are available at: https://lla-control.github.io

</details>


### [246] [DepthWorld: 3D World Model for Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08780)
*Jai Bardhan,Josef Sivic,Vladimir Petrik*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该文提出标定流程构建了DROID-3D数据集，并训练了联合预测多视角RGB与深度的世界模型DepthWorld，实现一致的3D几何。 


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于视频的世界模型仅用RGB训练，逐帧看似正确但无法构成一致的3D世界，而机器人策略评估、改进与规划都依赖可靠的3D几何；同时该领域缺乏大规模3D监督，且新架构需在不破坏预训练视频先验的前提下吸收深度信息。

Method: 提出标定流程：将学习到的立体深度与联合因子图结合，汇集同一物理机器人采集的所有Episode，同时恢复其共享运动学参数与各场景外参，应用于DROID数据集得到DROID-3D（含密集度量深度与重标定多视角外参）。再基于Stable Video Diffusion训练DepthWorld，通过空间隐变量分块（spatial latent tiling）联合预测多视角RGB与深度，保持预训练VAE不变。

Result: DROID-3D在90%的Episode上外部相机重投影误差小于0.7 px；DepthWorld在相同训练预算下，深度监督使RGB预测比纯RGB基线提升+1.48 dB PSNR，同时输出准确度量深度供下游几何推理使用。

Conclusion: 深度监督不仅不损害反而增强视频先验，能在同一模型中同时获得更优RGB生成与可靠3D几何，为机器人世界模型提供数据与架构两方面的可行路径。

Abstract: World models offer a data-driven alternative to traditional simulators for robotics, with applications spanning policy evaluation, improvement, and planning. All of these uses depend on faithful 3D geometry, yet current video-based world models are trained on RGB alone and produce rollouts that look correct frame-by-frame but do not compose into a consistent 3D world. Closing this gap requires progress on two fronts: large-scale 3D supervision for manipulation, and an architecture that can absorb it without disturbing strong pretrained video priors. We introduce a calibration pipeline that combines learned stereo depth with a joint factor graph, pooling all episodes collected from the same physical robot to recover its shared kinematic parameters alongside per-scene extrinsics. Applied to the DROID dataset, this yields DROID-3D, a calibrated 3D dataset providing dense metric depth and recalibrated multi-view extrinsics (achieving <0.7 px reprojection error on 90% of episodes for external cameras). We then train DepthWorld, a Stable Video Diffusion-based world model that jointly predicts multi-view RGB and depth via spatial latent tiling, leaving the pretrained Variational Autoencoder (VAE) unchanged. Depth supervision improves RGB prediction itself by +1.48 dB PSNR over an identical RGB-only baseline at equal training budget, while simultaneously yielding accurate metric depth for downstream geometric reasoning.

</details>


### [247] [PEARS: Physical-Prior-Guided Efficient Adaptation via Failure Reasoning and Diffusion Steering for Tactile Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08784)
*Kun Song,Yiming Wang,Yilin Chen,Tianyi Ding,Jiaxin Tian,Tianqi Gong,Daolin Ma,Jia Pan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出PEARS，一种物理先验引导的混合强化学习框架，利用触觉反馈实现预训练策略的高样本效率在线自适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练机器人策略在部署中遇到分布外（OOD）条件时性能显著下降，需要真实交互后训练；但基于强化学习的后训练通常需要大量环境交互，在操作任务中每次试验缓慢、昂贵甚至具破坏性，因此亟需提高样本效率。

Method: PEARS由两部分组成：1）物理引导力推理（PFR）模块，每回合结束后利用VLM中编码的物理先验，从视觉结果与触觉交互历史诊断失败原因，并更新任务合适的接触力边界；2）高频混合力-位置控制器在接触阶段执行这些力边界约束；3）触觉条件扩散引导强化学习，调整冻结流匹配策略的潜在噪声，以纠正自由空间运动与接触时机误差，且不更新基础模型。

Result: 仿真中成功率相比各任务最强基线提升12.4–37.4个百分点；达到特定成功率阈值所需交互回合数相比最快基线最多减少53.2%；真实实验中在白板擦除任务成功率达95%，移液管液体吸取任务达90%。

Conclusion: 将PFR模块与策略引导相结合，可加速预训练策略的在线自适应，同时减少昂贵交互次数。

Abstract: Pretrained robotic policies can suffer substantial performance degradation under out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions encountered during deployment, motivating post-training through real-world interaction. However, reinforcement-learning (RL)-based post-training typically requires substantial environment interactions, a burden that is especially significant in manipulation, where each trial can be slow, costly, or destructive. Therefore, we present PEARS, a physics-prior-guided hybrid RL framework for sample-efficient online adaptation of pretrained policies with tactile feedback. After each episode, its physics-guided force reasoning (PFR) module uses physical priors encoded in a vision-language model (VLM) to diagnose failures from the visual outcome and tactile interaction history and update task-appropriate contact-force bounds. A high-frequency hybrid force-position controller then enforces these bounds during contact. Complementarily, tactile-conditioned diffusion steering reinforcement learning adjusts the latent noise of the frozen flow-matching policy to correct errors in free-space motion and contact timing without updating the base model. In simulation, PEARS improves success rates by 12.4-37.4 percentage points over the strongest per-task baselines. PEARS also reduces the number of interaction episodes required for a certain success threshold by up to 53.2% relative to the fastest baseline. In real-world experiments, PEARS achieves success rates of 95% on Whiteboard Erasing and 90% on Pipette Liquid Aspiration. These results show that combining the PFR module with policy steering can accelerate adaptation while reducing costly interactions. The project website is available at https://song-kun.github.io/pears.

</details>


### [248] [QF3: Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08789)
*Chung Min Kim,Brent Yi,David McAllister,Hongsuk Choi,Himanshu Gaurav Singh,Jinkun Cao,Ken Goldberg,Pieter Abbeel,Carmelo Sferrazza,Angjoo Kanazawa*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: QF3是一种在线离策略强化学习算法，通过流匹配与经滤的Q梯度训练流策略，实现人形运动策略从零训练并零样本迁移到硬件，较FPO++取得10倍墙钟加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流策略已成为从演示中学习机器人行为的标准策略类，但强化学习对于改进预训练流策略或通过交互从零学习仍然关键。现有流RL方法（如FPO++）多为在策略方法，效率较低，且难以从零训练并直接迁移到真实硬件。

Method: 提出QF3（Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients）在线离策略RL算法：以流匹配加上评论家的动作梯度来训练流策略，梯度通过对流输出的一步预测进行反向传播；为使更新保持在评论家与预测可靠的区域，QF3仅对保持在回放动作附近（near the replay action）的动作维度施加评论家梯度，即Q梯度过滤。结合高吞吐离策略训练配方。

Result: QF3是首个从零训练人形运动策略并零样本迁移到硬件的离策略流RL方法；在腿部运动与动作跟踪任务上较近期在策略流RL方法FPO++取得约10倍墙钟加速；进一步在ABC-Sim与Robomimic任务上微调预训练流式操作策略。

Conclusion: 结果表明QF3既能从零学习机器人策略，也能精炼从演示中获得的策略，兼具从零学习与演示精炼能力。

Abstract: Flow policies have become a standard policy class for learning robot behaviors from demonstrations, but reinforcement learning is still critical for improving pre-trained flow policies or learning them from scratch through interaction. We introduce QF3 (Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients), an online off-policy RL algorithm that trains a flow policy with flow matching plus the critic's action gradient, backpropagated through a one-step prediction of the flow's output. To keep updates where the critic and this prediction are reliable, QF3 applies the critic gradient only to action dimensions that stay near the replay action. To our knowledge, QF3 is the first off-policy flow RL method to train humanoid locomotion policies from scratch and transfer them zero-shot to hardware. Paired with a high-throughput off-policy training recipe, it trains humanoid locomotion and motion-tracking policies with a 10x wall-clock speedup over FPO++, a recent on-policy flow RL method. We further apply QF3 to fine-tune pretrained flow-based manipulation policies on both ABC-Sim and Robomimic tasks. These results suggest that QF3 can both learn robot policies from scratch and refine those acquired from demonstrations. Website: https://qf3-rl.github.io/

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [249] [GAMEGO: Training Game-Dev Agents with Synthetic Trajectories Anchored in Real-World Assets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06910)
*Haoyue Yang,Jingyao Li,Zhengfan Wu,Jing Liu,Xuanle Zhao,Kang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出GameGo框架，将简短的游戏种子系统性转化为完整的产品需求文档，结合动态压缩构建GameGoData数据集（55,060条轨迹）与GameGoBench（124个查询），训练出GameGoCoder模型，在游戏开发基准上超越同类基线并接近前沿模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在Web前端执行能力（尤其是浏览器游戏生成）表现突出，但已有工作多依赖复杂多轮工作流或聚焦静态评测基准。直接根据稀疏用户查询端到端生成复杂游戏时，编码智能体常被迫做出欠约束假设，导致机制不完整、玩法流程割裂、视觉表现有限。

Method: GameGo是一个可扩展框架：将简短游戏种子系统性转化为基于行业游戏开发实践的完整产品需求文档（PRD）；采用任务特定的动态压缩，在不限制设计探索的前提下最大化信息密度并保持指令遵循能力。基于该流程构建GameGoData（覆盖2D、2.5D、3D游戏的55,060条开发轨迹）和GameGoBench（124个多样化游戏查询），并训练GameGoCoder模型。

Result: 在GameGoData上训练的GameGoCoder在游戏开发基准上优于规模匹配的基线模型，性能与前沿模型相当。所有代码、数据集和模型将公开。

Conclusion: 通过PRD驱动的数据合成与动态压缩，GameGo实现了从稀疏查询到复杂游戏的端到端合成，验证了高质量数据流水线在提升编码智能体游戏生成能力上的有效性。

Abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in web front-end execution, with browser-based game generation emerging as a particularly prominent frontier. While previous efforts frequently rely on complex multi-turn workflows or focus on static game evaluation benchmarks, this work targets direct end-to-end real-world game synthesis driven by coding agents. However, generating complex games directly from sparse user queries often forces coding agents to make underspecified assumptions, yielding incomplete mechanics, disconnected gameplay flows, and limited visual aesthetics. To resolve this issue, this paper presents GameGo, a scalable framework that systematically transforms brief game seeds into comprehensive Product Requirements Documents grounded in industry game-development practices. To retain core gameplay constraints without restricting design exploration, GameGo uses task-specific dynamic compression to maximize information density while preserving instruction following. Based on this pipeline, GameGoData is constructed with 55,060 development trajectories across 2D, 2.5D, and 3D games, alongside GameGoBench, a benchmark comprising 124 diverse game queries. Training GameGoCoder on GameGoData yields a model that outperforms matched baselines and is comparable to frontier models across gamedev benchmarks. All code, datasets, and models will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [250] [Text2Dashboard: A Governed Agent Architecture for Natural-Language Dashboard Generation over Enterprise DataBrain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06914)
*Yiou Wu,Zezhi Tang,Ningwei Bai,Liuhaichen Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Text2Dashboard 是一个面向 DataBrain 的原型系统，将自然语言分析请求转化为可审查的仪表盘，通过模型提议动作、确定性软件控制执行，并在小规模任务与故障注入中验证了可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将自然语言分析请求自动转化为可审查、可审计的仪表盘，同时保证执行过程受控、安全且可恢复；并通过原型验证该工作流的可行性。

Method: 结合 Codex 插件与独立 Agent Runtime，采用 schema 约束的模型决策与类型化工具，配合持久化状态和确定性 Hooks（用于审批、审计、检查点、恢复与故障处理）；流程包括实体解析、元数据发现、只读 SQL 强制、仪表盘组合，以及静态检查、动态预检和浏览器检查。

Result: 在冻结的真实 DataBrain 任务与受控 Hook 故障上评估：元数据与 SQL 任务严格成功率 6/8（元数据选择 4/4 通过，四个 SQL 任务均满足语义标准，2/4 满足精确输出列契约）；最终版本通过 4/4 单面板仪表盘任务、1 个双面板任务和 1 个既有仪表盘精化任务，一个参数化任务超出步数限制；十个故障场景均达到预期且无未授权外部副作用；模型推理在每组中占观测运行时 97% 以上。

Conclusion: 这些规模较小、特定于 DataBrain 的结果尚不足以证明生产可用性、通用 text-to-SQL 准确性，或相对于人工构建仪表盘的效率优势。

Abstract: Text2Dashboard is a DataBrain-specific prototype that turns natural-language analytic requests into inspectable dashboards. An installable Codex plugin and standalone Agent Runtime combine schema-constrained model decisions with typed tools, persistent state, and deterministic Hooks for approval, audit, checkpointing, recovery, and failure handling. The pipeline resolves entities, discovers metadata, enforces read-only SQL, composes dashboards, and applies static checks, dynamic preflight, and browser inspection. The model proposes actions while deterministic software controls execution and records state transitions.
  We evaluate the workflow on frozen real-DataBrain tasks and controlled Hook faults. Strict success was 6/8 on metadata and SQL tasks: metadata selection passed 4/4, all four SQL tasks met semantic criteria, and 2/4 met the exact output-column contract. The final release passed 4/4 single-panel dashboard tasks, one two-panel task, and one existing-dashboard refinement; a parameterised task exceeded its step limit. All ten fault scenarios met their specified outcomes without unapproved external side effects. Model inference accounted for over 97\% of observed runtime in every reported group. These small, DataBrain-specific results do not establish production readiness, general text-to-SQL accuracy, or an efficiency advantage over manual dashboard construction.

</details>


### [251] [FluidPD: In-Place Elasticity for SLO-Aware Prefill-Decode Disaggregated LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06917)
*Kartik Ramesh,Kaidi Fu,Zihan Zheng,Jiahuan Yu,Fabio Oliveira,Carlos Costa,Minjia Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FluidPD 是一个面向 P/D 分离式 LLM 服务系统的 SLO 感知原地弹性方案，通过 FluidToken 与 FluidRole 两个机制应对瞬态和持续性的 prefill/decode 负载失衡，在 Azure 生产负载上将 SLO 达成率较静态 SGLang 最高提升 94.6 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 P/D 分离服务系统多采用固定的 prefill/decode 工作节点比例配合请求路由。然而真实负载既存在短时突发，也存在 prefill-to-decode 需求比的持续漂移，使得某一时刻配置良好的比例很快失配，即便其他节点存在空闲算力也会导致延迟 SLO 违约。现有自动扩缩容虽可增加容量，但响应慢、需额外 GPU，且无法直接解决短时间尺度的阶段失衡问题。

Method: FluidPD 提供 SLO 感知的原地弹性，包含两个互补机制：FluidToken 在 decode 侧存在空闲算力时，将有限比例的 prefill 计算卸载至 decode worker，以处理瞬态失衡；FluidRole 在原地重新分配运行中的 worker 的 prefill/decode 角色，避免模型重载与引擎重启，以处理持续性失衡。两个机制均由轻量级 pressure index 驱动，可在资源压力演变为 SLO 违约之前予以暴露。

Result: 在 Azure 生产 trace 负载上，FluidPD 相比静态 SGLang 将整体 SLO 达成率最高提升 94.6 个百分点。

Conclusion: SLO 感知的原地 P/D 弹性可在不额外配置 worker 的前提下提升服务质量，验证了在 P/D 分离服务中同时应对瞬态与持续性阶段失衡的有效性。

Abstract: Prefill-decode disaggregation is becoming a common architecture for LLM serving because it separates two phases with distinct execution patterns and SLO objectives. Existing systems typically combine a fixed prefill/decode worker ratio with request routing across workers. However, real-world workloads exhibit both short bursts and sustained shifts in the prefill-to-decode demand ratio. As a result, a configuration that is well provisioned at one time may quickly become mismatched, causing latency SLO violations even when idle capacity exists elsewhere. Existing autoscaling mechanisms can add capacity, but they react slowly, require spare GPUs, and do not directly address short-timescale phase imbalance.
  We present FluidPD, a P/D-disaggregated serving system that provides SLO-aware in-place elasticity. FluidPD introduces two complementary mechanisms. FluidToken handles transient imbalance by offloading a bounded portion of prefill computation to decode workers when decode-side slack is available. FluidRole handles sustained imbalance by reassigning running workers between prefill and decode roles in place, avoiding model reload and engine restart. Both mechanisms are guided by lightweight pressure indices that expose prefill and decode-side resource pressure before they appear as SLO violations. Across production Azure trace workloads, FluidPD improves overall SLO attainment over static SGLang by up to 94.6 percentage points, demonstrating that SLO-aware in-place P/D elasticity improves service quality without provisioning additional workers.

</details>


### [252] [Anchor Divergence for Semantic Geometry in Contrastive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06919)
*Akash Kannan,Kiho Park,Victor Veitch*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出“锚点散度”（Anchor Divergences），通过锚点分布与Bregman几何的对应关系，在固定表示上指定上下文相关的语义几何。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 余弦相似度提供单一固定几何，但语义相似性本质依赖上下文：两幅图像可能因同一物体、相似风格或同一临床发现而相似，单一几何无法刻画这种多义性。

Method: 利用对比学习、指数族与信息几何之间的相互作用，建立“锚点上的概率分布”与“表示空间上的Bregman几何”之间的对应；据此定义Anchor Divergences，用于在固定表示上指定特定上下文的语义几何。该对应意味着对锚点分布建模即是对几何本身建模。

Result: 检索实验表明，锚点散度能够有效且高效地指定上下文相关的语义相似度。

Conclusion: 对比表示天然包含一族可特化于特定语义结构的几何，锚点分布与Bregman几何的对应为上下文相关相似度提供了统一且实用的建模框架。

Abstract: This paper concerns how semantic context determines geometry in learned vector representations. Similarity is typically measured using cosine similarity, which provides a single fixed geometry. Semantic similarity, however, is inherently context dependent: two images may be similar because they depict the same object, share a visual style, or are relevant to the same clinical finding. We show that contrastive representations naturally encompass a family of geometries that can be specialized to particular semantic structure. The key idea is to use an interplay between contrastive learning, exponential families, and information geometry to establish a correspondence between probability distributions over "anchors" and Bregman geometries on the representation space. We use this correspondence to define "Anchor Divergences", a method for specifying context-specific semantic geometries on fixed representations. Under this correspondence, modeling the anchor distribution models the geometry itself. Experiments on retrieval show that anchor divergences provide an effective and efficient way to specify context-specific semantic similarity.

</details>


### [253] [RadOnc-Agent: An LLM-Orchestrated Framework for AI Workflows Across the Radiotherapy Care Pathway](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06923)
*Caiwen Jiang,Shuoyang Wei,Songlin Zhao,Junyu Li,Jingyuan Chen,Wei Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 RadOnc-Agent——一个由大语言模型编排的智能体框架，将放疗流程形式化为四个临床阶段、提供 26 个可调用函数，实现跨阶段异构能力的统一调度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 放疗领域的人工智能能力目前分散在不同临床阶段、软件环境和数据模态中，与放疗从治疗决策到随访的纵向连续工作流形成割裂，缺乏统一协调机制。

Method: 构建智能体框架，将放疗形式化为四个临床阶段，通过对话界面提供 26 个可调用函数；由大语言模型控制器将临床意图映射为受 schema 约束的调用，维护患者与工作流上下文，并将请求路由至专科服务。评估采用 2,600 条单函数请求（7,800 次重复执行）、200 个预定义合成跨阶段场景（覆盖四阶段、600 次执行）以及来自 60 份去标识患者记录的 120 个真实工作流实例（360 次干净执行），并开展消融对比。

Result: 单函数执行中正确选择目标函数比例达 98.79%；脚本化跨阶段工作流完成率 96.50%；真实患者工作流完成率 96.67%。消融实验中，移除纵向状态使跨阶段完成率由 96.50% 降至 84.00%；关闭 schema 与身份校验使后端调度错配率由 0% 升至 95.28%（重放/测试评估）。

Conclusion: 结果证明了以 LLM 编排架构协调异构放疗能力与跨纵向工作流信息的技术可行性，但未验证临床正确性、临床实用性或前瞻性获益。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence has advanced individual radiotherapy tasks, yet these capabilities remain separated across clinical stages, software environments and data modalities. This fragmentation contrasts with the longitudinal radiotherapy workflow from treatment decision-making through follow-up. Here we present RadOnc-Agent, an agentic artificial-intelligence framework that formalizes radiotherapy into four clinical phases and provides 26 callable functions through a conversational interface. A large-language-model controller maps clinical intent to schema-constrained calls, preserves patient and workflow context, and routes requests to specialist services. We evaluated system execution using 2,600 single-function requests (7,800 repeat executions), 200 prespecified synthetic cross-stage scenarios spanning four phases (600 executions), and 120 workflow instances from 60 de-identified patient records (360 clean executions) representing decision-to-planning and planning-to-adaptation. RadOnc-Agent selected the intended function in 98.79% of single-function executions, completed 96.50% of scripted cross-stage workflows, and completed 96.67% of real-patient workflow executions. In comparative ablations, removing longitudinal state reduced cross-stage completion from 96.50% to 84.00%, while disabling schema and identity validation increased mismatched backend dispatch from 0% to 95.28% in a replay/test evaluation. These findings establish the technical feasibility of an LLM-orchestrated architecture for coordinating heterogeneous radiotherapy capabilities and information across longitudinal workflows; they do not establish clinical correctness, clinical utility or prospective benefit.

</details>


### [254] [Metonymic Circuits for Abstract Concept Grounding in Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06928)
*Jing Ding,Ziqiao Ma,Jiayuan Mao,Joyce Chai,Freda Shi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究揭示视觉Transformer如何通过"转喻式锚定"机制，用具体可解释的锚概念将视觉信号桥接到抽象语义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究抽象概念（如"愤怒"）在训练数据缺乏直接指称证据时，视觉Transformer如何将抽象概念与视觉信号建立联系。

Method: 在CLIP和DINO视觉编码器上应用Transcoders，恢复可与具体概念语义标签关联的中间特征，并追踪其在抽象概念识别电路中的贡献；在精心构建的图标数据集上进行实验，并通过因果干预验证。

Result: 发现结构化的转喻电路：感知基元主导早期层，类物体锚概念先于抽象目标出现；含渲染文字的图像则募集一条独立的"感知到文本"路径。

Conclusion: 因果干预验证转喻中间特征在抽象概念锚定中具有功能性作用，支持抽象概念通过具体锚概念进行转喻式锚定的假设。

Abstract: We study how Vision Transformers ground abstract concepts (e.g., angry) when training data provide limited direct referential evidence. We hypothesize a metonymic grounding mechanism in which abstract predictions are driven by concrete, interpretable anchor concepts (e.g., fire) that bridge visual signals to abstract semantics. By applying Transcoders on CLIP and DINO vision encoders, we recover intermediate features that can be associated with semantic labels for more concrete concepts, and trace their contributions in circuits underlying abstract concept recognition. Experiments on a carefully curated icon dataset reveal structured metonymic circuits, in which perceptual primitives dominate early layers and object-like anchors precede abstract targets. Images containing rendered text instead recruit a distinct perceptual-to-textual route. Causal interventions further validate that metonymic intermediates are functionally involved in grounding abstract concepts.

</details>


### [255] [Principles that Guide, Actions that Inform: Agent Evolution via Knowledge Abstraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06964)
*Bowen Ye,Yongchao Xu,Junkai Ma,Xiang Yin,Wenzhao Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 SAGA 框架，将 LLM 智能体的交互经验逐步抽象为情节描述、可复用流程与带适用条件的原理，并回注到决策中形成执行—抽象反馈闭环，在 ScienceWorld 与 ALFWorld 上提升任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体虽在交互环境中表现良好，但持续从经验中进化能力仍然有限。微调依赖参数访问且计算成本高，对大规模与闭源模型不灵活；外部记忆虽避免改参，却主要关注经验的表示与组织，所学知识仍与具体任务和情境紧密耦合，泛化性不足。核心难题是如何把具体交互转化为抽象、可复用的知识，以指导超越个体经验的未来决策。

Method: 提出 SAGA（Self-evolving Agents through Experience-Grounded Abstraction）。该框架渐进式地将交互轨迹转化为情节描述、可复用流程（procedures）和带明确适用条件的原理（principles），并保持与执行证据的链接。检索到的原理被实例化为任务特定指导，通过纠正性反馈与重采样来精炼候选动作。由此形成"执行—抽象"反馈闭环：积累的知识指导未来交互，新经验持续更新分层记忆。

Result: 在 ScienceWorld 与 ALFWorld 基准上取得了任务性能提升；消融实验表明情境化实例化（contextual instantiation）与动作调控（action regulation）对利用原理级知识具有重要作用。

Conclusion: SAGA 通过由经验驱动的知识抽象与利用，使 LLM 智能体无需参数更新即可持续进化，且关键在于将抽象原理重新落地为情境化、可调控的决策指导。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in interactive environments, yet their ability to continually evolve from experience remains limited. Although fine-tuning enables adaptation, its dependence on parameter access and high computational costs restrict its flexibility, especially for large-scale and closed-source LLMs. External memory offers an alternative by allowing agents to accumulate experience without modifying model parameters. However, existing methods mainly focus on experience representation and organization, while the acquired knowledge remains tightly coupled with specific tasks and contexts, limiting generalization. A key challenge is how to transform concrete interactions into abstract and reusable knowledge that guides future decisions beyond individual experiences.
  To address this challenge, we propose SAGA (\underline{\textbf{S}}elf-evolving \underline{\textbf{A}}gents through Experience-\underline{\textbf{G}}rounded \underline{\textbf{A}}bstraction), a framework for experience-grounded knowledge abstraction and utilization in LLM agents. SAGA progressively transforms interaction trajectories into episodic descriptions, reusable procedures, and principles with explicit applicability conditions, while maintaining links to execution evidence. Retrieved principles are instantiated into task-specific guidance and used to refine candidate actions through corrective feedback and resampling. This creates an execution--abstraction feedback loop, where accumulated knowledge guides future interactions and new experiences continuously update hierarchical memory. Experiments on ScienceWorld and ALFWorld demonstrate improved task performance, with ablation studies highlighting the importance of contextual instantiation and action regulation for leveraging principle-level knowledge.

</details>


### [256] [AegisFlow: A Multi-Agent Agentic AI Framework for Autonomous Remediation and Self-Healing in Fragile Data Ecosystems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06971)
*Muhammad Bilal Awan,Zubair Hussain,Abdul Shahid*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AegisFlow 是一个基于 LLM 的智能体自愈框架，通过 Watchdog 与 Repair 双智能体及影子补丁机制，将数据管道故障修复时间从约 170 分钟降至 3.2 分钟，补丁成功率达 92%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统数据管道脆弱，易因上游 schema 漂移、API 契约变更或网页 DOM 修改而失败；现有可观测性工具仅向人工工程师告警，导致 MTTR 高、运维疲劳。作者希望闭环打通"检测—修复"，减少人工介入。

Method: 提出 AegisFlow（Agentic Engine for Intelligent Self-healing and Graph-driven Operations for Workload remediation）：由 Watchdog 智能体采集运行时遥测，Repair 智能体基于 LLM 自动生成、测试并部署代码补丁；采用基于 MAPE-K 循环的非侵入式执行模型"并行影子补丁"（Parallel Shadow Patching），在数字孪生环境中生成并验证补丁。

Result: 在五类常见故障场景中评估：MTTR 改善 98.1%（平均每补丁 170 分钟降至 3.2 分钟），补丁成功率 92%；JSON schema 变更场景成功率 96%，标点漂移 98%，Shadow DOM 场景最低为 85%；释放约 98% 的数据工程 on-call 时间用于创新。

Conclusion: AegisFlow 实现了检测与修复的自动闭环，显著降低 MTTR 并提升补丁成功率；框架与部署无关，可作为插件集成到现有管道编排系统，对既有系统改动极小。

Abstract: Traditional data pipelines are notoriously brittle, often failing due to upstream schema drift, API contract changes, or website DOM modifications. Present observability tools only raise alerts but for human engineers, resulting in a high Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) and operational fatigue. In this paper we propose AegisFlow (Agentic Engine for Intelligent Self-healing and Graph-driven Operations for Workload remediation), a novel agentic framework that closes the loop between detection and resolution. AegisFlow uses a Watchdog agent to collect runtime telemetry and has a Repair agent to automatically create, test and deploy code patches based on Large Language Models (LLMs). The framework presents the non-intrusive execution model called Parallel Shadow Patching, a non-intrusive execution model based on the Monitor, Analyze, Plan, Execute, Knowledge (MAPE-K) loop to generate and verify patches in digital twin environments. Through experimental testing, we have evaluated AegisFlow across five common failure scenarios, and see 98.1 percent improvement in MTTR (from an average of 170 minutes per patch to 3.2 minutes) and a patch success rate of 92 percent . In particular, the system is successful in dealing with changes in the JSON schema (96 percent ) and punctuation drift (98 percent ), and is least successful in Shadow DOM cases (85 percent ). AegisFlow frees up about 98 percent of data engineering on-call time from firefighting and reallocates it towards innovation. The framework is deployment agnostic consisting of a system that can be deployed in a plugin fashion into an existing pipeline orchestration system with minimal uplift to the existing system.

</details>


### [257] [EPOCH: Reliable Discovery through Evidence-Governed Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06986)
*Binjie Guo,Aisheng Mo,Ruitong Li,Xinle Deng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出EPOCH——一种证据治理型AI研究智能体架构，通过任务契约、类型化记忆、主动证伪、准入检查与独立重放，解决候选方案被夸大发现、评价反馈被滥用的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI研究智能体在搜索程序、数学构造与证明时，通常只优化评估器反馈，而缺乏对反馈如何被解释、质疑与复用的治理机制。这导致脆弱但看似有前景的候选被当作发现推广，并混淆基准改进、有限证书与定理级声明。

Method: EPOCH实现一个证据治理的发现闭环，组合五要素：显式任务契约（task contracts）、类型化记忆（typed memory）、主动证伪（active falsification）、准入检查（admission checks）与独立重放（independent replay），使每个候选依据其支撑声明的强度与范围被评估。

Result: 在AlgoTune上取得最优聚合性能，平均归一化得分0.65（最强基线0.53）；在内部Math14套件取得最高平均分0.57；在官方测试重放下表现出有利的留出行为；在AgentHPO上领先描述性聚合。在十个发现问题上取得任务特定进展，包括可执行构造、优化算法、反例与证明支持的结果。

Conclusion: 证据治理是迈向既产出更强解、又产生更可信科学发现的AI研究智能体的必要一步。

Abstract: AI research agents are increasingly used to search over programs, mathematical constructions, and proofs. However, existing systems typically optimize evaluator feedback without adequately governing how that feedback is interpreted, challenged, and reused. As a result, promising but fragile candidates can be promoted as discoveries, while benchmark improvements, finite certificates, and theorem-level claims are too easily conflated. We introduce EPOCH, an evidence-governed architecture designed to close this gap. EPOCH implements an evidence-governed discovery loop by combining explicit task contracts, typed memory, active falsification, admission checks, and independent replay, so that each candidate is evaluated against the strength and scope of the claim it supports. EPOCH achieves state-of-the-art aggregate performance on AlgoTune, substantially exceeding the strongest baseline in mean normalized score (0.65 vs. 0.53), and attains the highest mean score on the internal Math14 suite (0.57). It further shows favorable held-out behavior under official-test replay and leads the descriptive aggregate on AgentHPO. Across ten discovery problems, EPOCH delivers substantial task-specific advances, including improved executable constructions, optimized algorithms, counterexamples, and proof-supported results. These advances demonstrate its ability to convert search into concrete progress across mathematical and computational domains. Together, the results suggest that evidence governance is a necessary step toward AI research agents that produce not only stronger solutions, but also more trustworthy scientific discoveries.

</details>


### [258] [When better traffic forecasts fail to improve signal control: a layered diagnostic study of forecast-to-decision value](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06992)
*Jianing Long,Xiaobin Li,Wuming Lei,Weiguang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文通过宣城29天重构需求的层级诊断研究，检验交通预测精度提升为何未转化为信号控制收益，发现主要瓶颈在于决策时泄漏、动作可辨识性不足及目标不一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提升交通预测精度通常被视为改善信号控制的前提，但实践中预测误差下降未必带来控制决策优化，二者之间存在“预测—决策鸿沟”，缺乏系统诊断手段。

Method: 基于中国宣城29天重构需求（其中7天为测试日），构建分层诊断框架：评估点预测、保形区间、依赖感知场景及匹配的闭环控制器；进行界面审计以识别决策时刻泄漏与动作可辨识性；修正时间接口后，将因果预测与5秒事件预言机在穷举联合动作搜索下对比，并设置合成正对照验证。

Result: 入口级与流向级预测相对历史均值分别降低MAE 4.03%与3.92%；标称90%保形区间边际覆盖率达90.72%，但高需求子集事后仅75.66%；9个受控交叉口中仅2个存在多个有效动作。合成正对照中未来信息使内部滚动成本降低61.5%；冻结测试日上，因果预测与事件预言机相对无未来滚动分别使排队车·秒增加6.09%和3.39%，预言机使溢流暴露降低3.78%，配对日自助法区间跨零。

Conclusion: 预测价值取决于时间可观测性、动作可辨识性、动态一致性与目标对齐四个条件，预测精度提升不足以自动转化为运营收益；所提协议可诊断预测改进失效的环节。

Abstract: Improved traffic forecasts do not necessarily yield better signal-control decisions. We investigate this gap through a layered diagnostic study using 29 days of reconstructed demand from Xuancheng, China, with seven dates reserved for testing. The framework evaluates point forecasts, conformal intervals, dependence-aware scenarios, and matched closed-loop controllers. Entry-level and movement-level forecasts reduce mean absolute error by 4.03% and 3.92%, respectively, relative to historical means. A nominal 90% conformal interval achieves 90.72% marginal coverage but only 75.66% on an ex-post high-demand subset. Interface audits identify decision-time leakage and reveal that only two of nine controlled intersections offer multiple effective actions. We correct the temporal interface and compare causal forecasts with a five-second event oracle using exhaustive joint-action search. A synthetic positive control demonstrates that future information can reduce the internal rollout cost by 61.5%. On the frozen test dates, however, causal forecasts and the event oracle increase queue vehicle?seconds by 6.09% and 3.39% relative to the matched no-future rollout, while the oracle reduces spillback exposure by 3.78%; paired-day bootstrap intervals cross zero. These findings indicate that forecast value depends on temporal observability, action identifiability, dynamics consistency, and objective alignment. The proposed protocol provides a practical way to diagnose where predictive improvements fail to translate into operational benefits.

</details>


### [259] [Joint upper-bound coverage and route-choice utility: an empirical evaluation on two urban proxy tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06995)
*Jianing Long,Xiaobin Li,Wuming Lei,Weiguang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文用冻结协议分离速度误差、联合路径上界覆盖率、路由选择与实际损失，基于北京和成都路网速度数据构建离线代理任务，发现联合覆盖率提升并不改善下游路由效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 更准确的交通预测或更高的不确定性覆盖率是否改善路由决策尚不清楚，需要将预测精度、区间覆盖率与下游路由效用解耦评估。

Method: 采用冻结协议，分离速度误差、联合候选路径上界覆盖率、路由选择与实际损失；使用北京与成都处理后路网速度数据，构建离线代理任务，每城含150个OD对、3条候选路径、14个测试日；在最小上界路由准则下比较原始90分位路径时间上界与联合校准上界。

Result: 联合覆盖率在北京M1由83.19%升至92.26%，成都M1由75.14%升至88.33%，成都M2由74.01%升至90.64%；但C2使迟到率分别增加0.1633、0.7848、0.9200个百分点，平均行程时间增加0.588、3.082、4.418秒。另一成都预测器对比中，速度MAE降低14.91%对应C0下迟到率降低1.4571个百分点。

Conclusion: 在这些冻结任务中，联合覆盖率不能作为下游路由效用的替代指标；离线结果不构成在线或因果收益的证据。

Abstract: Whether more accurate traffic forecasts or higher uncertainty coverage improve route decisions is unclear. We evaluate this question with a frozen protocol that separates speed error, joint candidate path upper bound coverage, route selection, and realized loss. Using processed road speed data from Beijing and Chengdu, we construct offline proxy tasks with 150 origin destination pairs, three candidate paths, and 14 test days per city. We compare raw 90th percentile path time bounds with jointly calibrated upper bounds under minimum bound route choice. Joint coverage rises from 83.19% to 92.26% in Beijing M1, from 75.14% to 88.33% in Chengdu M1, and from 74.01% to 90.64% in Chengdu M2. Yet C2 increases lateness by 0.1633, 0.7848, and 0.9200 percentage points, respectively, and mean travel time by 0.588, 3.082, and 4.418 seconds. In a separate Chengdu predictor comparison, a 14.91% reduction in speed mean absolute error accompanies a 1.4571 percentage point reduction in lateness under C0. Joint coverage is therefore not a surrogate for downstream route utility in these frozen tasks the offline results do not establish online or causal benefits.

</details>


### [260] [Topology-Consistent Task Planning over Cellular Workflow Complexes for LLM-based Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07004)
*Sen Zhao,Jia Tang,Ruiqi Kong,Zuyu Zhang,Lifeng Shen,Ding Zou,Xinyu He,Xu Zhang,Junwei Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TopoPlanner 是一个拓扑一致的工具规划框架，将工具依赖图提升为"胞元工作流复形"（cellular workflow complex），并以此作为拓扑感知上下文，使 LLM 智能体能够处理验证-纠正循环、分支汇聚与可复用中间状态等复杂工作流结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体任务规划器擅长处理顺序结构或类 DAG 结构，但难以应对真实工具编排中自然出现的验证-纠正循环、汇聚式分支合并以及可复用中间状态等模式。这些拓扑特征超出了一般有向图的表达能力，因此需要引入更丰富的结构表示。

Method: 方法包含三个核心步骤：(1) 将工具依赖图提升为胞元工作流复形（cellular workflow complex），提供拓扑一致的结构载体；(2) 通过余层（cosheaf）一致的胞元检索，从复形中检索与请求相关的闭合子复形（closed subcomplex）；(3) 在检索到的拓扑上执行多维结构推理，并将所得胞元表示接入规划 LLM，用于生成工具序列。

Result: 在四个工具规划基准上，针对拓扑引导的循环（loop）、合并（merge）以及循环-合并（loop-merge）工作流进行实验，TopoPlanner 在不同本地 LLM 骨干模型上均一致优于基于提示（prompt-based）和基于图增强（graph-enhanced）的基线方法。

Conclusion: 将拓扑学工具（胞元复形、余层一致性）引入 LLM 智能体规划，可有效弥补传统顺序/DAG 表示在循环、汇聚和中间状态复用等复杂工作流模式上的不足，且性能提升不依赖于特定骨干模型，具有较好的通用性。

Abstract: Task planning for LLM agents requires workflows that satisfy both user intent and complex sub-task dependencies. While existing planners work well for sequential or directed acyclic graph (DAG)-like structures, they struggle with workflow patterns such as verification-correction loops, convergent branch merging, and reusable intermediate states that arise naturally in real-world tool orchestration. We present TopoPlanner, a topology-consistent planning framework that lifts tool dependency graphs into cellular workflow complexes and uses them as topologyaware context for LLM tool planning. TopoPlanner retrieves a request-relevant closed subcomplex through cosheaf-consistent cellular retrieval, performs multidimensional structural reasoning over the retrieved topology, and interfaces the resulting cellular representation with the planner LLM for tool-sequence generation. Experiments on four tool-planning benchmarks with topology-guided loop, merge, and loop-merge workflows show consistent improvements over prompt-based and graph-enhanced baselines across different local LLM backbones.

</details>


### [261] [When to Rethink: Learning Multi-Perspective Self-Verification for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07018)
*Ziquan Zhu,Hanruo Zhu,Si-Yuan Lu,Morris Yu-Chao Huang,Yicheng Lin,Wei Han,Tianlong Chen,Mingyuan Wu,Hanchao Yu,Gaojie Jin,Lu Liu,Bo Sun,Tianjin Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 MOTIVE 框架，通过多视角自验证与可靠性引导的选择性重思，提升视觉语言模型多模态推理的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型虽在多模态推理上表现优异，但仍易生成看似合理却错误的答案。自验证可在不依赖外部评判者的情况下提升可靠性，但现有方法通常依赖单一验证准则或固定提示，导致可靠性估计不完整且不稳定。

Method: 作者先系统分析验证器能力与提示设计对验证性能的影响，发现更强验证器判断更可靠，且验证性能对提示选择高度敏感，无单一提示在各任务中占优。基于此提出 MOTIVE：从互补的验证视角评估候选答案，通过基于正确性的多视角验证学习，学习与正确性对齐的可靠性分数；推理时该分数驱动"接受或重思"决策，可靠答案直接返回，不确定答案触发历史引导的重思。

Result: 在多种多模态基准与 VLM 主干上的大量实验表明，MOTIVE 持续优于强自验证与自纠正基线；可靠验证改善了接受或重思决策，并减少不必要的推理轮次。

Conclusion: MOTIVE 实现了更可靠且高效的自验证，无需外部评判者即可提升多模态推理的可靠性与效率。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in multimodal reasoning, yet they remain prone to generating plausible but incorrect answers. Self-verification offers a practical way to improve answer reliability without relying on external judges, but existing methods typically depend on a single verification criterion or fixed prompt, resulting in incomplete and unstable reliability estimates. We first systematically analyze how verifier capability and prompt design affect verification performance. Our findings show that stronger verifiers provide more reliable judgments, while verification performance is highly sensitive to prompt choice, with no single prompt consistently dominating across tasks. Guided by these findings, we propose \texttt{MOTIVE}, a \textbf{M}ulti-View Self-Verificati\textbf{O}n wi\textbf{T}h Rel\textbf{I}ability-Guided Selecti\textbf{VE} Rethinking framework for reliable multimodal reasoning. \texttt{MOTIVE} evaluates each candidate answer from complementary verification perspectives and learns a correctness-aligned reliability score through correctness-grounded multi-view verification learning. During inference, this score governs an accept-or-rethink decision, allowing reliable answers to be returned directly while uncertain ones trigger history-guided rethinking. Extensive experiments across diverse multimodal benchmarks and VLM backbones demonstrate that \texttt{MOTIVE} consistently outperforms strong self-verification and self-correction baselines. Further results show that reliable verification improves accept-or-rethink decisions and reduces unnecessary reasoning turns, enabling more reliable and efficient self-verification without an external judge.

</details>


### [262] [Beyond Refusal Patterns: Safe-Role Internalization for Robust and Generalizable LLM Safety Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07023)
*Jinghao Pang,Jitai Hao,Qiang Huang,Zhaochun Ren,Jun Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 SSRFT 框架，将安全对齐重构为对预定义"安全角色"的内化，通过构建 SRQA 数据集使模型习得安全价值观而非拒绝模式，在鲁棒性、泛化性和减少过度拒绝方面优于标准 SFT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全对齐方法（SFT、RLHF）需要大量针对特定攻击的监督与计算资源，且存在浅层安全对齐和过度拒绝问题：模型倾向于学习显式拒绝模式而非内化安全价值观，导致对新型越狱攻击（如预填充攻击）鲁棒性差、跨域泛化能力弱，同时对良性查询产生不必要拒绝。

Method: 提出 SSRFT（Supervised Safe-Role Fine-Tuning），首个将安全对齐重构为"预定义安全角色内化"的框架。方法上构建 Safe-Role Question-Answer（SRQA）数据集，数据来源包括心理测量学问题、少量越狱提示及安全角色描述；在此基础上合成角色一致的回答，经过验证后扩展至多样化场景，从而让模型内化安全导向的价值观与原则，而非记忆显式拒绝模板。

Result: 在多种 Base 与 Instruct 模型上的实验表明：SSRFT 相比标准 SFT 实现更鲁棒、更可泛化的安全对齐；对预填充攻击（prefilling attacks）的鲁棒性显著提升，对未见越狱领域的泛化能力更强，同时在良性查询上降低了过度拒绝率，并保持了模型的通用能力。

Conclusion: 安全角色内化是一种相较"以拒绝为中心"的安全对齐范式的有效替代方案，能够在提升安全鲁棒性与泛化性的同时兼顾模型的可用性和通用能力。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable capabilities but remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that elicit harmful or unsafe outputs. Existing safety alignment approaches, including Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), often require substantial attack-specific supervision and computational resources, while remaining susceptible to shallow safety alignment and over-refusal. To address these challenges, we introduce SSRFT(Supervised Safe-Role Fine-Tuning), the first framework that reformulates safety alignment as the internalization of a predefined safe role. SSRFT constructs a Safe-Role Question-Answer (SRQA) dataset from psychometric questions, limited jailbreak prompts, and a safe-role description. Role-consistent responses are synthesized, validated, and expanded into diverse scenarios, enabling models to internalize safety-oriented values and principles rather than explicit refusal patterns. Experiments across multiple Base and Instruct models show that SSRFT achieves more robust and generalizable safety alignment than standard SFT. SSRFT shows substantially greater robustness to prefilling attacks and better generalization to unseen jailbreak domains, while reducing over-refusal on benign queries and preserving the model's general capabilities. These results establish safe-role internalization as an effective alternative to refusal-centric safety alignment. Warning: This paper contains examples of harmful and toxic language.

</details>


### [263] [Offline AI Modules: Voice-First Offline Architecture, Hardware Reference Stack, Quantization and Benchmarking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07026)
*Sunday Afariogun,Odunolaoluwa Jenrola,Zeinab Nezami*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对离线AI语音优先技术栈进行端到端基准评测，覆盖Jetson Orin NX与Raspberry Pi 5两级硬件、3个2-5B指令微调模型、4种量化格式，结论是Q4_K_M在体积与质量间权衡最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向非洲语言社区，语音是主要交互方式且网络不可靠或缺失，需要低功耗、社区可及的完全离线语音AI部署方案，而该技术栈此前缺乏端到端评测。

Method: 构建模块化语音优先离线架构、低成本硬件BOM与可复现量化及基准流水线；在TierB（Jetson Orin NX）与TierA（Raspberry Pi 5）上评测3个指令微调模型×4种量化格式，测部署指标（解码吞吐、对话延迟、内存、功耗）与多语质量（MasakhaNEWS主题分类准确率，覆盖英语、豪萨语、伊博语、尼日利亚皮钦语、约鲁巴语及分语种困惑度漂移）；语音识别用Ethio-ASR评测阿姆哈拉语和奥罗莫语。

Result: Q4_K_M在两级硬件上均为最佳体积-质量权衡：TierB上gemma-4-E2B-it在Q4_K_M下解码吞吐28.8 t/s、主题分类准确率89.2%；TierA上三个模型均运行在16GB内存预算内。

Conclusion: Q4_K_M量化可作为非洲语言社区离线语音AI部署的推荐配置，两级硬件均可支撑实际部署，为低资源语言场景提供了可复现的部署基线。

Abstract: The Offline AI Modules workstream enables practical, low-power, and community-accessible deployment of voice-first AI systems that operate fully offline. Designed for African language communities where speech is the dominant mode of interaction and internet connectivity is unreliable or absent, the workstream delivers three reinforcing components: a modular voice-first offline architecture, a low-cost hardware reference bill of materials, and a reproducible quantization and a reproducible quantization and benchmarking pipeline for instruction-tuned language models in the 2-5B parameter class. This paper presents the first end-to-end benchmark evaluation of the stack across two hardware tiers: an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX (TierB) and a Raspberry Pi5 (TierA). Three instruction-tuned models are evaluated across four quantization formats, assessed for deployment metrics (decode throughput, chat latency, memory, power) and multilingual quality (topic classification accuracy on MasakhaNEWS across English, Hausa, Igbo, Nigerian Pidgin, and Yoruba; per-language perplexity drift). Speech recognition is evaluated using Ethio-ASR on Amharic and Oromo across both tiers. The principal finding is that Q4_K_M quantization represents the best size-to-quality trade-off for deployment on both tiers: gemma-4-E2B-it achieves 28.8t/s decode throughput and 89.2% topic classification accuracy at Q4_K_M on TierB, while all three models run within the 16GB memory budget on TierA.

</details>


### [264] [JIVEAdapter: A Multi-Task Additive Low-Rank Adapter via Joint and Individual Variation Explained (JIVE)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07036)
*Sara Abdali,Pashmina Cameron*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: JIVEAdapter：受JIVE启发的多任务"加性"低秩适配器，将权重更新分解为跨任务共享的Joint结构与任务特有的Individual结构，二者近正交，支持Joint冻结复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有低秩适配器多为单任务，且以乘性方式表示每个权重更新，无法显式区分跨任务共享信息与任务特有信息。

Method: 将每个权重更新分解为所有任务共享的Joint结构加每任务Individual结构；对Individual施加近正交于Joint的惩罚以保证可解释性与分离性；在共享Joint池与各任务Individual池间自适应分配秩；Joint可一次性联合学习或按任务增量学习，随后冻结并作为新任务的先验复用，无需重训共享部分。

Result: 在GLUE与SuperGLUE上以DeBERTaV3-base为骨干，在匹配的每任务有效秩下，与强单任务及多任务低秩基线相当，且无需MoE等额外模块；当存在相关held-in任务时，冻结的Joint可通过复用该任务的Individual（仅需廉价的逐方向缩放）服务held-out任务，否则训练一个小的新Individual。

Conclusion: JIVEAdapter以加性低秩分解显式分离共享与任务特有信号，实现参数高效的多任务适配，并支持共享Joint的冻结复用与增量扩展。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning adapts pretrained models at a fraction of the cost of full fine-tuning, yet most low-rank adapters are single-task and represent each weight update multiplicatively, leaving no explicit account of what is shared across tasks and what is task-specific. We introduce JIVEAdapter, a multi-task "additive" low-rank adapter inspired by statistical Joint and Individual Variation Explained (JIVE). JIVEAdapter decomposes every weight update into a Joint structure shared across all tasks plus a per-task Individual structure, penalizes the Individual structures to be near-orthogonal to the Joint so shared and task-specific signal stay "interpretable" and separated, and allocates rank adaptively across a shared Joint pool and a per-task Individual pool. The Joint is learned once, jointly over a task group or incrementally, one task at a time, then frozen and reused as a prior for new tasks without retraining the shared part. On GLUE and SuperGLUE with DeBERTaV3-base, JIVEAdapter is competitive with strong single-task and multi-task low-rank baselines at a matched per-task effective rank, without extra modules such as MoE, and when a related held-in task exists its frozen Joint serves a held-out task by reusing that task's Individual with only a cheap per-direction scale, otherwise training a small new one.

</details>


### [265] [Inference-Time Projection for Physically Valid Biomolecular Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07037)
*Qurat-ul-ain,Yee Whye Teh,Charlotte M. Deane,Matteo Cagiada*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出两种闭式投影算子，在推理阶段对AF3风格扩散模型的$\hat{x}_0$施加物理约束，无需重训练即恢复完美物理有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AF3类共折叠模型虽结构精度高，但大量输出物理无效（链间原子重叠、配体键长键角畸变、环非平面、手性翻转）。现有方案或用物理势引导采样（成本与显存激增，大复合物无法推断），或微调模型（耗时且绑定特定架构）。作者观察到物理有效性可在推理时由采样器已有量完全验证，故将其建模为约束推断问题。

Method: 不改变去噪器及权重，将物理有效性作为约束推断问题，对扩散模型去噪后的干净坐标估计$\hat{x}_0$施加两个闭式投影算子：(1) 链间范德华投影，推开最严重冲突的原子对；(2) 配体距离几何投影，恢复键长、键角、内部接触、平面性和手性。两算子均为局部、稀疏、位移封顶，无需网络评估、梯度或重要性采样。

Result: 在Boltz-2与OpenFold-3两个独立模型上，跨五个基准（CASP15、CASP16、PoseBusters单体与复合物集、Boltz物理有效性测试集）验证，恢复完美物理有效性，同时保持结构精度与配体放置指标，运行时与显存开销可忽略。

Conclusion: 该方法模型无关、即插即用，可嵌入任意AF3风格采样器，为物理有效的全原子结构预测提供了实用路径。

Abstract: AlphaFold 3-style cofolding models predict biomolecular complexes with high structural accuracy, yet a large fraction of their outputs are physically invalid: chains overlap at interfaces, ligand bond lengths and angles are distorted, rings are non-planar, and stereocentres are inverted. Current approaches either steer the sampler with physics-informed potentials, which multiplies sampling cost and memory overhead making inference impossible on large complexes, or finetune the model, costing time and tying the fix to one architecture. We observe that, unlike structural accuracy, physical validity is fully verifiable at inference time from quantities the sampler already holds. We therefore treat physical validity as a constrained inference problem and introduce two closed-form projection operators applied to the diffusion model's denoised clean-coordinate estimate, $\hat{x}_0$: an inter-chain van der Waals projection that pushes apart the most severely clashing atom pairs, and a ligand distance-geometry projection that restores bond lengths, angles, internal contacts, planarity and chirality. Both operators are local, sparse and displacement-capped, require no network evaluations, gradients or importance sampling, and leave the denoiser and its weights untouched, so they can be dropped into any AF3-style sampler without retraining. Applied to two independently developed models, Boltz-2 and OpenFold-3, across five benchmarks (CASP15, CASP16, the PoseBusters monomer and complex sets, and the Boltz physical-validity test set), our method recovers perfect physical validity while preserving structural-accuracy and ligand-placement metrics. These gains are achieved with negligible runtime and memory overhead, providing a practical, model-agnostic route to physically valid all-atom structure prediction.

</details>


### [266] [CuratorMAS: Automating Dataset Curation via Multi-Agent Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07075)
*Yixin Zhang,Wenjie Feng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出多智能体协作框架 CuratorMAS 实现自动化数据集策展，将策展流程分解为可编程并行工作流，显著降低噪声率并提升下游模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高质量数据是可靠机器学习的基础，但数据集策展成本高且难以跨领域泛化。已有方法依赖人工设计的启发式规则或模型相关信号，限制了其在不同任务和用户查询上的适用性。

Method: CuratorMAS 是一个多智能体协作框架，编排多个智能体评估与策展数据集，将复杂策展过程分解为五个可编程执行阶段并构成可并行工作流：数据集探索（收集文件结构、约束线索等上下文）、在线检索领域知识以增强评估、推导评估准则并计算相应指标、据此执行过滤，最后由演化模块汇总评估结果并更新相关技能。

Result: 大量实验表明，CuratorMAS 可将噪声率最多降低 36.03 个百分点，同时使下游模型 F1 分数最多提升 8.88 个百分点。

Conclusion: CuratorMAS 通过多智能体协作与可编程并行工作流实现了灵活、自动化的数据集策展，在降低数据噪声和提升下游任务性能方面均取得显著效果。

Abstract: High-quality datasets are essential for reliable machine learning, but dataset curation remains costly and hard to generalize across domains. Existing methods typically rely on manually designed heuristics or model-dependent signals, limiting their applicability across tasks and user queries. To address these limitations and automate data curation, we propose \textbf{CuratorMAS}, a multi-agent collaboration framework that orchestrates agents to evaluate and curate high-quality datasets. To achieve the goal of flexible curation, CuratorMAS decomposes the complex curation process into five programmable execution stages and forms a parallelizable workflow. Specifically, CuratorMAS first performs dataset exploration to collect contextual information such as file structures and constraint cues, thereby developing a comprehensive understanding of the given task. In order to acquire up-to-date information, CuratorMAS retrieves domain knowledge from online sources to augment the evaluation process. Next, CuratorMAS derives the necessary evaluation criteria and computes the corresponding metrics. Based on these results, CuratorMAS executes filtering accordingly. Finally, an evolution module summarizes the evaluation outcomes and updates the relevant skills. Extensive and comprehensive experiments demonstrate that CuratorMAS significantly reduces the noise rate by up to 36.03 percentage points (pp) while also improving the F1 score of downstream models by up to 8.88 pp.

</details>


### [267] [Smart Content Ingestion for Generative AI Workloads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07091)
*Abbas Raza Ali,Muhammad Ajmal Siddiqui,Moona Zahid*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向生产环境的内容抽取系统，将内容抽取确立为生成式AI数据生命周期中的独立阶段，通过选择性OCR路由、基于参考的抽取评分、结构感知分块和只读检索评估器，实现可配置、可度量的抽取流水线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI使模型与任务解耦，单一基础模型服务开放式下游任务，模型端的通用性带来数据端的异构性：企业知识以PDF、演示文稿、表格、扫描件、表单、图表等人类可用格式编写，同时携带文本、视觉、几何与结构信息。语言模型或检索器无法在被错误表示的接口信息上可靠推理，因此内容抽取成为不可替代的生命周期阶段，其错误无法被下游检索或重排修复。

Method: 系统包含四个组件：选择性OCR路由；稀缺优先的策展引擎，配合基于参考的抽取评分器，测量字符、词与表格结构准确率；确定性的结构感知父子分块器；只读检索评估器，从每一页生成有依据的问题并报告Hit@k、MRR与延迟。

Result: 在180篇文档语料上，最优抽取器得分97.4/100（字符错误率0.13%，表格相似度0.995）；分块器在25,050个生成问题上达到hit@1为68.6%、hit@10为92.8%、MRR为0.77。

Conclusion: 作者提炼三条设计原则：结构先于语义、绝不修改所测量的对象、为标注预算。并将可度量的内容抽取定位为企业级智能体系统的感知层。

Abstract: The evolution of machine learning has progressively changed where intelligence resides in an AI system. In conventional machine learning the task, data representation, labels and model architecture were tightly coupled, so data preparation was narrow, schema-bound and visible. Generative AI decouples the model from any single task: one foundation model serves open-ended downstream tasks, and the generality gained on the model side is matched by heterogeneity on the data side, because enterprise knowledge is authored in the formats people use (PDF, presentations, spreadsheets, scanned documents, forms, tables, diagrams and mixed-layout files) that carry textual, visual, geometric and structural information at once. A language model or retriever cannot reason reliably over information misrepresented at this interface, so content extraction becomes a lifecycle stage in its own right whose errors no downstream retriever or re-ranker can repair. This paper presents a production-ready content-extraction system that makes this stage explicit, configurable, and measurable. The system incorporates selective OCR routing, a scarcity-first curation engine with a reference-based extraction scorer that measures character, word, and table-structure accuracy, a deterministic structure-aware parent-child chunker, and a read-only retrieval evaluator that generates grounded questions from every page and reports Hit@k, mean reciprocal rank, and latency. On a 180-document corpus the best extractor scores 97.4 of 100 (character error rate 0.13%, table similarity 0.995) and the chunker reaches hit@1 of 68.6%, hit@10 of 92.8% and MRR 0.77 over 25,050 generated questions. We distil three design principles (structure before semantics, never mutate what you measure, budget your labels) and position measured content extraction as the perception layer of enterprise agentic systems.

</details>


### [268] [Small Language Models for Smart Data Model Classification at the Edge: A Cost-Aware Hybrid Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07093)
*Cristian Martella,Angelo Martella,Antonella Longo,Motaz Saad*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究面向IoT资源受限场景，评估轻量级开源语言模型将数据实体映射到最匹配的智能数据模型（SDM），并对比通用、推理专用与代码专用模型及两类近零成本相似度基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IoT异构数据源激增，SDM分类对互操作性至关重要，但现有方法资源消耗高、难以适用于算力受限的边缘环境；文献中缺乏轻量、资源高效的解决方案。
